title: Chronic Acute Dialysis Technician - Days
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

Position responsible for providing limited Hemodialysis treatment and other services for the Chronic Kidney Disease and Acute Dialysis patient in an Acute or Sub-Acute facility. Also responsible for performing advanced indirect and selected direct patient care duties in support of the nursing process in a competent manner under the direction of an RN or LVN as outlined in the Skills Inventory and for performing related clerical functions; responsible for performing Unit Clerk and phlebotomy duties as well as for serving as preceptor and resource to staff.

Chronic Acute Dialysis Technician - Days, FT,
Shift:
Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday
2 days ( 12 hour shifts) the other 2 days (8 hour shifts)

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of (1) one year experience in an acute dialysis or chronic dialysis facility or other related field required.
  • Current CPR certification required or must be obtained within 30 days of employment.
  • Current Dialysis Technician Certification by one of the three nationally approved certifying bodies:
  • BONET: Board of Nephrology Nursing & Technology
  • NNCC: Nephrology Nursing Certifying Commission
  • NNCO: National Nephrology Certification Organization
  • Approved by the Texas Department of Health Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
  • Ability to understand written instructions and perform basic mathematical calculations; demonstrates skills for the acute dialysis assigned specialty area/function or assigned procedures, including a working knowledge of basic medical terminology and computer software skills.
  • Two (2) years Hospital or Chronic Dialysis Facility experience as a Dialysis Patient Care Technician.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform duties with increased responsibilities.
  • Ability to perform duties requiring prolonged standing, walking, stooping, bending, and lifting.
  • Demonstrates commitment to the Partners-in-Caring process by integrating our culture in all internal and external customer interactions; delivers on our brand promise of “we advance health” through innovation, accountability, empowerment, collaboration, compassion and results while ensuring one Memorial Hermann.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Performs indirect and direct chronic acute dialysis patient care duties in a competent manner as directed by a physician, registered nurse or licensed vocational nurse within the scope of hospital-approved Dialysis Patient Care Technician skills inventory according to the needs/age of the patient/population served; takes patients’ TPR and blood pressure, monitors intake and output, and maintains related records.
  • Enters physician orders via computer and coordinates schedules of diagnostic testing; assists patients with written teaching protocols; performs assigned acute dialysis treatments as directed; prepares patients for meals and feeds them; performs/assists with personal care needs; maintains patient dialysis area in orderly fashion; serves as Unit Clerk and/or monitors patients as assigned.
  • Ensures safe care to patients adhering to policies, procedures, and standards, within budgetary specifications, including time/supply management, productivity, and accuracy of practice.
  • Promotes individual professional growth/development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education, skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor, and resource to less experienced staff.
  • Prime Dialyzers, obtain dialysate solution, monitor the delivery system during treatment using all alarm systems, settings and appropriate tests.
  • Set-up and monitor dialysis equipment and systems; observe equipment and RO water system for correct function, respond to visual and audible alarms, and make appropriate adjustments prior to, during and following dialysis treatment.
  • Perform water quality checks and safety checks; dismantle, clean and disinfect equipment according to Memorial Hermann Hospital Chronic Acute Dialysis Guidelines.
  • Communicate with other ancillary departments necessary to aide in providing services to the Chronic Acute Dialysis Patients.
  • Assist with ordering of supplies and inventory maintenance.
  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.
  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Vice President, Product Management
description:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.


Magna Legal Services is seeking a Vice President of Product Management to build and lead consistent product management practices across the company. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, this leader will lead Magna’s product management team and work with Business Unit leadership in a matrixed environment to bring structure, process, and discipline to how Magna evaluates, develops, launches, and improves its products and services.

The VP will contribute to product strategy by bringing client, market, and operational insights to planning and prioritization. Working closely with leaders across Commercial (including Sales, Marketing, and Client Success), Technology, Operations, and Magna’s Business Units, including court reporting, records retrieval, jury consulting, investigations, trial technology, and language services, the VP will help turn strategic priorities into well-defined roadmaps and coordinated execution. Product sits at the center of these groups: the VP serves as the bridge between the Business Units, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Client Success, and owns enterprise-wide products that do not fall neatly within a single Business Unit, such as the client portal.

Magna’s product managers will report directly to the VP of Product Management, with a dotted line to their respective Business Unit leaders. The dotted-line relationship reflects that the Business Units own their product and offering strategy; product managers will work closely with their Business Unit leaders to ensure product development is directed by and consistent with Business Unit priorities.

The VP will also work through Magna’s Product Council, chaired by the Chief Strategy Officer, which brings together executive, commercial, and technology leadership, including the CTO, to align product priorities across the company. The VP will partner closely with the CTO and Engineering leadership, who will be actively involved in shaping product priorities, roadmaps, and feasibility decisions, so that product direction and technology strategy move forward together.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead, develop, and manage Magna’s product managers, who report directly to the VP with a dotted line to their Business Unit leaders.
  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of enterprise-wide products that serve multiple Business Units, such as the client portal.
  • Establish product management processes, standards, and governance that support consistent decision-making across Magna.
  • Introduce best practices for product discovery, opportunity assessment, prioritization, requirements development, launch planning, and ongoing improvement.
  • Contribute to product strategy by sharing client feedback, market insights, portfolio assessments, and product performance data.
  • Translate company and service-line priorities into clear product roadmaps, business requirements, and execution plans.
  • Facilitate cross-functional planning and decision-making among Business Unit, Technology, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and Operations leaders, including through Magna’s Product Council.
  • Guide product initiatives from initial concept through development, launch, adoption, and refinement.
  • Develop practical tools and frameworks to evaluate opportunities, build business cases, assess feasibility, and measure expected impact.
  • Partner with CTO/Engineering team to ensure engineering produces development timelines with enough specificity around milestones and sequencing to enable the PM to monitor and report out on progress.
  • Define and monitor measures of product performance, such as adoption, client outcomes, revenue contribution, and operational effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing products and services, and coordinate the work needed to advance them.
  • Build organizational understanding of product management roles, processes, and decision rights.

Desired Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Significant experience in product management, product operations, or product development, ideally in professional services, legal services, technology-enabled services, or a related environment.
  • Demonstrated success establishing or improving product management processes and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Experience coordinating products or services through discovery, development, launch, and ongoing improvement.
  • Strong ability to translate client and business needs into requirements, roadmaps, and actionable plans.
  • Experience with prioritization, business cases, product performance measures, or go-to-market planning.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to build alignment among senior stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the judgment to introduce process that supports effective execution.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic organization and building structure where processes are still developing.

Success in This Role

Success will mean that Magna has clear, repeatable product management practices; teams have a shared process for assessing and advancing product opportunities; and product decisions are supported by client insight, business priorities, and measurable outcomes.

title: Vice President, Client Enrollments
description:
At Freedom Debt Relief, we help everyday people move from struggling to thriving with personalized financial solutions. We are evolving from a fully phone-led enrollment model to a digital-first, hybrid one. Clients can choose to enroll online with guided, AI-assisted help and work with a skilled advisor whenever that serves them better.

As Vice President, Client Enrollments, you will lead that transformation while meeting enrollment targets through it. You will own one enrollment funnel that leverages both modes, digital self-enrollment and agent-assisted sales, so they reinforce each other rather than compete. You will lead a multi-site and remote organization of directors, managers and hundreds of enrollment specialists.

This role collaborates with performance marketing, digital product, data science and the contact center systems. You own conversion yield, unit economics, contact strategy, regulatory compliance and, ultimately, achieving the enrollment targets committed to monthly, quarterly and annually. If you have led a sales organization through a shift like this, and grown the business in both modes at once, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the hybrid enrollment transformation. Define and execute the roadmap from phone-led to digital-first enrollment. Set milestones for digital enrollment share, conversion and cost per enrollment, and sequence the change so enrollments grow throughout it.
  • Shape the digital enrollment experience with Product. Partner with Product, Design and Engineering on the guided flow: discovery, solutioning, approval and enrollment. Define the milestones, when a human or AI agent steps in, and handoffs that give the advisor full context so the live conversation picks up where the member left off digitally.
  • Redesign the sales operating model. Rethink how human and AI capacity is organized as more members enroll digitally. Refine team structures, lead ownership, compensation and incentives, and how work is routed. Build staffing and capacity plans that keep top talent engaged as roles evolve.
  • Run a modern, multichannel contact strategy. Optimize for answer rate and trust, not dial volume. Lead branded calling, verified caller ID, SMS, email, chat and appointment scheduling, and protect line health and deliverability across carriers and devices.
  • Engage the lead. Align preview, power and AI dialing to lead value, and build blended teams that work their pipeline, take new leads, and handle inbound calls and warm transfers.
  • Put AI to work across the sales lifecycle. Deploy AI to deliver information to the advisors that will improve the consumer experience and strengthen the advisor’s performance.
  • Measure everything and test rigorously. Establish KPIs from connect rate, connect-to-close, cost per enrollment, CAC and LTV. Use controlled tests and holdouts so changes such as new dialing strategies are measured and proven out, not assumed to be valuable.
  • Drive enterprise alignment. Partner with Lending (personal loans and home equity) on shared assessment, lead-value scoring, a single consumer profile and cross-product pathing. Converge where it improves results and diverge deliberately where business needs and economics differ.
  • Lead people through change. Reskill frontline teams for new roles, keep top talent through compensation and role changes, and build frontline leadership depth. Cultivate a culture anchored in Achieve's values: Care, Get Better, Act with Integrity and Collaborate.
  • Champion compliance in every channel. With Legal, Risk and Compliance, maintain adherence to TSR, TCPA, FTC guidance, state debt relief laws and UDAAP. Extend that rigor to digital disclosures, e-signature, consent for SMS, and AI-assisted conversations.

What success looks like:

Success is a growing enrollment business that has become genuinely hybrid. Members can start and finish an enrollment online and can reach a skilled advisor when that serves them better; ultimately, both paths should feel like one integrated experience. Enrollments grow throughout the shift, not only after it, against targets set with executive leadership.

Behind that client experience sits a stronger foundation: higher answer rates and healthier lines, an operating model and incentives built for hybrid enrollment, and AI that makes every advisor more effective. Cost per enrollment falls, lifetime value rises, and Debt Relief works in step with Lending to match each consumer to the right solution.

What you'll bring

  • A transformation you led. You have led, not just supported, a sales or enrollment organization through a shift from phone-led to digital or hybrid enrollment at scale. You can show the before and after: digital share, conversion, CAC and headcount.
  • Growth in both modes at once. A track record of growing digital and advisor assisted channels together, resolving channel conflict, and building compensation and roles so frontline teams embraced the shift.
  • Executive leadership at scale. 12+ years of progressive sales, enrollment or customer acquisition leadership, including 5+ years as a Senior Director or VP leading 100+ FTEs. Experience in fintech, consumer lending, mortgage, insurance, debt relief or similar high-volume consumer businesses.
  • Multichannel contact expertise. Deep experience with voice, SMS, email, chat and AI voice in high-volume environments. You understand caller-ID reputation, branded calling, carrier spam labeling, consent management and dialer strategy, and how they drive answer rates.
  • Digital funnel fluency. You have partnered closely with product and engineering on conversion funnels, A/B testing and milestone analytics, and you can shape a digital experience, not just staff the phones behind it.
  • AI in sales operations. Hands-on experience deploying AI agent assist, conversational AI, automated disposition or AI-driven quality assurance, with measurable results and sound guardrails.
  • Contact center technology. Experience scaling modern stacks, including telephony (e.g., Five9, Genesys, Twilio), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), preview, power and AI dialers, and messaging platforms.
  • Commercial and analytical rigor. Command of unit economics, CAC and LTV, lead scoring and routing, capacity planning and incentive design for hybrid models. Comfortable with experiment design and holdout testing.
  • Regulatory depth. Strong knowledge of consumer financial services regulation, the Telemarketing Sales Rule, TCPA, UDAAP and call center governance, including how they apply to digital and AI-assisted interactions.
  • Change leadership and empathy. Proven ability to bring large frontline teams through change, present strategy to the C-suite, and keep deep empathy for consumers facing financial hardship.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus factor.

Achieve well-being with:

  • Hybrid and remote work opportunities
  • 401 (k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision with HSA and FSA options
  • Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days
  • Access to wellness support through Employee Assistance Program, Talkspace, and fitness discounts
  • Up to $5,250 paid back to you on eligible education expenses
  • Pet care discounts for your furry family members
  • Financial support in times of hardship with our Achieve Care Fund
  • A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups

Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.

Work from home/hybrid:

We are proudly offering hybrid options in the San Francisco, CA and Phoenix, AZ metro markets. Hiring remotely in selected locations throughout PST, MST, CST.

Salary Range: $240,000 to $275,000 salary + bonus + benefits.

This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Join Achieve, change the future.

At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.

All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
Who we are.

Platinum Technologies is a Northern Virginia based integrated solutions firm that specializes in PaaS, Cybersecurity & AI Platform development for the Defense and Federal Sectors. Our team solves hard problems and helps our Mission Partners achieve their goals. If you are self-motivated, possess demonstrated learning agility, and are passionate about delivering high-quality work products – we want to hear from you.

We lead with technical expertise, but that is just the tip of the iceberg – the ‘Why’ matters. At Platinum, we don’t hire people to just do a job. We provide professional and leadership development to complement our self-motivated domain experts. Our teammates are dot-connecting leaders that operate in a mutually accountable environment to deliver thought leadership, expert technical analysis, and quality execution for our clients.

You.

Platinum Technologies currently has an opportunity for a Senior Database Engineer supporting the Defense Enclave Services (DES) program for DISA and the DoD Fourth Estate. This role supports secure, reliable enterprise database operations and modernization across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and Azure SQL environments.

Candidate must hold an active Secret clearance and be a U.S. citizen.

What you get to do.

Database Engineering and Operations

• Administer, maintain, monitor, and optimize enterprise database environments, including Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and Azure SQL.

• Ensure database availability, performance, reliability, security, and integrity across production and non-production environments.

• Troubleshoot complex database issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

• Perform database performance tuning, patching, upgrades, backups, recovery, and routine lifecycle maintenance.

• Monitor database health, resource utilization, and operational performance to proactively identify and resolve potential issues.

• Support database operations within classified and security-restricted DoD environments.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, configuration baselines, and operational procedures.

Database Modernization and Systems Integration

• Support modernization of legacy database environments, including migration from Oracle to Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL solutions.

• Assist with database architecture, schema design, data migration, replication, and system integration.

• Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, scripts, and database processes.

• Support database connectivity, secure application integrations, and data exchange between enterprise systems.

• Collaborate with Identity Management (IdM), infrastructure, cybersecurity, and application teams to maintain and improve mission-critical services.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Automation, Security, and Continuous Improvement

• Develop and implement automation to streamline database administration, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting.

• Use scripting and automation technologies to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and minimize operational risk.

• Implement database security controls, including access management, auditing, encryption, and vulnerability remediation.

• Apply applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements, Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and security configuration standards.

• Participate in incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes within an ITIL-based operational environment.

• Identify opportunities to improve database performance, strengthen operational resilience, and reduce recurring incidents.

• Collaborate with technical stakeholders to assess and implement practical engineering improvements.

Required Skills.

• Minimum eight (8+) years of demonstrated hands-on technical experience in database engineering, database administration, enterprise IT operations, or related technical disciplines.

• Experience administering and supporting enterprise relational database technologies, including Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server.

• Strong proficiency in SQL, database troubleshooting, performance tuning, and query optimization.

• Demonstrated experience supporting production database environments, including patching, upgrades, backups, recovery, security administration, and incident resolution.

• Experience with database migration, data integrity, and systems integration concepts.

• Working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating environments.

• Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

• Experience collaborating with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and engineering teams in complex enterprise environments.

• Strong problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills.

• Active Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.

• Current DoD 8140/8570-compliant certification satisfying the applicable position requirements, such as Security+ CE or an approved equivalent.

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience, or an approved equivalent combination of education, technical training, industry certifications, and additional directly applicable professional experience, consistent with contract labor category requirements.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, race, color, religious creed, national origin, citizenship, marital status, sex, sexual orientation/gender identity, age, or genetic information.

description:

title: Special Education Aide
description:
Job Title: Special Education Paraprofessional
Supervisor: Principal
Terms of Employment: 185 days

Job Summary
Position provides assistance to teachers in the daily instruction and care of eligible students with disabilities. As a paraprofessional, the employee works under the direction of the teacher to monitor and address the instructional, personal, and behavioral needs of students. Although responsible to the teacher(s) to whose classrooms he/she is assigned, the individual's overall performance is evaluated by the principal. Employees are subject to reassignment at any time by the building principal in consultation with the District Office to meet the changing needs of students with disabilities within the District.

Essential Duties

  1. Assists with the implementation of students' with disabilities Individualized Education Programs under the direction of the classroom teacher(s) and/or service provider(s)
  2. Assists with individual or small group instruction developed and supervised by the teacher in the assigned class(es) including but not limited to teaching, re-teaching and reviewing lessons, asking questions and prompting students and/or guiding independent work
  3. Attends to the needs of students with disabilities that may include personal hygiene, lifting, feeding, toileting, monitoring supportive medical equipment, i.e., walkers, wheelchairs, etc.
  4. facilitating the use of assistive technology
  5. Escorts and supervises students not limited to daily arrival and school departure, transitions between classes, the playground, cafeteria, and off-site learning activities
  6. Collects, charts, and reports student performance data to teachers
  7. Performs general clerical tasks for assigned classroom, including maintaining student records (i.e., data books, portfolios, assignment folders)
  8. Distributes, and collects instructional materials and reports
  9. Assists with behavioral management programs in the classroom and implements behavior intervention plans and/or plans for independence for individual students
  10. Participates in designated staff development. Paraprofessionals who may be required to physically restrain students to ensure their safety and the safety of others will be provided appropriate staff development
  11. Maintains bulletin boards and classroom supply inventories, as appropriate
  12. Provides ABA therapy, as appropriate. Paraprofessionals who provide this related service are required to participate in ongoing, supplemental staff development
  13. Serves as an educational team member who collaborates and supports the efforts of school staff and the needs of all students with disabilities

Other Duties
Performs any other related duties as assigned by the Principal or other appropriate administrator.

Job Specifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required)

  1. Must meet requirements for a paraprofessional which includes one of the following: Minimum of 60 college credit hours or an Associates Degree or Paraprofessional certificate (minimum score of 456 on the exam), or passed the areas of WorkKeys/WIN
  2. Knowledge, skills and abilities of this job may include the following:
    • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals
    • Write routine reports and correspondence
    • Communicate effectively before groups of customers or employees of an organization
    • Apply common sense in the delivery, understanding and following instructions in written, oral, or diagram form
    • Add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
    • Compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and reach with hands and arms; walk; sit; stoop or kneel; crouch or crawl. Duties may involve risk resulting from attending to students' behavioral, physical or sanitation/hygiene needs.

Additional physical requirements include the following:

  • Physically capable of frequently lifting or moving up to 40 pounds
  • Sufficiently mobile to ensure the safety of students
  • Specific vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, color vision peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time
  • Manual dexterity for the purpose of using a telephone and data entry
  • Read a computer screen and printed material with or without vision aids
  • Hear and understand speech at normal levels and on the telephone
  • Speak in audible tones so that others may understand clearly in person and on the telephone


Work Environment
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Duties are normally performed in a school/classroom environment.
Duties may be conducted in work-related community settings and/or occasionally performed on study trips away from the school. This position requires 7.5 hours with no unencumbered lunch.

Pay Grade: 103-104

title: Manager, Product Integrity — Connected Products
description:
Fortune Brands Innovations is hiring a Manager, Product Integrity to join our Connected Products team. Product Integrity is the team that confirms our connected products — Flo by Moen water devices, Yale and August smart locks, and Master Lock connected padlocks — do what their requirements say they do before they reach a customer. This role leads that team and owns the bridge between requirements and proof: taking what Product, Systems Architecture, and Compliance ask for and turning it into tests with a method, a sample size, and a pass/fail criterion.

The role also owns 100% end-of-line testing at the factory, including test fixture design and test software. Depending on test complexity, fixtures are built fully in-house or developed with a supplier.

We are looking for a leader who can spearhead the product quality and integrity function covering test definition, systems integration, test execution, and holding a high product integrity bar. This leader will lead a hardware testing team. The right person understands the whole product — electrical, mechanical, firmware, and how they interact — well enough to argue a requirement with Product, an interface with Architecture, and the statistics with Reliability, and then run the lab that proves it.

Position location: this position is eligible to work in a hybrid environment out of our North Olmsted, OH or San Francisco, CA locations.

What you will own

  • The Product Integrity team. Lead a team of test engineers covering production and 100% test, hardware test, reliability test, quality inspection, and overall confirmation of product requirements. You set the direction and the standard; the team executes.
  • Requirements into tests. Turn every hardware requirement in the PRD — from Product, Systems Architecture, and Compliance — into a testable requirement with a method, a sample size, an acceptance criterion, and a gate. Product defines the design envelope; you define how we test to it.
  • Gate evidence. Every stage gate (EVT, DVT, PVT) carries your evidence package: what was tested, against which requirement, with what result.
  • Reliability. Define the reliability test plan for each program and own the statistics behind it: sample sizes, confidence levels, and acceleration factors for environmental testing.
  • Production test. Develop fixtures and test software that meet approved cycle times, with test limits tied to expected field performance.
  • Field performance. Review returns and field data, and feed what you learn back into requirements and test plans.

The team and the logistics

  • Team: test engineers covering production test, hardware test, reliability test, and quality inspection. The lab is in North Olmsted.
  • Location: North Olmsted, OH or San Francisco, CA. If based in San Francisco, expect occasional travel to North Olmsted.
  • Travel: ~15%. Travel to factories in Nogales and Tecate, Mexico; Hanoi, Vietnam; and between North Olmsted and San Francisco.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years on connected consumer hardware spanning electrical, mechanical, and firmware.
  • Experience developing factory test fixtures at both board level and end of line.
  • Experience writing requirements and V&V plans.
  • Reliability engineering fluency: accelerated life testing, Weibull and AFR math, sample sizing at a stated confidence, HALT/HASS, thermal, drop, and cycle life. You can design a plan and read a failure.
  • Production test experience: fixtures, test software, DFT, cycle time, and yield at a contract manufacturer.
  • Has led a small technical team and is comfortable setting direction for test engineers who are more hands-on than you.

Nice to have

  • Battery power model development.
  • Sensor products with calibration and drift requirements.
  • Sealed or outdoor enclosures.
  • RF performance characterization.
  • Certification literacy across safety (UL), RF (FCC), and interop (Matter/CSA); NSF/IAPMO for water products or BHMA for locks.

title: Special Education Assistant Principal
description:
At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

The Integrated Special Education (ISE) Instructional Coach will be a key member of the school's instructional leadership team and critical to driving forward the quality of Integrated Special Education within Rocketship schools. The ISE Coach will work closely with the Principal and the Director of Integrated Special Education to lead and implement the instructional and case management vision for all students with IEPs and 504 Plans as well as oversee MTSS. The ISE Coach will coach the special education team consisting of special education teachers and paraprofessionals,, as well as lead core special education collaboration practices, including data analysis cycles, observing classrooms, providing continuous feedback including in the moment coaching, and co-planning units of study and lesson plans aimed at increasing educator effectiveness. The ISE coach will also support and coach compliance practices, such as IEP writing, facilitating, and filing. This role will also develop and facilitate ongoing professional development for instructional and compliance practices. Within MTSS, this role will ensure response to student data according to cycles of intervention, and parent and school requests for evaluations. Within MTSS this role is responsible for scheduling and holding SST meetings in response to data and requests to plan and propose student supports, as well as monitoring implementation and progress. The ISE Coach will play a critical role in driving school teams toward ensuring that all Rocketeers are served in a compliant (audit ready), effective and high-quality environment, with the goal to achieve 1.5 years of growth (based on NWEA annually) in both math and literacy. As an ISE Instructional Coach, you will receive ongoing professional development in conducting rigorous observations, providing meaningful feedback, and executing useful planning and analysis.
The ISE Coach reports to the school principal, and is also supported by the Director of ISE.
Our Ideal Candidate:
Believes that adult preparation is essential to student success. Has a desire to become an elementary content expert and is eager to use that knowledge to develop teachers who demonstrate excellence in their planning and execution of lessons. Understands that creating equal access to opportunity for all is hard work but deeply rewarding and within their control.

Essential Functions: Developing Effective Educators

  • Coach special education teachers, paraprofessionals and school based related service providers to build content expertise in Humanities or STEM for co-teaching and small group instruction.
  • Collaborate and provide regular consultation with service providers and key contractors as needed.
  • Collaborate with the School Leadership Team and general education teachers to implement exemplary special education services that meet student needs and are consistently in compliance.
  • Foster a rigorous and college preparatory culture of excellence in every classroom that ensures high levels of student achievement.
  • Engage in cycles of data driven instruction and assessments to inform planning and personalize instruction to student needs.
  • Develop and support coaching plans for individual members of the special education team, leading to sustained improvement in instructional practice.
  • Ensure at least 1.5 years of progress for all Rocketeers annually through management and planning.
  • Collaborate with the Special Education team to ensure teachers are receiving the necessary support and training to maximize the delivery of instruction.
  • In partnership with the school-based instructional team, provide professional development training to school staff as-needed regarding best practices in special education, trauma-informed education, social-emotional supports, crisis intervention, and community resources.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Essential Functions: Case Management Leadership

  • Model and build the exemplars for case management systems and practices for the school.
  • Provide coaching and feedback on all IEP practices including but not limited to IEP drafts, IEP meeting facilitation, progress monitoring of IEP goals, and service tracking among others.
  • Coach case managers on effective time management to ensure the school team is holding compliant IEP meetings that consistently meet deadlines (meetings and evaluations).
  • Act as LEA Representative for IEP meetings.
  • Collaborate with the school, regional and national team for advocate and attorney engagement on campus.
  • Monitor student progress towards IEP goal attainment.
  • Monitor, provide coaching and feedback of the IEP database and IEP files (virtual and as applicable physical).
  • Provide crisis intervention for students with IEPs and 504 Plans, as well as build the capacity of staff to provide crisis intervention.
  • Provide consultation with parents, teachers, and other appropriate staff regarding students’ special education program and any adaptations/materials needed to facilitate improved performance in the classroom or at home, as well as coach case managers to build their capacity to communicate with parents, teachers and other staff.
  • Maintain relationships and effectively communicate with the school leaders team, teachers, and families in all facets of the position.
  • Adhere to all federal and state requirements for 504 Plans and special education to remain in compliance with current law.
  • Maintain a close working relationship with other members of the Regional and National ISE team to ensure exchange of best practices, coordination of efforts, and general support for the Integrated Special Education department.

Essential Functions: Student and Parent Partnership:

Essential Functions: Rocketship Professional Culture:

  • Create a healthy, high-achieving, urgent environment where staff and students feel challenged and also fully supported and valued.
  • Promote and participate in collaborative opportunities across schools to share best practices, problem solve, and gather feedback.

Required Qualifications:

  • Valid Special Education teaching credential or administrative license; Master’s degree in Special Education or related field strongly preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience teaching and/or leading in an urban city classroom; demonstrated track record of improving academic outcomes for students with disabilities.
  • Embrace the mission of Rocketship Education and our inclusive approach to serving students with disabilities.
  • Knowledge of federal and state laws and regulations associated with special education.
  • Experience working with students with a range of disabilities (learning disabilities, emotional and behavioral disorders, autism, etc.).
  • Experience implementing student supports through a Multi-Tiered Systems of Support (MTSS)
  • Experience working with elementary aged students is strongly preferred.
  • Strong leadership skills and personal drive.
  • Deep knowledge of elementary instruction and planning skills.

title: Internship Programme, Valuations & Modelling - London (July 2027)
description:
Why S&W?

At S&W, we believe a great early career experience is about more than just the work you do. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that help shape your future. Whether that's developing new skills, growing your confidence or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that supports you to be yourself and succeed.

During your internship, you'll contribute to meaningful work, learn from experienced professionals and gain first-hand insight into life in professional services.

As one of the UK's fastest-growing accountancy and advisory firms, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. Your internship is a chance to experience life at S&W first-hand, get to know our people and culture, and explore what a future career with us could look like.

We see our interns as future talent, which is why many go on to secure a place on one of our Graduate programmes after completing their degree.

No previous experience in accountancy, finance or professional services is required. We're looking for people who are curious, motivated and eager to learn. What matters most is your attitude, potential and willingness to get involved.

The Valuations and Modelling team at S&W

The V&M team is part of a broader advisory department alongside our due diligence, forensics, restructuring, and corporate finance. Over the last four years, the V&M team has over doubled in size is currently made up of 40 people across our London, Birmingham and Newcastle offices.

Being a dynamic and collaborative team, we give our people an opportunity to receive hands-on coaching from a range of members across the team, and client exposure from day one. Our client base spans across many industries and client types, and we will be able to offer you a variety of experiences across different V&M projects.

What will you be doing?

The V&M team prepares a wide range of valuations and financial models for accounting, tax and commercial purposes. In addition to business and share valuations, the team also prepares valuations of key intangible assets (trademarks, patents and other technology assets) and incentive scheme awards (e.g. share options and management share plans).

Over the course of the internship, you'll gain valuable insight into life at S&W, develop professional skills, expand your network and build a deeper understanding of the opportunities available in Audit & Assurance.

You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from support from colleagues across the business, giving you the opportunity to learn from people at different stages of their careers and build connections that last beyond the programme.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting more senior members of the team on a wide range of projects at the same time;
  • Taking ownership of allocated tasks and being accountable for the quality of the deliverable provided, making sure time is managed efficiently across the relevant projects;
  • Learning and implementing key valuation methodologies and concepts;
  • Preparing and analysing financial data;
  • Support on financial modelling activities;
  • Using available data sources, performing clear and concise industry research including industry trends, comparable companies and key metrics observed on transactions;
  • Supporting the team on business development initiatives; and
  • Being involved in project management and time management to achieve deadlines.

To Be Successful in This Role

You'll be someone who:

  • Is naturally curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges
  • Communicates well, builds positive relationships and collaborates effectively with others
  • Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems
  • Is organised, willing to take ownership and able to manage competing priorities
  • Is interested in understanding how businesses operate and the challenges they face

You'll also need to:

  • Be available for the full duration of the internship programme (28th June – 6th August)
  • Be in your penultimate year of university
  • Be on track to achieve at least a 2:2 degree in any discipline
  • Have a minimum of 112 UCAS points from your top three A Levels (or equivalent), excluding General Studies
  • Have achieved a minimum Grade 5 (or equivalent) in GCSE English Language and Maths

No previous experience in accountancy, finance or professional services is required, and we welcome applications from all degree disciplines.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.

We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know.

IMPORTANT NOTES FOR COMPLETING YOUR APPLICATION

When you click on the 'I'm interested' button, you'll be taken to your profile page. We're currently updating it, but in the meantime:

  • We can only accept one application to any of our programmes in a recruitment season. If you're unsuccessful, you'll need to wait until the following recruitment season to reapply.
  • Under the Resume (CV) section, uploading a document is mandatory; however, it will not be formally reviewed.

title: Principal Research Scientist I, Biologics Analytical Research and Development, CMC Biologics Development
description:
AbbVie Biologics Analytical Research & Development (Biologics Analytical R&D) is a global analytical sciences organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products. Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative therapeutic biologic medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules through the transition of analytical methods and testing to commercial labs to support product launch. We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines. Careers in AbbVie Biologics Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.

The biologics characterization group develops state-of-the-art analytical techniques for in-depth characterization of therapeutic proteins and other novel biologic molecules using advanced, combined analytical techniques. We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific and leadership experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a subject matter expert in BioARD, lead phase-appropriate analytical development strategies for biologics characterization including ADC, PDC, AOC, fusion proteins, multi-specific antibodies, and other novel modalities.
  • Design and execute the buildout of biotherapeutics extended characterization methods, to facilitate in-process analytics, batch release/stability, RS qualification, and comparability study.
  • Make lab-based, data-driven, and phase-appropriate contributions to project team and deliver results in a team-oriented setting and will work across scientific disciplines to drive programs through critical milestones.
  • Represent key area function in cross-functional project teams, provide hands-on analytical support, technical oversight to portfolios.
  • Collaborate and integrate scientific objectives associated with development of new/improved products or technology; contribute to scientific exchange and publications.
  • Author, review lab notebook, analytical report, and analytical sections of regulatory filings. Primary author of external publications, presentations, and patents. Present at leading scientific conferences.
  • May mentor/supervise a team of one or more, guide and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals.
  • BS or equivalent education with 14+ years of experience; MS or equivalent education with 12+ years of experience; PhD in scientific discipline (e.g., Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Biology) with typically 6+ years of industry experience, is required.
  • Demonstrated proficiency and substantial hands-on experience in mass spectrometry-based characterization of biologics, including intact/subunit analysis, peptide mapping, disulfide bond mapping, etc., as well as hands-on experience in mass spec data processing and interpretation using various MS software platforms.
  • Strong working knowledge and familiarity with separation-based analytical techniques, including SEC, HIC, HILIC, RPLC, IEX, CE, icIEF, etc.
  • Knowledge in key analytical CMC areas, such as risk-based analytical development and method validation, CQAs assessment, reference standard qualification, comparability study.
  • Familiarity with biophysical assays, or binding and functional assays are plus.
  • Working knowledge of lab automation, good written and oral communication skills, time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.

title: Blue Collar Tour Hype Person / MC (Hypeman)
description:
Skilled Trades Ambassador, Blue Grit's Blue Collar Tour

Organization: Blue Grit's Blue Collar Tour

Job type: Full-time mobile tour role

Tour dates: On site starting January 4, 2027, through mid-to-late March 2027

Location: Nationwide travel

Pay: $2,000 per week plus $60 per day per diem

Lodging: All lodging is covered, including weekends

About the Blue Collar Tour

Blue Grit's Blue Collar Tour is a nationwide tour that stops at high schools across the country and covers all trades. Now in its seventh year (it started in 2021), the tour brings a high-energy, hands-on program to students, sparking interest in skilled trades through live demos, student participation, and a mission-first message about post-grad opportunity.

Role Summary

You're the on-mic heartbeat of every stop. You'll warm up large student crowds, run the show from start to finish, weave in safety and sponsor moments, and turn the tour's mission into moments that are fun, respectful, and memorable.

What You'll Do

  • Own the mic: Open, host, and close each event. Deliver high-energy intros, transitions, and calls-to-action that land with high-school audiences.
  • Engage and motivate: Read the room, invite participation, and sustain energy while reinforcing respect, safety, and inclusion.
  • Tell the mission story: Share real paths into skilled trades and point students to clear next steps (QR codes, sign-ups, counselor follow-through).
  • Run the show: Keep segments on time. Coordinate with instructors, AV, and school staff, and adapt to gym, shop, and fairground venues.
  • Safety first: Give crisp pre-demo safety briefs (boundaries and PPE) and reinforce them throughout.
  • Partner mentions: Work required acknowledgements and equipment highlights into the show naturally.
  • Content moments: Set up photo and video beats, and support the media team with shout-outs and crowd cues.
  • Represent well: Earn trust with administrators and teachers, and handle Q&A professionally.
  • Improve the playbook: Capture engagement notes and timing to help the tour get better every stop.

What You Bring

  • Stage presence and voice: Experience as an MC, host, or public speaker (assemblies, tours, sports, concerts, brand activations).
  • Youth-audience savvy: Rapport, humor, and classroom-level crowd control.
  • Mission alignment: Genuine belief in skilled trades and multiple post-secondary pathways.
  • Adaptability and composure: Move quickly from hype to instructional to inspirational, and stay calm when tech or timing shifts.
  • Professionalism and teamwork: Take feedback, protect the brand, and support school relationships.
  • Safety mindset: Comfortable reinforcing PPE and demo boundaries.
  • Valid driver's license and road-ready for back-to-back routes.
  • School-site ready: Background check required for K-12 environments.
  • Nice to have: Trades, education, coaching, youth programs, or live-event production background.

Schedule and Travel

  • Dates: The tour team is expected on site starting January 4, 2027, through mid-to-late March 2027.
  • Schedule: Expect 5 to 6 days a week, early load-ins, school-day assemblies, and occasional evenings.
  • Travel: Heavy nationwide travel.
  • Lodging: All lodging is covered. During the week the team sleeps on the tour bus, and weekend lodging is provided.
  • Physical: On your feet for extended periods, projecting your voice in large spaces, with occasional lifting with team support.

Pay and Perks

  • Pay: $2,000 per week plus $60 per day per diem.
  • Lodging: All lodging covered, including weekends.
  • Experience: Tour-life experience, portfolio-building footage, and networking with schools and industry partners.

How to Apply

Apply here, or email info@applytoweld.com.

title: Senior Service Designer
description:
What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a skilled practitioner with significant experience in delivering service design projects. The focus of your role will be to create end-to-end, evidence-based designs for services which are inclusive and accessible. You’ll often be working with multidisciplinary teams on complex projects where autonomy and project management will be important.

We’re on the hunt for someone who will champion our values: to care passionately, be fluent in people, believe in your craft, push convention, be open to change, value each other.

We work with a broad range of clients, some of whom are completely new to user-centred design (UCD). This means you’ll also play a key role in championing our UCD approach.

The role may also involve:

  • Leading and directing projects – You’ll lead multidisciplinary teams and clients in the pursuit of inclusive, accessible and planet-friendly services.
  • Team support and management – You’ll help to support the service design team by inspiring and line managing team members, including overseeing appraisals and professional development.
  • Defining and refining practice – You’ll help to define the way our disciplines work together, and progress the way NEC Digital Studio does inclusive, sustainable design.
  • Supporting new business – You’ll help NEC Digital Studio find and win work by spotting opportunities with clients and helping with proposals and pitches.

We welcome applicants from all professional backgrounds. We acknowledge that we didn’t all start out as service designers and are proud of the varied expertise amongst our team. Our minimum criteria is that you have degree or professional experience that is relevant to Service Design.

Your skills and experience

We’d like to hear from you if you have skills or experience in some of these areas:

  • Research - Scope, plan and conduct research activities to identify and articulate the key factors influencing the service, its users and the wider operating environment. Synthesise findings into actionable insights that inform design and delivery decisions.
  • Strategy & systems thinking – Familiar with systems thinking, you lead teams and clients to map and analyse strategies, systems and scenarios. You’re experienced in forming well-grounded strategic recommendations.
  • User-centred journeys & experiences - You choose the right approaches to lead projects to outcomes that are great for the user, feasible to implement, and fit the client’s strategic vision.
  • Bridging design and delivery - Build strong working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, facilitating collaboration between design, product and technical stakeholders. Translate insights, needs and constraints into clear requirements and support alignment around delivery priorities and outcomes.
  • Facilitation - You lead teams to design and deliver engaging and effective workshops. You support colleagues to present to and inspire clients, stakeholders and other colleagues.
  • Visual communication - You lead teams to make clear and compelling points through well-designed visuals. This may include drawing and sketching or graphic communication
  • Written communication - You guide teams on the most appropriate written formats and structures for each project. You create and oversee clear, concise writing.
  • Recommendation & implementation - You work with stakeholders to identify what change is possible and how to bring it about. This includes outlining timeframes and resource implications, and identifying future phases of work.
  • Prototyping - You lead teams, clients and stakeholders to scope targeted prototyping exercises. You work across disciplines to design, build and test prototypes that contribute to project outcomes (online and offline).
  • Stakeholder management – you know how to negotiate and guide clients and stakeholders towards positive outcomes that deliver outcomes within budget.
  • Managing complexity and ambiguity – Services are complex and messy! You’re up for leaping into the unknown, supporting our team members and clients to navigate the uncertainty that comes with service transformation projects
  • Proactive and autonomous – you can lead the conversation, and look for ways to participate and add value
  • Experience working in Health or Pharma sectors would be ideal

How we work

We work with central and local government, the NHS, charity and private sector organisations.

We work hand in hand with our clients and sometimes we’re embedded in their teams for projects. Beyond individual projects, NEC Digital Studio’s Service Designers support each other at weekly meet-ups where we share our work, discuss its wider implications, and learn about methods.

You’ll also broaden your skills by working closely with members of the User Research and Digital teams, including interaction and content designers, developers and user researchers.

All of our Service Designers are supported by more senior members of the Service Design team. They look after your wellbeing, help you set goals and objectives and provide feedback to help you grow.

We pride ourselves in offering an excellent benefits package, including an above average pension scheme. When you join the team at NEC Software Solutions, you are provided with the following:

  • Private Medical Cover funded by NEC for Employees (with the option to add family members at an additional cost)
  • 25 days paid holiday with the option to buy/sell (FTE)
  • 4 x basic salary life assurance cover funded by NEC (with the option to increase cover at an additional cost)
  • A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions up to a maximum of 8.5%
  • A selection of flexible benefits to suit your individual needs
  • All colleagues get free access to LinkedIn Learning. Over 15000 courses covering a huge breadth of subjects. Learn about what you like, when you like, how you like.

OTHER INFORMATION

  • Candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. Documentary evidence will be required.
  • All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting, references and occupational health checks.
  • Depending on the nature of the role a Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check may also be required. SC clearance will also be required for the role.

NEC Software Solutions is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from all communities. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have specific accessibility needs during the recruitment or interview process, please feel free to share these with us. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accommodating experience for all candidates.

We receive applicants from multiple different sources - so the application process may vary. Once you have chosen to apply the key things we would like to see in your applications are:

  • A CV
  • A Cover Letter - tell us why you think you’d a good fit for the role and why you want to work for NECD. Please aim to keep your covering letter to 1000 words.
  • A copy of your portfolio

Who We Are:

We’re NEC Software Solutions. While you read this ad, our software is helping to dispatch ambulances, support families, keep trains on the move, locate missing people and even test the hearing of newborn babies.

Working with us, you’ll be helping our 3,000+ employees push the boundaries of what’s possible and support amazing public services.

We work with governments, hospitals, police forces, housing providers, local authorities, charities and more. We help them pay financial support faster, improve diagnosis and treatments for patients and respond to emergencies in the right way. The more we do, the more our customers can do for others. And together, we make a world of difference.

At NEC Digital Studio, we believe in design practices that make the world more human.

NEC Digital Studio was created to put people at the centre of services, positively changing how they experience the world. Everything we design, build and maintain is made for life. Our mission is to empower organisations to be more effective, inclusive and sustainable, through tools, systems and experiences that are intelligent, integrated and intuitive for all.​

As a people-first digital studio, we are designing and developing evidence-led solutions at scale to transform the services used by everyone, every day.​

We specialise in working with seldom heard voices and diverse user groups. We practice participatory co-design and ethical research. Our teams are experts in accessibility and digital inclusion

We’d love your help. And we’ll support you all the way.

title: Senior Director - Payments Strategy
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Senior Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our clinical trial payments solution, Veeva Payments, within the Veeva Clinical Operations suite.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Payments solution. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial budgeting, site contracting, and investigator payments within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how sponsors and CROs budget, contract, and pay clinical research sites.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of Veeva Payments among Life Sciences companies (Sponsors, CROs, and emerging biotechs), aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
  • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a connected payments solution in improving site payment speed, budget visibility, financial accuracy, and site satisfaction
  • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native payments application that generates payable items directly from trial execution data, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure revenue goals are achieved
  • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical trial payments and site financial technology at key industry events, conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Payments roadmap based on market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
  • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on site payment and trial budgeting pain points, identify emerging trends in site financial management and investigator retention, and provide actionable insights to enhance the Payments product and overall business strategy

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
  • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations and finance leaders, and C-level executives)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

  • Payments Domain Expertise: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy or implementation for clinical trial payment or site financial management solutions; understanding the nuances of fee schedules, clinical trial agreements, study budgets, and accounts payable integration is a core competency
  • Clinical Operations Expertise: Specific experience with the operational and financial workflows of clinical research sites, sponsors, and CROs
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and the compliance considerations of investigator payments, including fair market value and transparency reporting
  • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $150,000 - $300,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

title: Schrijnwerker gespecialiseerd in brandwerende deuren (m/v/x)
description:
Als schrijnwerker gespecialiseerd in brandwerende deuren speel je een sleutelrol in de veiligheid en de goede werking van de infrastructuur van Kliniek Sint-Jan. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het installeren, onderhouden en herstellen van brandwerende deuren en ander bijbehorende schrijnwerkelementen en zorgt ervoor dat deze voldoen aan de huidige brandveiligheidsnormen.

Belangrijkste taken

  • Installatie en onderhoud van brandwerende deuren:
    • Je installeert en past brandwerende deuren aan in overeenstemming met de technische specificaties.
    • Je controleert en past automatische sluitsystemen en opzwellende afdichtingen aan.
    • Je vervangt of herstelt defecte onderdelen (scharnieren, deursluiters, sloten ...).
  • Controle en conformiteit:
    • Je voert regelmatig controles uit om ervoor te zorgen dat brandwerende deuren goed werken.
    • Je documenteert je werk en stelt onderhoudsrapporten op.
    • Je zorgt ervoor dat installaties voldoen aan de brandbeveiligingsvoorschriften (RF-normen).
  • Samenwerking en technische ondersteuning:
    • Je werkt samen met het onderhoudsteam en de technische diensten van de kliniek.
    • Je adviseert over de keuze van materialen en uitrustingen in overeenstemming met de veiligheidsnormen.
    • Je zorgt voor een snelle interventie bij vastgestelde niet-conformiteiten.

Andere taken kunnen uitgevoerd worden volgens de noden van de dienst.

    • Je hebt een opleiding in schrijnwerkerij, meubelmakerij of gelijkwaardig en beschikt over een erkenning als plaatser van brandwerende deuren (ISIB-certificering).
    • Je hebt ten minste 3 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie.
    • Je kan autonoom werken en werkt tegelijkertijd graag in team verband.
    • Je bent proactief, hebt doorzettingsvermogen en toont flexibiliteit aan.
    • Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en werkt nauwkeurig.

    • Een contract van onbepaalde duur
    • Een salarispakket in overeenstemming met de functie, met erkenning van relevante anciënniteit
    • Hospitalisatieverzekering na 6 maanden en verzekering ongevallen privé-leven
    • 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (pro rata van de arbeidstijd), evenals extra verlofdagen op 50, 52 en 55 jaar en in overeenstemming met de geldende wetgeving
    • Medische consultaties in de Kliniek Sint-Jan tegen ziekenfondstarieven

    • Bedrijfsrestaurant aan voordeeltarief
    • Een warme professionele werkomgeving waarin het menselijke aspect centraal staat
