title: Lead Systems Engineer
description:
Who we are.

Platinum Technologies is a Northern Virginia based integrated solutions firm that specializes in PaaS, Cybersecurity & AI Platform development for the Defense and Federal Sectors. Our team solves hard problems and helps our Mission Partners achieve their goals. If you are self-motivated, possess demonstrated learning agility, and are passionate about delivering high-quality work products – we want to hear from you.

We lead with technical expertise, but that is just the tip of the iceberg – the ‘Why’ matters. At Platinum, we don’t hire people to just do a job. We provide professional and leadership development to complement our self-motivated domain experts. Our teammates are dot-connecting leaders that operate in a mutually accountable environment to deliver thought leadership, expert technical analysis, and quality execution for our clients.

You.

Platinum Technologies currently has an opportunity for a Systems Engineer SME supporting the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) Integrated Information Technology Support Services (I3TS) digital modernization program. In this role, you will work with government and technical leadership to strengthen mission-critical systems, improve operational efficiency, and maintain secure Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) infrastructure. This role is located at Fort Belvoir, VA.

Candidate must hold an active TS/SCI clearance at the time of consideration.

What you get to do.

• Architect, deploy, and maintain CSfC infrastructure across Black, Gray, and Red networks.

• Design and sustain multilayer CSfC architectures aligned with NSA Data-at-Rest (DAR) and Mobile Access (MA) Capability Packages.

• Architect and administer certificate authorities, OCSP responders, public key infrastructure (PKI), and hardware security modules (HSMs) consistent with CSfC key management requirements.

• Manage VMware vSphere/ESXi or Nutanix AHV hyperconverged environments, including vSAN or distributed storage, and design resilient air-gapped backup and disaster recovery solutions.

• Deploy and administer hardened Windows Server (Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy) and Red Hat Enterprise Linux systems.

• Implement tamper-resistant centralized syslog collection and forwarding from network devices, hypervisors, and operating systems to enterprise SIEM platforms, including cross-domain log forwarding.

• Build and maintain automated operating-system deployment and gold-image workflows using Microsoft Configuration Manager (MCM/SCCM) for CSfC end-user devices.

• Apply and validate patches and DISA STIGs, conduct vulnerability scans, track IAVMs, and remediate findings to maintain Authorization to Operate (ATO).

Required Skills.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Engineering Management, Management Information Systems, or a related STEM field, with 12–15 years of relevant experience; or a master’s degree with 10–13 years of relevant experience. A technical doctorate or equivalent combination of experience, education, and training may be considered.

• 12+ years of progressive systems engineering experience in DoD/DoW, federal, or defense contractor enterprise environments.

• Active TS/SCI security clearance at time of consideration.

• Active DoD 8570.01-M / DoD 8140 IAT Level II or III baseline certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, CASP+, or CISSP).

• Active computing environment certification in at least one of the following: VMware VCP/VCAP, Nutanix NCP, Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), or Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.

• Direct experience drafting CSfC Key Management Plans (KMPs) and Continuous Monitoring Plans (CMPs) for NSA CSfC PMO approval.

• Proficiency with PowerShell, Bash, and Ansible for automated STIG remediation, configuration drift detection, and certificate deployment.

• Advanced configuration of Rsyslog or Syslog-ng and log-forwarding architectures to enterprise SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Elastic.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, race, color, religious creed, national origin, citizenship, marital status, sex, sexual orientation/gender identity, age, or genetic information.

title: APP Per Diem Main Line Health
description:
SHIFT:

Any (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
In collaboration with an attending physician, Hospital Provider Nurse Practitioner is responsible for the direct care and follow-up of a population of patients that matches his/her scope of practice and skill set. This care is delivered in defined inpatient and hospital-outpatient areas. The components of the role include clinical practice, consultation, professional development, education, and research. The NPs in these roles may be required to have acute/critical care education and certification. The appropriate education/certification will be determined by the scope of the role in a particular practice area. The clinical portion of this role will require increased level of accountability including managing a cohort of high acuity patients. In addition to managing patient care, the Hospital Provider NP may be required to utilize invasive interventions and procedures to promote physiologic stability. The role will also include off-shift responsibility. The off shift rotation schedule may include days, evenings, nights, weekends and holidays and will be determined by the clinical needs of the practice environment.

What you will do

  • Assesses the complex acute, critical and chronically ill patient for urgent and emergent conditions. Uses relevant data to evaluate for physiologic instability. Utilizes the data to formulate a plan of care.
  • Performs therapeutic interventions to stabilize acute and critical health problems. Specific interventions are listed in the Scope of Practice Document and approved as a part of the credentialing/privileging process.
  • Analyzes the indications, contraindications, risk of complications and cost-benefits of therapeutic interventions.
  • Manages the plan of care through evaluation, modification and documentation according to the patient's response to therapy. Manages changes in condition with a focus on optimizing the patient outcomes.
  • Incorporates health promotion, health protection and injury prevention measures into the plan of care within the context of the complex acute, critical and chronic illness.
  • Facilitates the patient's transitions between and within health care settings.
  • Serves as an educational resource to the patient/family, nursing staff, and provider team. Acts as a consultant to multidisciplinary health care team members.
  • Participates in scholarly activities including research and education. Participates in own professional development by maintaining required competencies, identifying learning needs and seeking appropriate educational offerings. Participates in the professional development of others. Acts as a preceptor and mentor to support the development of nurses, nurse practitioners, students, and other health care providers.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to patient safety by speaking up about safety issues and changing practice to enhance safety. Shares errors or potential errors through system reporting mechanisms. Demonstrates shared accountability for safe practice.

Education Qualifications

  • Master's Degree Nursing - Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to work in an inter-professional team setting with multiple responsibilities.
  • Ability to use computer and electronic medical records effectively.
  • Refer to Scope of Practice Document and Clinical Responsibilities Checklist for specific requirements of role.
  • Computer Competency
  • Basic use of a computer (mouse, keyboard, printer, USB ports).
  • Basic use of Microsoft Office (Word processing, spreadsheets, presentations and Skype).
  • Web browsing, intranet search, document access.
  • Use of shared network file space.
  • Basic use of patient facing technology. (e.g. IV pumps, point of care devices, CR monitors).
  • Navigation and use of clinical communication systems.
  • Information Literacy
  • Determines the nature and extent of clinical information needed and uses the appropriate technology to access it.
  • Accesses needed information effectively and efficiently.
  • Evaluates information and its sources critically and appropriately incorporates it into clinical practice.
  • Evaluates outcomes of the use of information.

title: Pharmacy Data Technician
description:
Springfield, Missouri, United States of America

Extraordinary Care. Extraordinary Careers.

With one of the nation’s largest, most innovative long-term care pharmacy services providers, there is no limit to the growth of your career.

Guardian of the Heartland, a member of the Guardian family of pharmacies, has an exciting opportunity for you to join our rapidly growing team in Springfield, Missouri.

Why Guardian of the Heartland? We’re reimagining medication management and transforming care.

Who We Are and What We’re About:

Our core focus is delivering customized medication management solutions to support healthcare organizations serving seniors and individuals with complex care needs. With our comprehensive suite of tech-enabled pharmacy services and a dedicated team of professionals committed to enriching the lives of those we serve, we are redefining how pharmacy care is delivered.

We offer an opportunity to learn and grow your career in a fast-paced, diverse, and inclusive environment. If you are looking for a challenging, team-oriented environment in which you can put your expertise to work, then this is the place for you.

SCHEDULE: MONDAY-FRIDAY 11A-8P. EVERY 5TH WEEKEND SATURDAY AND SUNDAY 9A-5P.

Responsible for entering and processing prescriptions into the pharmacy operating system with both speed and accuracy. Communicates with customers on the telephone and responds quickly and courteously to their needs.


Attributes Required:

  • Work Ethic/Integrity – must possess intrinsic drive to excel coupled with values in line with company philosophy
  • Strategy and Planning – ability to think ahead, plan and manage time efficiently
  • Problem Solving – ability to analyze causes and solve problems at both a strategic and functional level
  • Team Oriented – ability to work effectively and collaboratively with all team members

Essential Job Functions (include the following):

  • Enter new and refill prescriptions into operating system in accurate and timely manner to eliminate errors at dispensing
  • Triage incoming fax prescriptions to ensure timely dispensing
  • Ensure proper notes in computer and cycle fill coding
  • Calculate and/or verify the correct dosage based on the prescription
  • Demonstrate caring, understanding and courtesy when responding to calls from customers. Route calls as appropriate to ensure top level service
  • Ensure all prescriptions assigned for processing are completed in regular shift
  • Receive, evaluate, process and follow-up as needed with doctors’ offices on all refills assigned
  • Develop proficiency in the utilization of all pharmacy systems (ie document imaging, legacy pharmacy computer operating system)
  • On an as needed, may assist with filing of completed orders, packaging of medications, inventory, profiling of orders for medical records, and filling processed prescriptions to dispense to the patient
  • Develop and learn cycle in order to meet delivery deadlines. Maintain data entry records for cycle medication, fill requests and process cycle medication orders needing renewal in addition to new cycle orders as applicable
  • Other essential functions and duties may be assigned as needed

Education and/or Certifications

  • High School Diploma or GED (per state requirements)
  • Pharmacy Technician license/certification/registration (per state requirements); National Certification preferred (PTCB)

Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of related experience (advanced degree may substitute for experience)
  • Advanced computer skills; pharmacy operations system experience preferred
  • Ability to work independently and deliver to deadlines
  • Ability to solve problems with minimal direction
  • Great attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment working on multiple tasks simultaneously, while adhering to strict deadlines
  • Quality minded; motivated to seek out errors and inquire when something appears inaccurate

Work Environment:

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holiday and overtime.

What We Offer:

Guardian provides employees with a comprehensive Total Rewards package, supporting our core value of, “Treat others as you would like to be treated.”

Compensation & Financial

  • Competitive pay
  • 401(k) with company match

Family, Health & Insurance Benefits (Full-Time employees working 30+ hours/week only)

  • Medical, Dental and Vision
  • Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Company-paid Basic Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment
  • Company-paid Long-Term Disability and optional Short-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Employee and Dependent Life, Accident and Critical Illness
  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

Wellbeing

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Guardian Angels (Employee assistance fund)

Time Off

  • Paid holidays and sick days
  • Generous vacation benefits based on years of service

The Guardian Difference

Our clients require pharmacy services that aren’t “cookie cutter.” That’s why every Guardian pharmacy is locally operated and empowered with the autonomy to tailor their business to meet their clients’ needs.

Our corporate support offices, based in Atlanta, Ga., provide services such as human resources, business intelligence, legal, and marketing to promote the success of each Guardian location.

Regardless of your role at Guardian, your voice and talents matter. Because healthcare is an ever-changing industry, we encourage innovative thinking, intellectual curiosity, and diverse viewpoints to ensure we stay competitive in today’s dynamic business environment.

At Guardian, we are dedicated to fostering and advancing a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Join us to discover what your best work truly looks like.

title: Project Manager - Cybersecurity/Pentesting
description:
About Coalfire
Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies all across the world navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S., Argentina, and the U.K.
But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will be responsible for end-to-end project life cycle management. This role will work directly with the DivisionHex teams to support the multiple frameworks and teams across Coalfire to successfully deliver projects within the defined scope, on time, and on budget. The Senior Project Manager works with all stakeholders in building and growing client relationships and handling escalated issues appropriately.

What You’ll Do

  • Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment for multiple initiatives simultaneously

  • Serves as the main point of contact for the customer and the Coalfire team throughout the project

  • Prepare project plans for all phases of the project or program with appropriate level of detail

  • Work with Resource Deployment Managers to secure resources to achieve project objectives in planned timeframe

  • Demonstrates ability to manage a high-volume portfolio while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and moving work forward efficiently

  • Skilled at keeping pace with large accounts involving multiple moving parts

  • Closely work with engagement lead to manage the day-to-day activities and resources on project engagements

  • Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership

  • Understand interdependencies between technology, operations, and business needs

  • Responsible for project scope, budget, timelines, communication, and change management

  • Set and continually manage project expectations and risks while delegating and managing deliverable with project team members and stakeholders

  • Monitor, track and control issues, conflicts, dependencies, and critical path deliverables. Escalates issues when necessary and follows escalation through to resolution

  • Develop and deliver progress reports, requirements documentation and presentations to various audiences, including project team, sponsors, and key stakeholders

  • Work with a team of matrixed employees to deliver a succinct customer experience

  • Ensure that projects and programs are proceeding according to established quality standards

  • Understand project management principles, methods, and techniques

  • Effectively applies Coalfire methodology and enforces project standards. Provides feedback on process changes and improvements

  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • Maintains company defined billable utilization targets

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum of 5 years of project management experience

  • Minimum of 3 years experience working in a client facing, consulting environment

  • Minimum of 3 years experience managing cybersecurity and/or penetration testing engagements

  • Bachelor's Degree or associate degree plus equivalent experience in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field of study

  • Ability to provide full time support DivisionHex teams globally

  • Experience with Smartsheets or Microsoft Project

  • Able to structure and lead cross-functional teams and stakeholders through the full life cycle of projects

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management methodology: including waterfall and agile methodologies

  • Proven success managing several projects simultaneously

  • Experience creating, adapting, or updating project management governance and processes for a centralized PMO

  • Demonstrated project ownership and consistent delivery on commitments

Why You’ll Want to Join Us
At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office.
Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.
At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our Human Resources team at HumanResourcesMB@coalfire.com.

title: Grievance and Appeals Specialist
description:
As the Grievance and Appeals Specialist, you will be responsible for independently resolving member and provider grievances and appeals within applicable state Medicaid, federal, contractual, and accreditation timeframes. You will work directly with members, providers, and authorized representatives and collaborate with Utilization Management, Claims, Member Services, Provider Relations, Pharmacy, Quality, and Compliance to achieve fair, accurate, and well-documented outcomes. You will manage moderately complex cases, support process improvement, and develop procedures and training materials.

The Illinois Tailored Care Management Program helps individuals with complex health and social needs transition from nursing facilities and Specialized Mental Health Rehabilitation Facilities (SMHRFs) to community-based living. Through person-centered care management and coordinated support services, the program empowers members to live more independently and thrive in their communities.

What You'll Do:

  • Serves as the primary point of contact for members, providers, and authorized representatives throughout the grievance or appeal process
  • Conducts outbound calls to explain the process, gather facts, request records, and clarify the issue under review
  • Communicates decisions verbally and in writing using clear, plain language that meets applicable readability and translation requirements
  • Handles escalated and sensitive contacts, including expedited appeals, executive or regulatory complaints, and Ombudsman inquiries, with professionalism and empathy
  • Represents Telligen at State Fair Hearings as assigned, including preparation of case summaries and evidence packets
  • Intakes, classifies, triages, investigates, and resolves grievances, appeals, and provider disputes
  • Identifies expedited and clinical cases for appropriate routing
  • Researches claims, authorizations, eligibility, benefit coverage, and contract language

title: Creative Director, Interactive Experiences
description:
Gigantic Playground, a CourtAvenue company, is a fast-growing creative technology agency that creates immersive and interactive experiences that connect people, places, and products in extraordinary ways. Our unique experience + technology approach blends creativity, immersive storytelling, and product innovation to create dynamic experiences that captivate, engage, and delight.

We're a purposely uncommon team, equal parts experience designers, creative technologists, and storytellers, with a mission to reimagine how people live, work, shop, and play.

Interactive work only earns its keep when someone actually stops, engages, and remembers it. That's the standard we hold ourselves to, and it's what this role exists to protect. As Creative Director, Interactive Experiences, you'll be the creative owner of everything we build that people touch, tap, walk into, or play with, from event installations to product launch apps to connected retail moments.

You're equally comfortable pitching the big idea in a client boardroom and sitting with a design team debugging why an interaction feels one beat too slow. We're looking for someone who can hold both altitudes at once: setting a creative bar for the whole studio while staying hands-on enough to shape the details that make an experience feel effortless. Your toolkit spans spatial storytelling, sensory and environmental design, and interactive technology, and you know how to weave all three into experiences that hold up whether someone spends five seconds or five minutes with them.

This is a leadership role with real creative stakes. You'll guide a team of designers and technologists, sit at the table with client leadership, and help define what "interactive" means for our studio as the tools and platforms we design for (AR, VR, connected hardware, generative AI, and whatever comes after) keep shifting.

Responsibilities

Shape the Creative Vision

  • Define the point of view behind each interactive project, turning a client brief or a piece of new technology into an experience concept worth building
  • Stay involved through production, not just at kickoff, so the finished experience still reflects the ambition of the original idea
  • Set and protect a consistently high bar for design, motion, and interaction quality across every project the studio ships

Lead People and Client Relationships

  • Manage and develop a team of designers, creative technologists, and producers, giving them clear creative direction and room to do strong work
  • Serve as the primary creative contact for client teams, balancing their business goals against what will actually make for a compelling experience
  • Pitch new ideas and present finished work in a way that builds client confidence in the studio's judgment, not just its execution

Push the Work Forward

  • Keep a close eye on new interactive formats, hardware, and platforms, and bring recommendations to clients before they ask for them
  • Introduce AI-assisted tools into the team's workflow where they genuinely help, whether that's early concepting, rapid prototyping, or content production
  • Help junior and mid-level creatives grow by pairing critique with real mentorship, not just notes on a deck

Own the Details That Make It Real

  • Oversee spatial and environmental design decisions alongside interactive content, so a physical installation and its digital layer feel like one idea rather than two
  • Work with production, fabrication, and technology partners to keep ambitious concepts grounded in what can actually be built, staffed, and maintained on-site
  • Stay current on trends in interactive art, entertainment design, and consumer technology, and bring that thinking back into the studio's own work

Requirements

  • 10+ years or more in a creative role focused on interactive, digital, or experience design, including several years directly managing a team

  • Strong personal taste backed by a portfolio that shows range across interaction design, visual design, and concept development

  • Direct experience partnering with enterprise or consumer technology clients, and comfort navigating the layers of stakeholders that come with that kind of account

  • Willingness to get into the tools yourself. This isn't a role where you only review other people's Figma files

  • A working understanding of what's actually possible on today's hardware and software, so your ideas are ambitious but buildable

  • Real, current experience using AI tools as part of your own creative process, not just an interest in the idea of them

  • Comfort working across the full arc of a project, from early concept sketches through rapid prototyping to a finished, fabricated, on-site experience

  • Familiarity with the broader interactive and immersive landscape (AR, VR, projection, sensor-driven installations) even if your day-to-day tools are mostly digital

Preferred Qualifications

  • A portfolio piece that clearly moved the needle on how long people engaged with an experience

  • Recognition from peers or industry press for work you led

  • Clients who ask for you by name when something new and difficult comes up

  • Background in large-scale experiential production

title: IT Administrator
description:
Job Description

As our IT Administrator, you'll work closely with our Head of IT to build, run and continuously improve the technology that keeps Cellular Origins connected, secure and moving forward.

You'll be hands-on across everything from Microsoft 365 and cloud infrastructure to business applications and workplace technology. Rather than inheriting an established environment and simply keeping it running, you'll help create one that can grow with us.

With a small IT team supporting a business doing extraordinary things, your ideas will be heard, your technical judgement will matter, and you'll have genuine ownership of the solutions you deliver.

What You’ll Do

You'll get to work across a broad range of technologies, solving real problems and helping us build an IT environment that's secure, dependable and easy for people to use.

Some of the things you'll get involved in include:

  • Building our independent IT environment: Help deliver our Microsoft 365 tenant migration and manage Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, Entra ID and Intune.
  • Making technology work for our people: Build and deploy Windows 11 devices using Autopilot, imaging and scripted provisioning, making it easier for colleagues to get up and running.
  • Shaping our new workplace: Help establish and maintain the network, wireless connectivity and workplace technology in our new Melbourn office.
  • Improving the systems we rely on: Support and develop business applications including NetSuite, our SharePoint intranet and internal Power Platform tools.
  • Making IT secure and sustainable: Put clear documentation, practical controls and repeatable processes in place so the systems you build are easy to support and maintain.
  • Finding better ways of working: Use automation to reduce repetitive tasks, explore new technologies and work with suppliers to make sure we're getting the best from our IT investments.

You'll also help us build the right foundations for a business working with customers in the life sciences industry, where security, reliability and well-documented processes really matter.

About You

You'll thrive in this role if you're someone who enjoys getting stuck into technical challenges, takes pride in doing things properly and likes having the freedom to find the best solution.

You're equally comfortable troubleshooting an issue for a colleague as you are planning a migration or improving how a system is managed. You'll enjoy working in a growing company where not everything has been defined yet, and where you can make a real difference by bringing structure, clarity and your own ideas.

You'll bring:

  • Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 in a live business environment, particularly Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and Entra ID.
  • Experience managing Windows devices using Intune, including Windows deployment and provisioning.
  • A good understanding of enterprise networking, including VLANs, DHCP, DNS and wireless networks.
  • Practical PowerShell skills to automate tasks, produce reports and make everyday IT work more efficiently.
  • The ability to write clear, useful documentation and explain technical decisions to people who aren't IT specialists.
  • Confidence working independently, setting priorities and seeing problems through from start to finish.

It would also be great if you've worked with Fortinet networking products, Azure administration, tenant migrations or Power Platform applications such as Power Apps and Power Automate.

Experience managing software licences and suppliers, using AI tools to improve business workflows, or relevant Microsoft 365 or Fortinet certifications would be welcome too

Cellular Origins is based at Melbourn Science Park, just 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our newly renovated premises offer modern office, laboratory and engineering spaces, surrounded by green spaces. We foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture, where ideas are encouraged, innovation thrives, and everyone has the freedom to do their best work.

Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications.

About the Job

What You’ll Get To Do

Perception-Aware Mission Autonomy: Couple runtime perception outputs (e.g. semantic 3D scene understanding) with world information, to create a unified semantic scene graph that enables perception-aware real-time mission planning and execution with spatial reasoning, feasibility validation, online task replanning, and natural language driven robotic autonomy.

VLM-Based Long-Horizon Reasoning: Design and implement a VLM-based mission controller that observes the robot's camera view and scene graph, reasons about mission progress, and selects actions from reusable primitives and tools, with step verification, failure detection and recovery, online replanning, and feedback handling for natural language driven long-horizon missions.

Multi-Robot Mission Autonomy: Support the development of a multi-robot mission autonomy framework for task allocation, execution monitoring, and coordination across heterogeneous robots, and expand the robotics testing framework through unit and integration tests to ensure system reliability, safety, and performance.

What You Have

  • PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

  • Advanced proficiency in Python programming, C++, ROS/ROS 2, Linux, Git, Docker

  • 5+ years experience with AI-driven autonomy software deployed on real robots (e.g. task and motion planning, VLM/LLM-based planners, state machines, behavior trees) and low-level robotic manipulation skills

  • Ability to effectively and efficiently communicate with all teams, and to lead technical efforts across them

  • Strong problem-solving skills and proven ability to navigate complex software systems

  • Strong work ethic, highly self-motivated, and able to work independently while managing multiple priorities

The Extras That Set You Apart

  • Experience with simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo, Isaac Sim)

  • Experience with heterogeneous multi-robot systems (UGV, UAV, mobile manipulator)

  • Experience with LLM/VLM-based long-horizon planning and failure recovery in robotic systems

Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Membership Manager - AETHOS Lisbon
description:
Join the Aethos Community – Hospitality with Purpose.

At Aethos, we believe in extraordinary places, passionate people, and meaningful connections. Hospitality should inspire and elevate — leaving a lasting impact on mind, body, and soul. That is why we carefully choose our locations and build teams looking for more than just a job — teams that thrive in a true community.

Aethos focuses on sustainability, well-being, and the luxury of time and space. We create retreats from the everyday, offering a sanctuary from the stress of modern life. Our goal? To redefine hospitality — building a place where both guests, members, and team members feel at home, inspired, and connected.

About Aethos Lisbon

Opening in June 2027, Aethos Lisbon will bring our conscious luxury philosophy to the heart of Portugal’s vibrant capital. Blending cultural heritage with modern design, the property will feature an exclusive private members’ club, bespoke wellness and dining spaces, and a thoughtfully curated environment designed to serve as an urban sanctuary for creators, innovators, and mindful travellers.

Join us!

We are looking for an engaging and detail-oriented Membership Manager (m/f) to nurture and grow the community at Aethos Lisbon. Reporting directly to the Membership Director, the role owns the full membership lifecycle and ensures every member feels known and valued from the moment they apply. On the acquisition side, you will manage applications, host property tours, and assess candidates to keep the community balanced. On the retention side, you will build lasting relationships, monitor engagement and renewals, and work closely with events, operations, and marketing to deliver a warm, seamless experience.

Role Description

  • Community Outreach: Support outreach before and after the June 2027 opening of Aethos Lisbon, engaging with the city’s social scene to help identify and attract the founding membership and keep the community growing.
  • Lifecycle Management: Manage the day-to-day membership lifecycle, from first enquiry and application through to onboarding, renewal, and long-term loyalty.
  • Application & Tours: Run the application process, hosting property tours and introductory meetings, and assessing candidates in line with the guidelines set by the Membership Director.
  • Targets & Pipeline: Work towards agreed targets for new members, keeping the pipeline up to date and reporting progress to the Membership Director.
  • Brand Representation: Represent Aethos in Lisbon’s social scene, attending events, launches, and gatherings to build contacts and introduce new people to the community.
  • Member Introductions: Carry out new member introductions, ensuring members understand the benefits, house rules, and opportunities, and know how to reach you.
  • Member Relations: Build personal relationships with members, getting to know them and their interests so each feels known and valued.
  • Engagement & Retention: Monitor member engagement and renewals, flag early signs of disengagement, and step in or escalate when a member’s experience falls short.
  • Insight & Feedback: Gather feedback on events, service levels, and facilities, and share it with the Membership Director and the wider team so it turns into improvements.
  • Database & CRM: Keep the membership database accurate and up to date, tracking applications, renewals, and member activity.
  • Event Integration: Support the events team with guest lists for major on-site and off-site events, ensuring members and VIPs receive the right access and a warm welcome.
  • Content Collaboration: Share member stories and content with the marketing team, so they can be brought to life across our channels.
  • Cross-Department Teamwork: Work closely with the events, marketing, operations, and hospitality teams to deliver a consistently high-quality experience for members and guests.
  • Floor Presence: Maintain a visible presence in the property as a welcoming face for members.

Candidate Profile

  • Experience: Proven background in membership coordination/management, high-touch guest relations, or front-of-house VIP services within private members' clubs, luxury lifestyle hospitality, or cultural venues.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Warm, discreet, and organised, with natural conversational ease and the ability to build meaningful, personal relationships.
  • Operational Strengths: Strong organisational skills with experience managing membership databases, tracking CRM pipelines, and handling event guest list logistics.
  • Network & Alignment: Active interest in and familiarity with Lisbon’s social, cultural, and creative scenes, alongside genuine alignment with Aethos’ focus on well-being and mindful community.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is essential; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Work Style: Proactive, attentive to detail, and confident operating both on the club floor and across structured daily administrative duties.

What We Offer

  • Stability: Full-time employment contract.
  • Remuneration: Competitive salary package commensurate with the role and experience.
  • Environment: Integration into the founding pre-opening team of a flagship property within a growing international boutique brand.
  • Development: Opportunities for continuous learning, skill expansion, and career progression across the Aethos Group.
Ready to be the welcoming face of Lisbon’s newest community? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to hr.portugal@aethos.com and dive into your next adventure!

title: Shipping and Receiving Coordinator III
description:
About ANA:

Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, MAC3 Pneumatic Air tools, and ANA’s exclusive Energy Boss ™ - Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment.

ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada with locations in Cypress, California and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling and we are seeking a Shipping and Receiving Coordinator III to join our growing team in an onsite position in Spartanburg, SC. As a Shipping and Receiving Coordinator III, you will have the opportunity to complete all picking, shipping and receiving functions in and out of the ERP and WMS system. This includes but is not limited to transfer order and sales order completion for all types of part numbers, tools and accessories, as well as purchase order receiving and put-away for all types of part numbers, tools and accessories.

The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 7:00 AM-3:45 PM with overtime as needed in a non-climate controlled environment.

This role reports to the Inventory Control Supervisor.

Shipping Role & Responsibilities:

  • Shipping outbound transfer orders and sales orders for components, all serialized inventory and accessories.
  • Scheduling outbound LTL shipments for your designated WHS (this includes but is not limited to BOL entry, density calculation and correct NMFC code entry)
  • Communicating with operations when needed.
  • Manually picking, packing, and shipping orders in the ERP for component, serialized tools and accessories shipments going outbound.
  • Providing pertinent information to the sales department and other stakeholders
  • Reporting discrepancies to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Ensuring the completion of all KPI reporting related to outbound transactions
  • Ensuring the successful completion of all outbound related inventory movement.
  • Supporting inventory control where applicable.
  • Perform other related shipping duties as assigned.

Receiving Role & Responsibilities:

  • Receiving inbound warehouse deliveries for all components, serialized inventory and accessories.
  • Communicating with operations and inventory when needed.
  • Manually checking in and receiving orders into the ERP for shipments received at the ANA warehouse.
  • Providing labeling information to receiving and reporting discrepancies to the inventory and operations team.
  • Ensuring the reconciliation of all inventory invoice issues
  • Ensuring the successful put away of all inbound inventory.
  • Ensuring the successful completion of all cycle counts for MAC3 tools and parts
  • Providing systematic support to accounting through accurate follow up and system reconciliation related to receipt.
  • Manually verifying day to day inbound transactions for accuracies and discrepancies
  • Supporting shipping where applicable.
  • Supporting kit completion where necessary
  • Oversee and execute complex shipping and receiving operations, ensuring inbound and outbound inventory is processed efficiently and accurately.
  • Coordinate logistics activities, including scheduling shipments, liaising with carriers, and troubleshooting delivery issues to minimize delays and errors.
  • Collaborate closely with the supervisor to help set and uphold site-wide shipping and receiving standards, leading inventory control initiatives, monitoring cycle counts, audits, and reconciliation, and driving process improvements to ensure optimal accuracy and operational excellence.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in shipping platforms, ERP systems, and documentation standards, providing training and support to team members.
  • Maintain compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies, preparing reports for management and facilitating resolution of advanced discrepancies.
  • Perform other related receiving duties as assigned.

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • 3–5 years of experience in shipping, receiving, or warehouse operations

  • Forklift experience required; certification preferred

  • Experience using ERP systems is required; Business Central experience is a plus

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve discrepancies

  • Effective communication skills with cross-functional teams (e.g., sales, accounting, operations)

  • Willingness to assist with training and mentoring junior team members

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work on your feet for extended periods

ANA’s Core Values:

  • Root Cause Problem Solving

  • Be Creative with Solutions

  • Build open and honest relationships

  • Build a positive team and family spirit

  • Be inclusive

  • Look for better ways

  • Be humble

  • Urgency

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive pay

  • 401k with company contribution

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision

  • Life Insurance

  • Voluntary Accident Insurance

  • Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Employee Appreciation Programs

You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship. Please be advised that ANA does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

ANA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Software Engineer FTC
description:
This is a great opportunity to join the Fastmarkets Software Engineering Team to help continue grow our technology and build a highly skilled team that will enable us to accelerate our product delivery and scale our business. This team develop, enhance and support our flagship digital platform, serving global customers with critical price data, news and analytics in the commodities markets we serve. We make this data and intelligence easily accessible through multiple channels including web, desktop, API, Excel and mobile iOS and Android applications, enabling customers to integrate our digital offering into their business workflows.

The Principal Software Engineer is a full-time position working within a Scrum team reporting to the Engineering Manager. In this technical role working as part of a global a team of Software Engineers, Business Analysts and Product Managers to successfully develop and deliver new features. This

includes contributing to major projects that make a difference to Fastmarkets customers both in our existing markets such as metals, forest products and agricultural commodity sectors.

Our technical stack is largely Microsoft .NET and cloud infrastructure is Azure and we seek to use the latest relevant technologies in our work. It is engineered for scalability and fault-tolerance with rich web and mobile UIs.

In this hands-on development role, you will be a senior member of the development team reporting to an Engineering Manager. As a Principal Engineer you will also be expected to contribute to the strategic and technical direction within the team to which you aligned. You will be a highly productive developer who is passionate about writing clean, quality code, building high-scale distributed systems that are fault-tolerant, with deep operational insights. You will take an engineering approach to developing new services and systems, favouring metrics over personal opinion or bias. You will have good communication skills and be able to mentor and help grow more junior developers, coaching them on good design, coding and software engineering practices. This is an individual contributor role, where you will be providing technical leadership.

Principal Accountabilities

1. Responsible for guiding coding best practice

2. Deliver high quality, performant code to SOLID design principals

3. Provide mentorship and guidance for more junior engineers

4. Contribute to overall strategic technical direction

KEY INTERFACES

· Engineering Manager

· Software Engineering Team

· Cloud Engineering and SRE

· Enterprise Architect

· Product Owners / Product Management

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

Key Experience / Qualifications

  • Strong grasp of OOP, concurrency, distributed and cloud computing concepts
  • Strong experience with .NET /C#
  • Microsoft Azure (Service Fabric, Blob Storage, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
  • Databases including relational (SQL Server) and NoSQL (CosmosDB)
  • UI Frameworks – Angular, TypeScript or JavaScript
  • Experience with distributed programming protocols and infrastructure including: Web protocols – REST, WebSockets (SignalR), gRPC
  • Messaging and caching - Service Bus, Redis
  • Experience of unit testing, continuous integration/deployment and test automation
  • Use of AI tooling to enhance and accelerate software development
  • Strong communicator in English: able to read/write documentation effectively and have good verbal communication skills
  • Cloud computing – Ideally Azure.
  • Experience developing microservices
  • Ability to mentor and grow more junior developers

Personal Attributes

  • Deeply technical
  • Continuously looking for ways to improve (yourself, your team, the code the processes)
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to execute and deliver in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly collaborative and able to work across multiple teams and geographies
  • Results-driven, with a focus on long-term value creation

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Continuing Education and Professional Studies (CEPS) at SAIT offers a wide range of programs designed to support lifelong learning, career advancement (through reskilling and upskilling) and customized talent development solutions for corporations. Join a team passionate about building lifelong learning opportunities that help people in Calgary and around the globe navigate the changing world of work.

The Opportunity
Job classification: P5944 - Business Analyst
Salary range: $86,000 - $96,000 Placement within the range is typically based upon a review of skills, experience, and internal equity.
Hours per week: 37.5
Paid leave: 4 Weeks Vacation / 14 Flex Days per year
Position End Date: January 4, 2028
Deadline to apply: 4:00PM, Friday November 6, 2026
Reporting to the Business Solutions Architect, the Business Systems Analyst acts as a key liaison between business needs and technology solutions. This role combines application administration, solution development, process automation, business analysis, and data analysis to improve business processes and operational effectiveness across CEPS. The incumbent works closely with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define requirements, and deliver scalable solutions using Smartsheet, Python, SQL Server, REST APIs, Power Automate, SharePoint, and AI-enabled tools.

How you'll contribute

  • Administer and maintain existing CEPS Smartsheet solutions, providing ongoing configuration, troubleshooting, and user support.
  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain business applications, automations, integrations, and reporting solutions.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and modern development practices to improve solution design, automation, analytics, documentation, and problem solving.
  • Partner with stakeholders to analyze business needs, identify improvement opportunities, and translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Independently manage solution delivery from requirements gathering through design, development, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing support, with guidance as needed.
  • Analyze business processes, systems, and data to identify efficiencies, risks, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and maintain functional specifications, process documentation, workflows, procedures, and training materials.
  • Coordinate testing activities, including unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to support enhancements, integrations, issue resolution, and operational support.
  • Provide application support, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and user training.
  • Support project planning, prioritization, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What you bring

Education & Experience

  • Degree, diploma, certification, or equivalent experience in Business Analysis, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Development, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in business systems analysis, application administration, solution development, process improvement, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Experience implementing, integrating, testing, and supporting business applications and technology solutions.
  • Proven experience analyzing business processes and data to identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.
  • Experience leading or supporting systems integration, workflow automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration skills with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external vendors.
  • Experience working in a large, complex organization is considered an asset.
  • Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Proficiency with Python, SQL, REST APIs, Power Automate, and data analysis.
  • Knowledge of application development, systems integration, testing, implementation, and support practices.
  • Experience working within Agile environments and using Jira.
  • Advanced Smartsheet administration and solution development experience is considered an asset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Microsoft Visio, Excel, and Word.
  • Strong business analysis, requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong project planning, prioritization, and delivery skills.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving
  • Independence & Accountability
  • Judgment & Decision-Making
  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation
  • Communication, Influence & Relationship Building
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Customer Service Orientation
We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest in this opportunity. We understand how important communication is, and we are committed to following up with every candidate. Please know that each application is thoughtfully reviewed, and you will hear from us either way.
Together, we build bold futures
At SAIT, we equip you with the resources you need to shape bold futures for yourself and our communities. We offer a comprehensive package including:
- Generous time off to pursue other passions and support your wellbeing
- SAIT paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision benefits so you, and your family, are well supported
- Benefits supporting mental health and access to Greenshield + for virtual therapy at a reduced rate
- Access to a Health Spending or Taxable Spending Account
- Professional development opportunities through our Free Seat Program, tuition support, access to LinkedIn Learning and discounted Continuing Education & Professional Studies courses
- Defined Benefit pension through LAPP to help you retire with confidence
- Excellent dining options on campus
- Free access to our fitness facilities and group fitness classes
And the perks keep on coming!

About SAIT

At SAIT, we’re building bold futures. We’re a community of tenacious problem-solvers, inventive thinkers, and passionate collaborators who believe in doing work that matters.

Named one of Alberta’s Top Employers, we’re driven by a desire to create an impact in our community. If you’re looking for a place where purpose meets possibility, you’ve found it here.

We’re committed to community and belonging

Community and belonging is essential to achieving SAIT's vision to be a global leader in applied education. We encourage applications from women, Indigenous people, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities. title: Teamleider KYC
description:
Als teamleider ben je hiërarchisch en functioneel leidinggevende van de junior en medior analisten, zowel op het gebied van KYC (Know Your Client) als COI (Conflict of Interest). Zo zorg je dat het analistenteam cliëntenonderzoeken tijdig, volledig en in één keer goed uitvoert, conform het acceptatie- en continuatiebeleid, de Wwft/AMLR, de Sanctiewet en de AVG. Daarnaast houdt je overzicht op het COI team en de verwerking van onder meer internationale COI verzoeken conform de independence wet- en regelgeving. Ook ben je in deze rol betrokken bij de implementatie en verankering van een nieuw internationaal conflictcheck-systeem en lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan procesoptimalisatie en kwaliteitsverbetering.

Je initieert daarnaast verbeterprojecten op het gebied van processen, systemen en vaktechnische ontwikkeling om onze kwaliteitsstandaard continu te blijven versterken. Met jouw overzicht en daadkracht stuur je op prioriteiten, doorlooptijden, backlog en screeningsalerts, zodat klantteams kunnen rekenen op betrouwbare en tijdige ondersteuning.

In deze rol ben je niet alleen bezig met de dagelijkse operatie, maar ook met het verder ontwikkelen van je team en het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Je coacht collega’s, begeleidt nieuwe medewerkers en vertaalt veranderingen in wet- en regelgeving, processen en tooling naar duidelijke afspraken op de werkvloer en ziet er samen met het team op toe dat deze afspraken worden nagekomen. Samen met de Director SCCO, senior analisten en Quality Checkers bouw je daarmee aan een professioneel service center waarin kwaliteit, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan.

Midden in Strijp-S vind je veel cultuur, innovatie én ons Eindhovense kantoor. Hiervandaan werken circa 250 professionals. Zij omschrijven zichzelf als creatief, rustig en sportief. Over sportief gesproken: tijdens de jaarlijkse marathon van Eindhoven is er een eigen BDO-fanzone om de sporters aan te moedigen.

Hiermee voeg jij waarde toe

Wij kijken eerst naar wie je bent. Wat jij kan. Hoe je jouw leidinggevende en coördinerende vaardigheden succesvol inzet als Teamleider KYC. Daarna kijken we of je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding, bij voorkeur in juridische, economische of bedrijfskundige richting;
  • Diepgaande kennis van WWFT, AML, sanctiewetgeving en complexe dossier ervaring;
  • 3 tot 5 jaar leidinggevende ervaring binnen KYC, CDD of client onboarding;
  • Ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van junior en medior analisten;
  • Ervaring met KYC-/screeningtooling, CRM- of workflowsystemen en datagedreven sturen;
  • Ervaring op het gebied van onafhankelijkheidsvraagstukken en kennis van de Verordening inzake de onafhankelijkheid van accountants bij assurance-opdrachten (ViO);
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en goede beheersing van het Engels.

Echte waarde is meer dan geld

Bij BDO kan je rekenen op een salaris dat past bij wat je doet én wat je kunt. Tel hierbij op:

  • volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wil je extern een deeltijdstudie volgen of meld jij je aan voor de BDO Academie, Goodhabitz of een van de summerschools?
  • een pensioenpremieregeling bij Nationale Nederlanden waar je 2% aan bijdraagt. Ook ben jij verzekerd voor een nabestaandenpensioen.
  • 22 vakantiedagen + 10 flexdagen per kalenderjaar. Wil je nog meer vrije tijd? In overleg kun je extra flexdagen kopen.
  • tot € 25,00 netto vergoeding per maand voor de kosten van jouw sportschool.

Dit zijn nog maar de eerste 4 punten. Voor een compleet overzicht van de arbeidsvoorwaarden ga naar .

Kom werken bij BDO en ga voor echte waarde

Reageren op deze vacature? Natuurlijk.

Heb jij eerst nog vragen? Tim van Laak geeft je antwoord via tim.van.laak@bdo.nl.

title: Internship Programme, Forensics - London (July 2027)
description:
Why S&W?

At S&W, we believe a great early career experience is about more than just the work you do. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that help shape your future. Whether that's developing new skills, growing your confidence or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that supports you to be yourself and succeed.

During your internship, you'll contribute to meaningful work, learn from experienced professionals and gain first-hand insight into life in professional services.

As one of the UK's fastest-growing accountancy and advisory firms, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. Your internship is a chance to experience life at S&W first-hand, get to know our people and culture, and explore what a future career with us could look like.

We see our interns as future talent, which is why many go on to secure a place on one of our Graduate programmes after completing their degree.

No previous experience in accountancy, finance or professional services is required. We're looking for people who are curious, motivated and eager to learn. What matters most is your attitude, potential and willingness to get involved.

The Forensics team at S&W

Our Forensics team combines specialist expertise with extensive experience of working alongside the legal profession. We support both corporate and private clients on a wide range of complex and high-profile matters, with our partners recognised as leaders in their fields and experienced Expert Witnesses.

We provide forensic accounting and forensic technology services across a broad range of areas, including dispute resolution, fraud and bribery investigations, private client disputes, personal injury claims, and Competition and Monitoring Trustee services, both in the UK and internationally. This means you'll gain insight into how financial and technological expertise can be applied to solve real-world business and legal challenges.

What will you be doing?

As a Forensics Intern, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals and gain exposure to a variety of forensic assignments. You'll develop your analytical skills, learn about the different services we offer, and gain valuable insight into a specialist area of professional services.

Over the course of the internship, you'll gain valuable insight into life at S&W, develop professional skills, expand your network and build a deeper understanding of the opportunities available in Audit & Assurance.

You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from support from colleagues across the business, giving you the opportunity to learn from people at different stages of their careers and build connections that last beyond the programme.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing an understanding of the different services offered within the Forensic Services team
  • Assisting with the analysis of financial documents, including financial statements, bank statements, and other sources of information
  • Conducting research and using available data sources to support forensic investigations and analysis

description:
Join an energetic, patient-focused team! MedStar Radiology Network is currently seeking an experienced CT Technologist for a Full-Time position at our outpatient imaging center in Chevy Chase, Maryland.


Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:30 AM–6:00 PM.


If you are passionate about providing excellent patient care and are looking to join a supportive, collaborative team, we would love to hear from you!


What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay
  • Paid Time Off & Holiday Pay
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage with a Flexible
  • Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) with Company Match and Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Short-term & Long-term Disability and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


JOB SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the Radiology Medical Director, the CT technologist:

  • Performs computed tomography procedures and related techniques, producing sectional & 3-dimensional images at the request of and for interpretation by a licensed independent practitioner.
  • Ensures services are performed in a safe environment in accordance with established guidelines and regulatory requirements.
  • Serves as part of the imaging center team and seeks as well as provides feedback for improved clinical practice.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Receives, relays, and documents verbal, written, and electronic orders in the patient's medical record.
  • Corroborates patient's clinical history with physicians' order and procedure, ensuring information is documented and available for use by a licensed independent practitioner. May also verify informed consent, if applicable.
  • Assumes responsibility for patient needs during procedures.
  • Identifies, prepares, positions patient, and competently performs procedure by using established CT protocols or as prescribed by a licensed independent practitioner for diagnostic interpretation or intervention, to achieve the highest quality image.
  • Applies principles of ALARA to minimize exposure to patient, self, and others.
  • Performs venipuncture and maintains intravenous access as prescribed by a licensed independent practitioner.
  • Identifies, prepares, and/or administers medications as prescribed by and under the direction of a licensed independent practitioner in accordance with state and federal regulations.
  • Evaluates images for technical quality, ensuring proper identification is recorded.
  • Provides education to patients, as well as students and other health care providers.
  • Performs ongoing quality assurance activities.
  • Conducts POC Creatinine clearance testing in accordance with established CT protocols or as prescribed by a licensed independent practitioner for diagnostic interpretation.
  • Following the direction of a licensed independent practitioner, assists with interventional computed tomography procedures and applies appropriate aseptic surgical technique as needed.
  • Selects appropriate CT technical exam factors with consideration given to established protocols and other factors influencing data acquisition parameters.
  • As required, instructs students and residents and performs preceptor duties as necessary.
  • Establishes ownership of clinical area by taking pride in appearance and readiness of exam rooms, equipment, and supplies.
  • Participates in performance improvement activities.
  • Manipulates and reconstructs digital data for display or hard copy records, ensuring proper identification is evident.
  • Maintains archival storage of digital data as appropriate.
  • Assists in maintaining supply inventory.
  • Takes the initiative to help other modalities/areas of the Imaging Center as assigned or when workload/area allows.
  • Demonstrates consistent use of AIDET (Acknowledge patient, introduce yourself, provide Duration/timeline for test, Explain the test & thank them for choosing the center) and HEAL (Hear them out, Empathize, Apologize, & Leap into action to solve) when interacting with patients/customers.
  • Attends/participates in staff meetings, in-services, and center-wide meetings as scheduled.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

title: Scientist II, Fermentation Process Development – Recombinant Peptides
description:
AbbVie’s Biologics CMC organization develops processes to support the advancement and manufacture of biologic medicines. AbbVie is seeking a motivated fermentation scientist to contribute to the development of microbial processes for recombinant peptide production. The successful candidate will perform hands-on fermentation studies and help develop, optimize, and scale upstream processes for therapeutic peptides. This role will collaborate with colleagues in strain development, downstream processing, analytical development, and other functions to generate reliable data and support project goals.

Responsibilities

  • Independently design, execute, and interpret critical fermentation experiments to answer scientific questions and advance project goals.
  • Develop and optimize microbial cultivation and fermentation processes, including work with hosts such as Escherichia coli and yeast.
  • Evaluate the effects of media composition, inoculum conditions, feed strategies, induction conditions, temperature, pH, agitation, aeration, and dissolved oxygen on growth and product expression.
  • Operate, maintain, and optimize bench-scale bioreactors and support microscale, parallel, and scale-down fermentation studies.
  • Apply broad technical proficiency to troubleshoot experiments, instrumentation, and routine process issues; adapt or innovate protocols and techniques as project needs evolve.
  • Collaborate with strain-development colleagues to screen and characterize microbial clones and expression systems.
  • Analyze fermentation data—including growth, substrate use, process parameters, product titer, and yield—and place findings in the relevant scientific context.
  • Troubleshoot experiments and instrumentation, adapting or developing methods to meet changing project needs.
  • Collaborate with strain-development, downstream-processing, and analytical teams to assess expression, peptide recovery, and product quality.
  • Consult relevant scientific literature and use it to inform experimental design, interpret findings, and solve technical problems.
  • Set and meet experimental timelines, communicate plans and results, contribute to technical documentation, and improve laboratory methods and operations.
  • Follow applicable corporate standards for conduct, safety, material handling, and GxP compliance, as relevant to the work.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience or Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with 7+ years of relevant experience, is required.

  • Theoretical and practical knowledge of microbial cultivation and fermentation, preferably using E. coli and/or yeast.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, and interpret critical experiments to answer scientific questions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, adapt, and optimize experimental methods and techniques in response to project needs.
  • Experience operating bioreactors and applying fermentation parameters such as pH, temperature, agitation, aeration, and dissolved oxygen.
  • Ability to troubleshoot experiments and instrumentation, recognize significant deviations, and determine appropriate follow-up work.
  • Strong scientific writing, verbal communication, data interpretation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to consult and apply relevant scientific literature and to communicate findings in the context of project objectives.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet timelines, and work effectively with cross-functional collaborators.
