If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

Position responsible for coordinating and maintaining specialized advanced technical skills, monitoring patients ECG rhythms, interpreting results, and communicating effectively with the healthcare team as determined by department procedure.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Completion of a Telemetry Monitoring Technician education program or one (1) year of related experience required.

Licenses/Certifications: (None)


Experience/ Knowledge/ Skills:

Principal Accountabilites

  • Provides precise continual surveillance and analysis of cardiac rhythms on electrocardiographic central monitoring station, documenting per established procedure; interprets ECG rhythms, recognizes significant ECG events.
  • Escalates significant or life-threatening changes immediately, utilizing appropriate ECG algorithm, to a Registered Nurse, as appropriate; communicates information in a clear, concise and accurate manner to the responsible individual within established timeframe.

title: Senior Battery Engineering Technician
description:
Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market.
Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026.
Mobility is one of the most highly-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Battery Engineering Technician to join our battery team in a fast-paced eVTOL startup environment. You will work closely with battery engineers to build, test, and characterize battery modules and packs — from prototype builds through validation. This role requires strong attention to detail, a safety-first mindset, and the ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Design, assemble, and validate battery prototypes at module and pack level — supporting engineering and validation programs.
  • Build and execute test setups for electrical, thermal, and thermal runaway (TR) testing, including applying sensors and thermocouples to test articles.
  • Build test articles, fixtures, and jigs; rework parts and assemblies as needed.
  • Build systems enclosures and securing harnesses for test stands and test assets.
  • Operate and maintain lab equipment including ultrasonic/spot welders, power supplies, and pack cyclers (Arbin, BioLogic, Chroma, or similar).
  • Perform EOL testing using pack cyclers.
  • Execute verification using hi-pot testers, multimeters (DMM), continuity testers, oscilloscopes, and bench power supplies; interpret results and identify failure modes.
  • Document build processes, test data, travelers, and inspection results with strong attention to traceability.
  • Collaborate daily with Battery Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing to resolve issues, implement ECOs, and improve build/test methods.
  • Handle, package, label, and dispose of hazardous battery materials in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Discharge and dispose of batteries following safety procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized lab environment; support 5S/lean improvements at the bench level.
  • Participate in first-article builds, prototype iterations, and transition-to-production efforts.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in battery or high-voltage systems (modules or packs) in an engineering or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building battery prototypes at the module and/or pack level.
  • Proficient in standard electronics test equipment: multimeters, hi-pot testers, resistance meters, oscilloscopes, and AC/DC power supplies.
  • Experience with battery test/data monitoring equipment (Arbin, BioLogic, Chroma, or similar cyclers).
  • Hands-on experience building fixtures, procuring parts, and preparing samples for test.
  • Experience working safely with hazardous materials; formal safety training is a plus.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude with experience in precision assembly, fabrication, and use of hand and power tools.
  • Experience with PCB assembly and soldering.
  • Experience with additive and subtractive manufacturing (3D printing, CNC).
  • Strong ability to read and interpret work instructions, wiring diagrams, and basic schematics.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits and comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills; team-oriented attitude.
  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with thermal runaway testing, abuse testing, or post-burn cleanup (including working in Tyvek suits).
  • Experience with DO-160G, DO-311A, or UN 38.3 certification testing.
  • Familiarity with aerospace/regulated environments: ESD controls, traceability, controlled rework, configuration management.
  • Experience with high-voltage systems in automotive, aviation, or energy storage applications.
  • Ability to use machine shop equipment: mill, lathe, welding (laser, ultrasonic, spot).
  • Experience supporting prototype-to-production scaling and writing/improving work instructions.
  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 or IPC-A-610 certification (plus).
  • Associate’s or technical degree in engineering or related field (desired but not required).
  • Experience with data analysis tools; proficiency in Microsoft Office.

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Independently builds and tests battery assemblies to standards with minimal rework.
  • Executes electrical and thermal tests reliably, documents results, and flags trends early.
  • Partners with battery engineers to quickly triage failures and improve build/test methods.
  • Maintains a clean, safe lab environment and contributes at least one measurable improvement (time reduction, defect reduction, or test repeatability).
  • Demonstrates a mentality of continuous learning and willingness to acquire new skillsets.

Attributes aligned with Core Values

  • Safety Above All: Demonstrates a proactive safety mindset by embedding safety into daily work, identifying and mitigating risks, encouraging open dialogue about safety concerns, and continuously improving practices and protocols.
  • Customer Focus: Puts customers at the center of every action by understanding their challenges, delivering meaningful value, and supporting their success.
  • Work Better Together: Seeks and values diverse perspectives, builds cross-functional relationships, and fosters trust through empathetic, fact-based communication and commitment to shared decisions.
  • Be the Pilot: Drives results with clarity and purpose by focusing on what matters most, adapting to change, taking initiative, and owning outcomes.
  • Embrace the Unknown: Navigates ambiguity with resilience and bold thinking, challenges the status quo, and combines innovative ideas with practical approaches to overcome obstacles and drive progress.
  • Respect for People: Fosters a high-performance culture grounded in respect, professionalism, and support by balancing high expectations with a healthy, collaborative environment and being a trusted, dependable teammate.
Applicants must be eligible for employment in the United States and willing to work onsite at our HQ office in Palo Alto, CA.
Pivotal offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and 401k plans.
Pivotal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pivotal does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Optics Consultant
description:

Working within TTP's Advanced Surgical team, you'll apply expertise in optics, photonics and imaging systems to develop innovative medical devices, diagnostic platforms and surgical technologies from concept through commercialisation while working alongside world-class scientists and engineers.

title: PostDoc Fellow - NIH DARPA Chou Lab
description:
SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.



CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
Under the direction/guidance of a mentor (principal investigator), assumes responsibility for a specific, on-going research project. The experience will serve to extend, refine and enhance skills necessary for professional and career development, and will enable the individual to broaden his/her scientific background by acquiring new research capabilities. It is expected that this individual will conduct independent scholarly research, and will contribute directly to the overall research goals of the project and the research group.

This role will be expected to participate in project planning, recording and interpretation/evaluation of data, and communication of results. This position will also be expected to acquire technical, lab management, and manuscript/grant writing skills; and participate in seminars, lectures, poster sessions and presentations at national meetings. This role also may be required to supervise junior lab members, develop new methods and protocols for research, and assist with the development of other research projects in the lab.


About the Laboratory

The postdoctoral fellow (postdoc) will have a terminal degree PhD, MD, DVM, etc. and will, under the direction/guidance of a mentor (principal investigator), assume responsibility for a specific, on-going research project. The position is in the laboratory of Dr. Stella Chou, a Principal Investigator in the Hematology Research Division. Her research focuses on pediatric blood diseases, mechanisms of normal and pathologic hematopoietic development, and the study of vitro generation of red blood cells from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) for transfusion medicine.


The postdoc experience will serve to extend, refine and enhance skills necessary for professional and career development, and will enable the individual to broaden his/her scientific background by acquiring new research capabilities. It is expected that this individual will conduct independent scholarly research, and will contribute directly to the overall research goals of the project and the research group. Postdocs will be expected to participate in project planning, recording and interpretation/evaluation of data, and communication of results. Postdocs will also be expected to acquire technical, lab management, and manuscript/grant writing skills; and participate in seminars, lectures, poster sessions and presentations at national meetings. Postdoctoral fellows also may be required to supervise junior lab members, develop new methods and protocols for research, and assist with the development of other research projects in the lab.


Research foci include:

1. Study and enhance in vitro generation of red blood cells from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) for transfusion medicine

2. Use customized pluripotent stem cells with rare blood cell phenotypes to optimize their use as red cell reagents that would improve antibody identification in transfused patients with sickle cell disease.

3. Identifying novel methods to expand pluripotent stem cell derived hematopoietic progenitors or improve red cell maturation that would facilitate use of iPSC-derived red cells for therapeutic purposes.

4. Adaption of next generation sequencing technology to improve red cell matching and prevent alloimmunization in patients with sickle cell disease.

5. Use CRISPR/Cas9 technology in pluripotent stem cells to manipulate specific genes that may enhance red blood cell proliferation, maturation, and enucleation.


The Chou laboratory is looking for candidates with a general molecular biology background and tissue culture experience. A background in hematopoiesis and/or experience with CRISPR technology or human primary, ESC, or iPSC culture would be a plus

What you will do

  • Conduct independent scholarly research and develop new methods and protocols
  • Participate in project planning, recording and evaluation of data
  • Acquire technical, lab management and grant writing skills
  • Participate in seminars, lectures, poster sessions and presentation at national meetings
  • Supervise junior lab members
  • Assist with other research projects

Education Qualifications

  • Doctorate Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to wear a respirator device

As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. Learn more.

About the role

You'll join our Robotics Engineering Team, helping to develop, integrate, test and improve the robotic systems that underpin our automation platform. Working closely with software, mechanical, electrical and systems engineers, you'll play an important role in making sure our technology performs reliably and consistently in real-world applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys understanding how complex systems work, solving practical problems and using data to drive improvements.

One day you might be supporting the integration of new hardware and software, setting up and running tests on a robotic system and investigating unexpected behaviour. Another day you could be analysing test results, identifying performance trends or documenting findings to help guide engineering decisions.

You'll have the opportunity to work across different aspects of robotics engineering, developing your technical skills while contributing directly to the performance and reliability of our systems. Given the current maturity of the system, this will primarily involve software integration on existing hardware.

What you’ll do

You'll help bring our robots to life, ensuring our systems are thoroughly tested, well understood and dependable when it matters.

You’ll get to:

  • Test and validate robotic systems, developing and executing test plans to assess functionality, performance, reliability and repeatability.
  • Support system integration, bringing together robotic hardware, software, sensors and other automation components to ensure they work effectively as a complete system.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues, working with multidisciplinary teams to identify root causes and implement improvements.
  • Collect, process and analyse test data, using appropriate tools to evaluate system performance, identify trends and support engineering decisions.
  • Produce clear technical reports and documentation, communicating test results, investigations, conclusions and recommendations.
  • Contribute to the development of our ROS-based software stack, writing and modifying code to improve robotic functionality, performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate across engineering disciplines, providing practical feedback to improve system design, usability and reliability.

About you

You'll enjoy this role if you like getting hands-on with technology, understanding how things work and finding solutions when they don't behave as expected. You'll be curious, methodical and comfortable working with both physical systems and technical data.

You’ll bring:

  • A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • A good understanding of robotics, automation or electromechanical systems, gained through industry experience, academic projects or practical engineering work.
  • Programming experience, ideally in Python, with the ability to write, understand or modify scripts for testing, automation or data analysis.
  • A practical, structured approach to testing, troubleshooting and solving engineering problems.
  • The ability to analyse technical data, interpret results and communicate findings through clear reports and documentation.
  • An understanding of how hardware and software interact within integrated engineering systems.
  • Good communication skills and an ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • An interest in developing reliable, robust engineering solutions and continuously improving system performance.

Desirable

  • Experience working with industrial robots, robotic arms or mobile robots
  • Familiarity with robotics frameworks such as ROS.
  • Experience with system integration, verification, validation or commissioning.
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols, sensors, actuators or control systems.
  • Experience using Python libraries or other tools for data processing, analysis and visualisation.
  • Experience working in a product development environment.

Cellular Origins is based at Melbourn Science Park, just 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our newly renovated premises offer modern office, laboratory and engineering spaces, surrounded by green spaces. We foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture, where ideas are encouraged, innovation thrives, and everyone has the freedom to do their best work.

Job Summary

This position is an experienced network security engineer responsible for the deployment, configuration, and administration of network security resources. This role requires the ability to document and illustrate network topology diagrams. This includes the physical installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of related equipment and services. A Network Security Engineer collaborates with network engineering, desktop services, client administration, application owners, project managers, vendors, and end-users to provide support and administrative services. Typically reports to the Manager, Network Security.

Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field, preferred

Licenses/Certifications: An entry level networking and security certification such as PCNSA, CCENT, Network+, Security+, or equivalent preferred.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Three (3) to six (6) years of experience required in the following: configuring network devices such as a switch, router, access point, or firewall; creating detailed topology diagrams and technical documentation; and troubleshooting connectivity issues.

  • The ideal candidate will be required to perform networking tasks and will often be required to work independently.

  • Strong understanding of OSI model

  • Strong knowledge of well-known ports

  • Familiar with Active Directory Users and Groups

  • Use of packet analysis tools such as Wireshark

  • Familiar with common malware, cyber-attacks, and types of attackers

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Participates in the research, installation, configuration, implementation, troubleshooting and maintenance of security systems and services.

  • Provides unassisted support to application owners, project manager, vendors, and end-users.

  • Works on teams and provide task completion for all levels of projects.

  • Accountable for meeting and setting project timelines.

  • Recommends technical standards.

  • Participates in designing and planning of advanced security systems or services.

  • Provides guidance and mentoring to Security Analyst(s)

  • Researches and makes recommendations regarding the acquisition of new security tools and technology.

  • Responsible for covering a 7x24 shift of on call support rotating which is rotated weekly among the Information Security Cyber Operations team.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

title: MarTech Project Manager
description:
Our client is a leading global financial services organization seeking a MarTech Project Manager to support its Marketing Data Platform organization. This individual will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and external vendors to coordinate the delivery of customer data and marketing platform capabilities.

This role will play an important part in a large-scale marketing data platform migration and modernization initiative, helping drive project governance, cross-functional planning, stakeholder communication, and execution. The ideal candidate combines strong enterprise project management experience with an understanding of marketing technology, cloud-based data platforms, and customer data within a complex, regulated environment.

The Details:

  • Duration: Approximately a 12-month consulting role with the possibility of extension (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without sponsorship)
  • Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Pretax Commuter Benefits, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

What you’ll do:

Project Management & Delivery

  • Coordinate the planning and execution of marketing technology, customer data, and platform modernization initiatives.
  • Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and external vendors to facilitate alignment and keep project deliverables moving forward.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and delivery tracking to support successful execution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities and stakeholder engagement to ensure teams have the information, resources, and direction needed to meet project objectives.
  • Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches based on project needs, balancing iterative development with structured milestones, business requirements, and regulatory review processes.
  • Track progress across workstreams, identify delivery risks and blockers, and coordinate resolution or escalation as appropriate.

Project Governance & Stakeholder Communication

  • Establish and maintain project governance practices, including meeting coordination, status reporting, decision documentation, and stakeholder communications.
  • Prepare and maintain project dashboards, milestone trackers, and risk, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs.
  • Facilitate governance meetings, steering committee discussions, sprint reviews, and project retrospectives.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery impacts to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Translate technical or operational challenges into clear business implications and actionable updates for non-technical audiences.
  • Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and next steps throughout the project lifecycle.

Marketing Data Platform & Modernization Support

  • Support initiatives involving customer data, marketing platform capabilities, data activation, and platform modernization.
  • Gather, organize, and validate business, technical, and operational inputs to support planning and delivery.
  • Work with teams responsible for cloud-based data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks, to coordinate activities, dependencies, and implementation milestones.
  • Maintain a working understanding of first-, second-, and third-party data and how these datasets support marketing and customer engagement capabilities.
  • Coordinate across business and technical teams to help ensure platform enhancements and migration activities align with business needs and operational requirements.
  • Support delivery within a large, regulated environment where customer data governance, compliance, and stakeholder alignment are important considerations.

Knowledge Management & Documentation

  • Establish and maintain project knowledge resources, including Confluence spaces, documentation repositories, implementation guides, and reporting libraries.
  • Ensure project documentation is accurate, organized, current, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
  • Document key decisions, processes, dependencies, implementation considerations, and action items.
  • Develop consistent reporting and documentation practices that improve transparency, knowledge sharing, and continuity across project workstreams.
  • Help ensure critical project knowledge is retained and available throughout the migration and modernization lifecycle.

Education & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in project management, program delivery, marketing technology, data platform initiatives, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects within large enterprise organizations.
  • Experience coordinating business and technology stakeholders, vendors, and multiple delivery workstreams.
  • Experience supporting data platform modernization, migration, customer data, or marketing technology initiatives.
  • Experience working in financial services or another highly regulated environment is strongly preferred.

Technical & Project Management Skills

  • Practical knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks, sufficient to understand project dependencies, coordinate delivery, and communicate effectively with technical teams.
  • Familiarity with first-, second-, and third-party datasets and their use within customer data or marketing environments.
  • Experience applying Agile methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban, as well as Waterfall or stage-gate delivery approaches.
  • Ability to manage hybrid project environments involving iterative development, fixed deadlines, multiple approvals, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Experience building and maintaining project plans, dashboards, milestone trackers, status reports, and RAID logs.
  • Familiarity with Confluence or similar knowledge management and documentation tools.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, issue escalation, and delivery tracking.

Communication & Leadership Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical topics in business-friendly language.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate across business, technology, operations, and vendor teams.
  • Confidence facilitating meetings, governance forums, steering committee discussions, and project reviews.
  • Ability to translate technical and creative blockers into business impact for senior leadership.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying risks, resolving blockers, and maintaining project momentum.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving accountability in a complex, matrixed organization.

title: Senior Test Manager
description:
Position Summary

Odyssey is recruiting to fill a Senior Test Engineer supporting the Technical Integration Support Collaborative (TISC) at Hurlburt Field, FL. The TISC is part of the ISR/SOF Directorate (AFLCMC/WI), which is responsible for equipping our warfighters to win the fight.

Responsibilities

Duties include, but not limited to:

  • Support the development of Test and Evaluation (T&E) strategies, plans, and management approaches for acquisition programs.
  • Assist in the preparation, coordination, and staffing of Program Introduction Documents (PIDs) and other test-related acquisition documentation.
  • Organize, coordinate, and facilitate Integrated Test Team (ITT) meetings, working groups, and stakeholder engagements.
  • Develop, coordinate, and staff Test and Evaluation Master Plans (TEMPs) in support of acquisition program objectives.
  • Prepare and maintain DAFMAN 63-119 Operational Test Readiness Review (OTRR) matrices and supporting documentation.
  • Provide advisory support to Government program offices in the development, integration, and maintenance of test schedules for acquisition and modernization efforts.
  • Coordinate with program management, engineering, logistics, airworthiness, and operational stakeholders to support test planning and execution activities.
  • Track test-related action items, risks, schedules, and deliverables to ensure successful execution of developmental and operational test events.
  • Assist with test readiness assessments and support acquisition milestone, certification, and fielding decision activities.
  • Develop briefing materials, reports, and status updates for Government leadership and test stakeholders.

Qualifications

Minimum Required Qualifications

Citizenship: Must be a US citizen

Clearance: Secret

Education and experience:

  • Master’s or Doctorate Degree in a related field and 10 years of related experience, 5 years of which must be in the DoD.
  • OR Bachelor’s degree in a related field and 12 years of related experience, 5 of which must be in the DoD.
  • OR 15 years of directly related experience, 8 of which must be in the DoD.

Technical Skills

  • Test & Evaluation Planning – Experience developing, coordinating, and executing Test and Evaluation (T&E) strategies, Test and Evaluation Master Plans (TEMPs), and test management documentation for DoD acquisition programs.
  • Operational & Developmental Test Management – Ability to plan, integrate, and oversee developmental testing (DT), operational testing (OT), and test readiness activities supporting acquisition milestone and fielding decisions.
  • Integrated Test Team (ITT) Leadership – Experience organizing and facilitating Integrated Test Teams, working groups, and cross-functional coordination among engineering, program management, logistics, and operational stakeholders.
  • Acquisition Test Documentation & Compliance – Knowledge of DAFMAN 63-119, Operational Test Readiness Reviews (OTRRs), test schedule development, risk management, and acquisition documentation required to support Air Force weapon system test activities.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Communication Skills – Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, test results, risks, and recommendations to Government leadership, engineers, operators, and other stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Team Building – Proven ability to work effectively across Integrated Test Teams (ITTs) and coordinate efforts among program management, engineering, logistics, operational users, and external organizations.
  • Facilitation & Stakeholder Engagement – Strong meeting facilitation and consensus-building skills with the ability to lead working groups, resolve issues, and drive action across diverse stakeholders.
  • Critical Thinking & Problem Solving – Ability to identify test challenges, evaluate impacts, develop risk mitigation strategies, and provide sound recommendations to support program execution and decision-making.

Additional Information

Location: Hurlburt Field, FL

Travel: 15%

Remote, Onsite, or Hybrid: Onsite

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

Role Overview

The Technical Support Engineer provides first-level technical support to customers across various channels including chat, email, web, and phone. This role focuses on basic troubleshooting, accurate information-gathering, resolution of common issues, and timely escalation of complex issues.

This position reports to the Manager, Technical Support.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor and respond to incoming customer requests for technical support across all supported channels.
  • Gather complete and accurate technical information (log files, environment details, reproduction steps, and more) to support resolution or escalation.
  • Clearly document all customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and outcome in the case management system.
  • Guide customers to relevant self-service resources and redirect non-support requests to appropriate internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities or gaps in self-service content, for example, KBAs.
  • Escalate cases that exceed defined scope or knowledge level, ensuring all required context is provided.
  • Meet individual performance targets related to case volume, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction.

What We’re Looking For

  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or have equivalent experience.
  • 0-2+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset.
  • Ability to follow structured troubleshooting processes and escalate effectively.
  • Familiarity with CRM and case management tools (Salesforce Service Cloud preferred).

Scope & Accountability

  • Direct ownership of individual customer cases within defined playbook and procedures.
  • Decisions are guided by documented standards and team support.
  • Impact is primarily at the individual customer interaction level.

Compensation & Benefits

How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. Core Values

Our core values shape the culture of Progress Valley and define what we expect from ourselves as colleagues, leaders, and caregivers. These values guide how we serve clients, collaborate with one another, and carry out our responsibilities each day.


Service

We serve all people with compassion, dignity, and respect.

Respects and values each person's background, beliefs, and experiences; demonstrates person-centered care; advocates appropriately for those we serve.

Integrity

We do what is right, take responsibility for our actions, and act ethically.

Acts honestly and ethically; owns mistakes with transparency; aligns words, decisions, and actions.

Awareness

We show self-awareness and empathy in our interactions.

Regulates emotions; listens to understand; communicates clearly, respectfully, and constructively.

Ownership

We take responsibility for our work, our decisions, and our impact.

Follows through on commitments; takes accountability for outcomes; invests in solutions, not problems.

Resilience

We remain steady, adaptable, and grounded.

Navigates challenges with positivity; embraces change; remains effective through adversity.

Growth

We prioritize growth in ourselves, our work, and our mission.

Seeks feedback; advances professional skills; contributes to improving and expanding services.


Position Summary

The CD Tech serves as a caretaker and custodian for both clients and the facility. The primary responsibilities include monitoring client conduct, maintaining the cleanliness and order of the premises, orienting new residents to house rules and procedures, and supporting the counseling team. In the absence of the Program Manager, the CD Tech assumes responsibility for all safety matters.

The CD Tech must demonstrate self-confidence and sound individual judgment, the ability to de-escalate and resolve conflict within the client community, and a high level of crisis tolerance. This position requires the ability to respond professionally to medical emergencies, convey a positive and professional image to clients, staff, and visitors, and maintain strict client confidentiality.

In all aspects of this role, the CD Tech embodies Progress Valley’s Core Values through compassionate, person-centered care, ethical conduct, clear communication, accountability, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous growth.


Essential Responsibilities


Service

Demonstrates compassion, dignity, and respect in all client and visitor interactions.

  • Manage and supervise client activity and daily responsibilities with a person-centered approach.
  • Explain house rules, regulations, and procedures to incoming clients in a clear and respectful manner.
  • Conduct client intakes, including documentation of medications, searching belongings, assigning keys and linens, and assisting with required documentation.
  • Facilitate client discharges, including room cleaning, return of keys and linens, and assistance with documentation and storage of belongings.
  • Greet visitors and ensure compliance with visiting policies, maintaining a welcoming and professional environment.
  • Respond to client emergency medical needs in a timely and composed manner.
  • Collect urinalysis samples and perform breath analysis testing as needed.

Integrity

Upholds ethical conduct, confidentiality, and compliance with policies and regulations.

  • Understand and follow all policies and procedures related to client and program rules and regulations to ensure consistency in service delivery.
  • Adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and agency policies related to the protection of client confidentiality.
  • Understand and follow vulnerable adult policy and reporting procedures.
  • Understand and follow incident/accident reporting policies and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with fire and safety codes and regulations.
  • Understand and follow emergency fire and weather policies and procedures.
  • Secure personal belongings of clients who depart for a period of 60 days or until disposition instructions are provided by the Program Manager.

Awareness

Communicates effectively and demonstrates empathy in all interactions with clients and staff.

  • Communicate to staff any inappropriate or suspected inappropriate client behavior in a timely manner.
  • Provide consistent feedback to counseling staff regarding client activities and behavioral observations.
  • Address client periods of non-compliance and escalate issues to counseling staff and/or the Program Manager as appropriate.
  • Manage client crisis situations following established procedures for communicating with clinical staff and management.
  • Document and communicate physical health issues to the nurse and other program staff.
  • Answer the telephone, log messages, check voicemail, and route messages appropriately.

Ownership

Takes responsibility for facility operations, documentation, and program consistency.

  • Provide consistency in program operations by maintaining all client behavioral interventions communicated by counseling staff, including earned privileges and restrictions.
  • Check and maintain the resident sign-out log, passes, and permissions, ensuring clients are present during appropriate times.
  • Record all shift activities in the daily log accurately and thoroughly.
  • Record and count all medications (new and refills) and document medication changes.
  • Assist the nurse in requesting new medications and refills from the preferred pharmacy.
  • Ensure premises are locked and secured; confirm unnecessary lights are off and appliances (coffee maker, washer, dryer, etc.) are turned off.
  • Maintain adequate supply of linens, cleaning supplies, and office supplies in coordination with the Lead CD Tech.
  • Complete demographic and statistical reports as directed.
  • Document and communicate maintenance needs to maintenance staff; inform the Maintenance Supervisor and Program Manager of significant incidents, building emergencies, and major repair needs.
  • Perform clerical duties as needed, including data entry, filing, copying, and light typing.
  • Perform necessary duties as driver of the house vehicle.
  • Assist maintenance staff with vehicle upkeep.

Resilience

Navigates challenges with professionalism, maintaining safety and stability for clients and staff.

  • Handle interventions with program clients in the event of minor violations, applying sound judgment and de-escalation skills.
  • Know and follow all program emergency procedures.
  • Perform room checks or “rounds” to ensure all clients are present and safe.
  • Ensure safety measures are followed, including carrying a cell phone and flashlight as appropriate, remaining within the perimeter of the property, contacting 911 for emergency services or intruder situations, and making no attempt to apprehend intruders.
  • Perform searches of the facility and clients and their belongings as needed or scheduled.
  • Supervise and record fire drills once per month.
  • Maintain facility grounds, including light cleanup and general appearance of lawn and snow removal as needed.
  • Understand and coordinate with the Program Manager or Maintenance Technician on maintenance tasks associated with general building wellness systems (heating, water, electric, etc.).

Growth

Engages in continuous learning and contributes to a positive, evolving work environment.

  • Attend training events and staff meetings as required by your supervisor.
  • Attain, maintain, and promote a positive, safe, harmonious, productive, and challenging work environment.
  • Seek opportunities to improve client service delivery and operational processes.
  • Contribute to the improvement and expansion of Progress Valley’s services.

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform other tasks and duties as assigned by supervisor or management.

title: Coordonnateur technique, Camps et cliniques & Entraîneur Pré-Académie / Technical Coordinator, Camps and Clinics, and Pre-Academy Coach

Dans ses fonctions, elle assure une communication régulière avec les joueurs et leurs parents et collabore avec les autres équipes. Elle bénéficie également du soutien d’un(e) entraîneur(e) adjoint(e) auprès de son équipe.

Principales responsabilités

Équipe U13 ou U14 (Pré-académie) :

  • Planifier et mettre en œuvre le cycle annuel d’entraînement de l’équipe, conformément aux objectifs de développement de l’Académie;
  • Tenir à jour la planification annuelle ainsi que les plans de séance;
  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les joueurs et leurs parents au sujet des objectifs, des attentes et des activités de l’équipe;
  • Participer aux réunions techniques et assurer le suivi des décisions prises et des mesures applicables;
  • Participer aux activités d’identification et de recrutement;
  • Planifier et coordonner les matchs amicaux, notamment l’horaire et les communications requises;

Camps et cliniques :

  • Élaborer et transmettre les plans d’entraînement des camps et des cliniques, conformément à la méthodologie de l’Académie;
  • Assurer une présence régulière sur le terrain afin d’observer le déroulement des activités, de vérifier l’application de la méthodologie de l’Académie et d’effectuer les suivis nécessaires auprès des entraîneurs;
  • Participer au recrutement et à la formation des entraîneurs, observer leur travail et leur offrir une rétroaction constructive favorisant leur développement;
  • Coordonner le calendrier, les sites et les ressources nécessaires, puis communiquer l’information aux personnes concernées;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe.

Job description

Reporting to the Academy Manager, the candidate fulfills a dual role: ensuring the technical coordination of camps and clinics, including the quality of activities and the supervision of assigned staff, and serving as head coach of a U13 or U14 Pre-Academy team, depending on the assignment determined by the Academy. The candidate has the relevant experience and the skills needed to carry out these two complementary roles. In this capacity, the candidate maintains regular communication with players and their parents and collaborates with the other teams. The candidate is also supported by an assistant coach for the team.

Main responsabilities

U13 or U14 team (Pre-Academy):

  • Plan and implement the team’s annual training cycle in line with the Academy’s development objectives;
  • Keep the annual plan and the session plans up to date;
  • Communicate regularly with players and their parents about the team’s objectives, expectations and activities;
  • Participate in technical meetings and follow up on decisions made and applicable measures;
  • Participate in identification and recruitment activities;
  • Plan and coordinate friendly matches, including scheduling and the required communications;

Camps and Clinics:

  • Develop and distribute training plans for camps and clinics in accordance with the Academy’s methodology;
  • Maintain a regular presence on the field to observe how activities unfold, verify the application of the Academy’s methodology and carry out the necessary follow-ups with coaches;
  • Participate in the recruitment and training of coaches, observe their work and provide constructive feedback that supports their development;
  • Coordinate the schedule, sites and resources required, then communicate the information to those concerned;
  • Perform any other related duties.
  • Faire preuve de créativité, d’innovation, de proactivité et d’ouverture d’esprit, ainsi que d’un grand entregent, d’un excellent sens du service à la clientèle et de solides habiletés interpersonnelles;
  • Posséder une expérience du milieu du soccer au Québec et une bonne connaissance des parcours de développement des joueurs;
  • Posséder au moins trois années d’expérience pertinente comme entraîneur(e) auprès de joueurs en développement, dont une expérience en coordination technique ou en supervision d’entraîneurs;
  • Détenir un diplôme B de la CONCACAF ou une certification de niveau supérieur;
  • Démontrer d’excellentes capacités de planification, de priorisation et de gestion du temps afin de coordonner une équipe de la Pré-Académie ainsi que plusieurs camps et cliniques;
  • Démontrer d’excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale auprès des joueurs, des parents et du personnel de l’Académie;
  • Maîtriser les logiciels de bureautique, notamment ceux de la suite Microsoft Office;
  • Être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe;
  • Être disponible pour travailler régulièrement les soirs et les fins de semaine, selon le calendrier du Club.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrate creativity, innovation, proactivity and open-mindedness, as well as strong people skills, an excellent sense of customer service and solid interpersonal skills;
  • Have experience in the Quebec soccer community and a good knowledge of player development pathways;
  • Have at least three years of relevant experience as a coach working with developing players, including experience in technical coordination or coach supervision;
  • Hold a CONCACAF B License or a higher-level certification;
  • Demonstrate excellent planning, prioritization and time management skills in order to coordinate a Pre-Academy team as well as several camps and clinics;
  • Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills with players, parents and Academy staff;
  • Be proficient in office software, particularly the Microsoft Office suite;
  • Be able to work both independently and as part of a team;
  • Be available to work regularly on evenings and weekends, according to the Club’s schedule.

title: Tiimiesihenkilö, Business Oulu -liikelaitos
description:
Haemme TIIMIESIHENKILÖÄ vakinaiseen virkaan Business Oulu -liikelaitoksen työllisyyspalveluihin.

BusinessOulu edistää kaupungin elinvoimaa luomalla menestymisen mahdollisuuksia alueelle, asukkaille ja yrityksille. Rakennamme vahvaa pohjoista kasvukeskusta, joka houkuttelee nuorekkaana yritys-, asuin- ja opiskelupaikkakuntana. Luomme uusia työpaikkoja kestävästi yritysten kasvun kautta.

Palvelemme alkavia, kasvavia ja kansainvälistyviä yrityksiä niiden toiminnan ja toimintaympäristön kehittämisessä sekä verkostoitumisessa ja osaavan työvoiman rekrytoimisessa. Työnantajille BusinessOulu tarjoaa laadukkaita, maksuttomia rekrytointipalveluita Oulun alueella.

Asiakkaanamme on työnhakijoita työuran aloittavista nuorista kansainvälisiin osaajiin. Järjestämme lisäksi rekrytointitapahtumia. Työnhakijoita palvelemme kaikissa työelämän vaiheissa. Löydät sivuilta https://businessasema.com/ tietoa avoimista työpaikoista, koulutuksista sekä eri palveluista työnhakijoille.

Tehtävä sijoittuu Henkilöasiakkaan palvelut 1-yksikköön, Kauppa, palvelut ja matkailu -toimialatiimiin, jossa vastaat osoitetun työnhakija-asiakasryhmän palveluiden sujuvuudesta.

Tiimiesihenkilönä vastaat tiimisi operatiivisesta johtamisesta ja toiminnasta Oulun kaupunkistrategian, elinkeinopoliittisen toimenpideohjelman, Business Oulu -liikelaitoksen ja Oulun seudun työllisyysalueen tavoitteiden mukaisesti.

Työssä yhdistyvät valmentava johtaminen, ihmisten kohtaaminen, ratkaisujen etsiminen ja yhteistyö erityisesti organisaation sisäisten toimijoiden kanssa, mutta myös verkostojen ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Verkostoyhteistyöhön kuuluvia tahoja voivat olla työnantajat ja yritykset, oppilaitokset, kaupungin muut palvelut, kolmannen sektorin toimijat sekä muut palveluntuottajat.

Toimit lähiesihenkilönä henkilöasiakastyötä virkavastuulla tekeville omavalmentajille, kotoutumisen omavalmentajille, työhönvalmentajalle sekä työkykykoordinaattorille. Tiimiesihenkilö tukee ja ohjaa tiimiä tulokselliseen työhön ja saavuttamaan liikelaitoksen tavoitteet. Raportoit myös tiimisi työn tuloksista sovituin määräajoin.

Vastaat siitä, että tiimissä toteutetaan työllisyyspalveluiden prosesseja (työnvälitys, osaamisen kehittäminen, kotoutuminen ja työkyvyn kehittäminen) työmarkkinoiden tarpeiden ja työllisyyttä koskevan lainsäädännön mukaisesti. Lähiesihenkilönä vastaat osaltasi tiimisi henkilöstön perehdyttämisestä, työhyvinvoinnista ja käyt henkilöstösi kanssa kehitys- ja osaamiskeskustelut.

Tehtävä edellyttää lain soveltamisen ja työllisyyden palveluverkoston tuntemusta sekä perehtyneisyyttä asiakaspalveluun ja asiakaslähtöisyyteen. Etsimämme henkilö kykenee ohjaamaan tiiminsä henkilöstöä tilanteissa, joissa ei ole valmiita ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja. Lisäksi osallistut organisaation, yksikön sekä tiimisi kehittämistoimintaan omasta roolistasi käsin.

Kelpoisuusehtona virkaan on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja työn työkokemuksen kautta hankittu ammattitaito ja osaaminen. Tehtävässä vaaditaan kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja perehdyttämistehtävistä.

Lisäksi edellytetään englannin kielen taitoa, kokemusta työvoimaviranomaisen tehtäväkentästä ja työtä ohjaavasta lainsäädännöstä sekä työn ja tiimien johtamisesta.

Kutsumme sinua vastuulliseen ja merkitykselliseen työhön, johon saat kannustavan organisaation tuen. BusinessOululaisille kuuluvat myös Oulun kaupungin kattavat työsuhde-edut. Työhyvinvointia tuetaan muun muassa liikunta- ja kulttuuriedulla. Lisäksi tarjolla on erilaisia kaupungin henkilöstölle kohdennettuja alennuksia.

Etätyötä voi tehdä Business Oulu -liikelaitoksen etätyösopimuksen mukaisesti.

Virkaan valitun tulee esittää hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan ennen viran vastaanottamista.

Oulun kaupunki käyttää vakinaisissa viroissa kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55A. Hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/15505/2026. Oulun kaupunki ei käytä tekoälyä hakemusten käsittelyssä. Hakemukset on toimitettava 19.11.2026 klo 16.15 mennessä.

title: Shipping and Receiving Associate (2nd Shift) - Weekends Off! (6646)
description:

If you enjoy hands-on work, don’t mind lifting throughout the day, and take pride in being the person who keeps operations moving—this could be a great fit.

5010 Hudson Dr, Stow, OH 44224

  • Weigh incoming waste using our Weighbridge system
  • Prepare, pack, and stage outgoing customer orders for transport
  • Complete required paperwork accurately and on time
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area

We are a healthcare service company providing safety systems and medical waste collection for hospitals, medical centers, surgical centers, nursing homes and an array of customers within the healthcare setting. title: Patient Flow Navigator
description:
As part of the Patient Flow Team, will implement system wide initiatives to facilitate the ease of patient movement through the hospital system. Working collaboratively with all teams, you will identify and resolve barriers to ensure effective flow of patients. This is a non unit producing position with administrative bed allocation responsibilities and authority to determine all bed assignments.

  • Provide co-ordination and supervision of patient admissions, discharges and transfers utilizing Halton Healthcare flow and access tools, standards, protocols and current awareness of each units status within the hospital
  • Chair daily bed meetings with the CRNs, Managers, Infection Control, Staffing Resource Team and Diagnostics.
  • Facilitate the flow of patients to maximize patient throughput and ensure placement of patients in the right bed at the right time through appropriate bed allocation
  • Act as a liaison between units to ensure smooth, timely and appropriate placement of admitted patients
  • Ability to assess risk and support patient acuity, while considering the global needs of all patients and hospital programs
  • Identify and track various Patient Flow performance metrics
  • Understand demand and capacity principles and processes and works in partnership with unit staff to identify/remove barriers to help resolve challenging situations
  • Develop and maintain strong, effective partnerships with all members of the health care team
  • Responsibility for tracking use of over census beds using developed tracking tool
  • Work in conjunction with Decision Support, Manager of Patient Flow and Director of Patient Flow to track identified metrics
  • Contribute to the overall goal of timely patient transfer requests include life or limb Criticall, repatriations, inter-facility transfers and compassionate requests. Responsibilities include contacting external facilities in order to follow up on existing incoming/outgoing repatriations/bed offers, and to initiate/coordinate new repatriation requests, particularly on weekends.
  • Assess and make recommendations for changes in current practice as per Halton Healthcare focus on continuous quality improvement

Halton Healthcare endeavors to hire individuals who are competent in their chosen profession and who exemplify our mission, vision and values of accountability, respect and compassion which guide our individual behaviours and attitudes.

  • BScN degree, Masters preferred
  • Current member in good standing with the Ontario College of Nurses
  • A minimum of 3-5 years progressive work experience in a patient flow/leadership role in an acute care health care setting
  • Proficiency with Meditech Electronic Documentation System, EDDIS and Visibility required
  • In-depth knowledge of individual sites and multi-site organizational processes required
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and implementation of best practice initiatives
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with multiple partners
  • Proven ability to effectively influence change in a complex multi-site healthcare environment
  • Ability to listen, engage, collaborate, negotiate, facilitate and entertain creative solutions in order to enhance patient flow organizationally
  • Identifies pre-gridlock situations and utilizes the Surge Policy to support the identification of an appropriate strategy and plan of action to prevent or deal with gridlock
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal and problem solving skills
  • Ability to cultivate positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to think critically and respond to a rapidly-changing environment with competing demands. Maintains a level of fluidity or flexibility to be able to deal with new information and/or unplanned situations
  • Ability to manage high job demands in a fast-paced environment and be self-directed
  • Must be physically able to round on units on a regular basis to assist in removing barriers to timely patient transfers. This may include engaging with appropriate physicians and health team members to help alleviate patient flow barriers/pressures
  • Optimize resource utilization (including staffing resources) within the organization, re-organizing staff where appropriate to ensure safe and efficient workflow
  • Satisfactory employment and attendance record

title: Loss Mitigation Officer
description:
*Must live within daily commuting distance of STCU Headquarters in Liberty Lake, WA*

The Loss Mitigation Officer plays a key role in independently calling and managing complex delinquency portfolios to minimize loss and reduce institutional risk. With a strong focus on regulatory compliance, strategic decision-making and member-centered solutions, this role directly impacts key financial performance metrics. The position is designed to accommodate growth, allowing officers to develop expertise, while contributing to a vital part of the credit union’s risk management strategy.

Core Job Requirements/Outcomes

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to regulatory compliance by adhering to FDCPA and UDAAP standards and proactively completing all mandatory training to ensure operational integrity.
  • Effectively manage delinquent accounts by calling on and engaging members with professionalism and empathy to identify causes of default and offer tailored recovery solutions, resulting in decreased loss to the credit union.
  • Minimize loan losses by preparing and recommending accounts for repossession or charge-off after all primary collection efforts have been exhausted, while demonstrating advanced proficiency through managing higher volumes, executing complex collection tasks, and mentoring others to support team development and operational excellence.

Other Essential Functions

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to excellence by consistently maintaining departmental standards, and reliably achieving operational and service goals that support the overall success of the team.
  • Continuously seeks opportunities to improve collection processes by identifying inefficiencies and implementing more effective methods, while remaining adaptable to change and open to adopting new strategies and tools for enhanced performance.
  • Responsible for accurately and efficiently processing payments, including internal transfers, external ACH transactions, and debit card transactions.
  • Actively contribute to team success through continuous improvement, collaboration on departmental initiatives, participation in ongoing training, and fostering strong, professional relationships that promote a positive and productive work environment.

Education: High School diploma or equivalent required.

Certifications: Certifications related to collections, finance, or credit risk are preferred.

Job Experience: Minimum two years of experience in account resolution, account maintenance or a comparable role in a financial institution or related industry. Must have demonstrated experience in negotiating repayment terms, resolving overdue accounts, and managing high call volumes. Experience in consumer collections preferred. Working knowledge of consumer deposit and loan products and familiarity with FDCPA, UDAAP, and related regulations preferred.

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Security Operations Analyst to join our Technology team and play a key role in protecting our environment from evolving cyber threats.

This is a hands-on role with a strong focus on vulnerability management, working across technology and application teams to identify security weaknesses, understand the real-world risk they present, and drive remediation through to completion.

You’ll work with security platforms including Qualys, Microsoft Defender, GitHub Advanced Security and Snyk, using data and threat context to ensure we focus our efforts where they matter most.

Day to day you will:

  • Own day-to-day vulnerability management, from identification and assessment through to remediation.
  • Analyse and correlate findings across tools including Qualys, Microsoft Defender, GitHub Advanced Security and Snyk.
  • Prioritise vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, internet exposure, attack paths and business criticality.
  • Partner with infrastructure, application and platform teams to establish clear remediation ownership and timeframes.
  • Create and manage remediation tickets, track progress and follow up on overdue or high-risk vulnerabilities.
  • Monitor remediation against agreed vulnerability SLAs and escalate exceptions or emerging risks.
  • Help maintain accurate asset ownership and criticality information to enable effective, risk-based prioritisation.
  • Produce meaningful reporting across security exposure, remediation performance, vulnerability ageing, backlog and emerging trends.
  • Support security governance, audit and risk activities by providing clear evidence, metrics and remediation updates.
  • Look for opportunities to improve vulnerability management processes through automation and smarter ways of working.
  • Contribute across the wider Security Operations function, including vulnerability triage, threat-driven investigations and security incident support.

About you:

  • Similar experience in cyber security, vulnerability management, Security Operations or a related technology security role.
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning, SIEM, XDR or EDR security tools.
  • Strong analytical skills with an understanding of vulnerability risk, exploitability, attack paths and prioritisation.
  • Exposure to tools such as Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel and/or frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to turn security findings into clear actions and drive remediation through to completion.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Python or security automation would be an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, SC-200 or CISSP would be beneficial.

title: Senior .NET Engineer
description:
The role requires an on-site presence in the Brno office a couple of days per month.
The Company
Capital Markets Gateway LLC (CMG) is a capital markets-focused fintech transforming global equity capital markets (ECM) through data, technology, and connectivity. As the preferred source for ECM analytics and the first network connecting the buy-side and sell-side for ECM workflows, we are committed to reshaping how capital markets operate. Founded in 2017 by a team of ECM practitioners, CMG has completed three successful fundraising rounds and is backed by a group of the world’s most prestigious financial institutions. The CMG platform is currently relied upon by 25 global investment banks and 135 asset managers representing $40 trillion in AUM. For more information, please visit www.cmgx.io.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior .NET Engineer to join our team to help build scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise solutions for the financial industry. As a Senior .NET Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust backend systems and APIs that power our core products. You’ll collaborate closely with frontend engineers, product managers, and QA teams to ensure seamless data flow, system reliability, and efficient service integration. Your contributions will include optimizing performance, enhancing system architecture, and applying best practices in software development, security, and deployment to support rapid and reliable product delivery.

Our Engineering Team

The CMG engineering team consists of domain experts who work collaboratively within a culture of cross-domain knowledge sharing. We value engineers who are passionate about modern technologies and best practices.

Our engineers are encouraged to challenge the status quo and are constantly seeking improvement and efficiency in our code-base and platform. CMG engineers are empowered to explore solutions using leading edge technologies such as AI and bring recommendations to the table. We are in a period of making impactful engineering decisions.

As part of our process, we believe in taking the time for research and prototyping - this is critical in making the right decisions. Given the experience of our team, we have naturally adopted best practices from local development, through code review and into production rollouts. Besides the standard pull requests, test automation, code coverage tracking, containerization, and one-click deployments, we are constantly reviewing these foundational components to develop new best practices.

Responsibilities

  • Operate as a product engineer focused on solving real user and business problems, not clearing a backlog. You bring ideas, challenge assumptions, and own outcomes.

  • Work in an AI-first development flow. Use Claude not just to go faster, but to do more: explore multiple approaches, validate ideas quickly, and build things that previously wouldn't have been worth the effort.

  • Primarily focused on backend: designing, developing, and maintaining scalable services with .NET 10, and GraphQL. Comfortable stepping into front-end work when the problem calls for it.

  • You're aligned to a product team and typically work alongside one or two other engineers on any given project, pairing on tough problems, reviewing each other's work, and shipping together rather than in parallel.

  • Uphold a high-quality bar. Engineers write their own tests at the unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, and every line of code, human-written or AI-assisted, is reviewed by a human before it ships.

  • Drive technical improvements across the codebase. Proactively identify friction, propose changes, and see them through to adoption.

  • Serve as the first DataLab hire in Czechia, working from our Brno office. Shift your schedule to US Pacific morning hours (until ~20:00 CET) 2-3 days per week to collaborate with the rest of the team, which aligns to US time zones, attend project meetings, and to provide support.

  • Support the product you build by participating in the team’s on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.

Qualifications

  • Must be based in the Czech Republic.

  • C#, ASP.NET Core: 3+ years.

  • Software Engineering: 5+ Years.

  • English level - C1 or C2.

  • Fintech experience is a plus.

  • Experience developing AI-powered applications is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

  • Latest .NET version for our backend services.

  • Federated GraphQL .NET server running in Hot Chocolate.

  • MassTransit and RabbitMQ for messaging.

  • Hangfire for our background processing.

  • Redis Cache for distributed caching and real-time messaging.

  • Azure as infrastructure provider.

  • Docker + Kubernetes for microservice orchestration using Istio service mesh.

  • PostgreSQL for relational db, ElasticSearch for indexing, Redis for caching.

  • DataDog and OpenTelemetry for observability.

  • GitHub for our Version Control and CI (with our own runners).

  • React with TypeScript on our front-end.

Our Values

  • We innovate with purpose

  • We focus on outcomes vs. output

  • We believe diverse and inclusive teams fuel innovation

  • We are humble yet candid

  • We do right by the customer

What we offer

  • Unlimited vacation

  • Meal vouchers paid in full by the company

  • Multisport card contribution

  • Pension contributions

  • Language courses

  • Centrally located office in the heart of Brno

  • Bi-weekly team lunches provided by the company

  • Tech courses and conferences

  • Top of the line MacBook

  • Company team building events

  • Flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home

CMG embraces our ongoing commitment to building a culture reflecting the people, perspectives, and passions it represents. We will accept nothing less than equity, inclusion, and belonging for all. With the only constant in life being change, we will always listen, learn, and improve for the betterment of our teams, customers, and communities. CMG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Senior Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our clinical trial disclosures and transparency solution, Veeva Disclosures, within the Veeva Clinical Operations suite.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Disclosures solution. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial transparency and disclosure practices within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how sponsors and CROs meet their global trial registration and results reporting obligations.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of Veeva Disclosures among Life Sciences companies (Sponsors, CROs, and emerging biotechs), aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
  • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a connected disclosures solution in improving registration speed, submission accuracy, deadline management, and overall transparency reporting efficiency
  • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native disclosures application that sources data directly from their existing clinical applications, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure revenue goals are achieved
  • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical trial transparency technology at key industry events, conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Disclosures roadmap based on market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
  • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on disclosure and transparency pain points, identify emerging trends in global registry requirements and public data sharing, and provide actionable insights to enhance the Disclosures product and overall business strategy

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
  • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations leaders, and C-level executives)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

  • Disclosures Domain Expertise: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy for clinical trial disclosure and transparency solutions; understanding the nuances of trial registration, results reporting, and redaction and anonymization workflows is a core competency
  • Clinical Operations Expertise: Specific experience with the operational workflows of sponsor clinical development, transparency, and regulatory teams, as well as CROs
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and global clinical trial transparency requirements such as ClinicalTrials.gov and EU CTR
  • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $150,000 - $300,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
