title: Second Shift Lead, Senior Logistics Operations
description:
As our Second Shift Lead, Senior Logistics Operations, you will be responsible for day-to-day operations for the manufacturing warehouse on the second shift, including receiving, stocking, inventory management, shipping, and other warehouse-related activities. You will also plan, develop, and improve warehouse processes within our operations. Additionally, you are responsible for hiring and developing the operations team. You will assist us in transitioning to a more production-ready company.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage daily warehouse operations, including receiving, kitting, and cycle counting.

  • Establish the process to operate and maintain our warehouse equipment in optimum condition through KPIs to ensure continuous improvement in cost, service, quality, and safety.

  • Work closely with other Team Leads and Program/Project Managers to ensure their team stays aligned with Zoox’s overall goals.

  • Manage and mentor 7-10 direct reports to execute and deliver to Zoox’s high standards.

  • Develop and implement the safety guidelines to ensure team safety.

  • Execute second-shift warehouse operations to ensure on-time material delivery to production at efficient cost.

  • Track KPIs against budget and drive corrective actions when performance is off target.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of professional work experience in a product-based warehouse or logistics environment

  • 3+ years of experience leading 7-10 direct reports

  • Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) - SAP preferred

  • Experience working in a high-level collaborative environment and promoting a teamwork mentality

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree

  • Experience working with SAP (S4 Hana highly preferred)

  • Experience in automotive and/or manufacturing operations

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in an NPI environment

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.
Follow us on LinkedIn
Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.
A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Debt Settlement - Administrative Back Office
description:

You will provide support for and collaborate with multiple business units, helping our members expedite their way to financial freedom! You’d be reviewing creditor information, reaching out to creditors to locate accounts, updating account information and ensuring all enrolled accounts are ready for settlement as soon as possible. We’re a growing team and welcome creativity and ingenuity as we work towards perfecting the settlement preparation process.

Starting Pay: $18.21 /hour
Shift Requirements: Flexibility between 6:00am-4:00pm
Start Date: December 7th

What you’ll do:

  • Review creditor correspondence and documents including collection letters, statements and credit reports

  • Handle Inbound and Outbound calls with creditors to update account statuses

  • Research accounts and contact creditors to find who is servicing the account

  • Multitasking various work streams daily which requires organization

  • Achieving individual and team metrics associated with task completion and accuracy

  • Process bulk Authorization to Communicate and Power of Attorney document requests for creditors

  • Manage creditor email inquiries and accurately disposition accounts

  • Conduct special research/creditor projects assigned as necessary

  • Due to potential return-to-office plans, this role is only available to employees in the greater Phoenix/Tempe area

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or administrative office setting

  • Experience with processing documents or experience in the financial industry preferred

  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal & written)

  • Ability to successfully multitask

  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and achieve goals

  • Attention to detail

  • Proficient skills with Excel, Google Sheets, and Salesforce

Achieve well-being with:

  • 401 (k) with employer match

  • Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days

Join Achieve, change the future.
At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. title: Senior Insights & Curation Researcher
description:
Working closely with the Creative Insights team, this person will be responsible for the gathering, selection, and elevation of visuals within Getty Images and iStock library to regularly promote the breadth and depth, creativity, and differentiation of Getty Images’ and iStock’s Creative visual offering.

En étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Creative Insights, cette personne sera chargée de l’identification, de la sélection et de la mise en valeur des contenus visuels de la bibliothèque Getty Images et iStock afin de promouvoir régulièrement l’étendue, la qualité, la créativité et la différenciation de l’offre visuelle Creative.


Who You Are:

You are passionate about the way imagery works. You are naturally interested in visual communication in all forms and love discussing the content that you come across. You are equal parts creative, analytical and commercial. You enjoy selecting and curating visuals to tell compelling stories that are commercially relevant and are comfortable sharing your visual expertise with the world at large. You are highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage the moving parts of multiple work streams operating simultaneously while still meeting deadlines. You are a creative problem-solver with the ability to quickly identify problems and work independently to find appropriate solutions. You have a pulse on what’s new and next in art and culture and are not afraid to share your insights and perspective with a multi-disciplinary creative team.

Votre profil:

Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’image et par la manière dont elle communique. Vous vous intéressez naturellement à toutes les formes de communication visuelle et aimez échanger autour des contenus que vous découvrez. Vous combinez sens créatif, esprit analytique et vision commerciale. Vous aimez sélectionner et mettre en scène des visuels pour raconter des histoires pertinentes sur le plan commercial et êtes à l’aise pour partager votre expertise visuelle. Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs projets simultanément tout en respectant les délais. Vous êtes force de proposition, autonome dans la résolution de problèmes et attentif(ve) aux nouvelles tendances de l’art et de la culture.

Your Next Challenge:

Insights-Driven Curation & Promotion
  • Provide promotional sets of visuals for assigned Creative Insights research projects, thought leadership (e.g., trend articles, toolkits, etc.), and other activities as assigned
  • Support bespoke requests for promotional sets of visuals to be funneled directly to key customers as part of partnership activations or as incentive for enterprise deals
  • Create themed sets of visuals to accompany insights for materials developed by Regional Marketing as well as PR activities such as press mentions, interviews, bylines, and events
  • Select and regularly rotate visuals to be promoted on the Getty Images and iStock homepages as well as on other owned social platforms such as Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn and email newsletters
  • Manage the merchandising of our key global and regional Creative special collections, curations and galleries (e.g., Project #ShowUs, The Disability Collection, LGBTQIA+ Curation, etc.) across Getty Images and iStock site pages
  • Support process for submission of premium visuals, stories, thought leadership) for awards and industry recognition
Visual Strategy & Education
  • Collaborate with Insights team to create visual narratives for key research and thought leadership projects in-region
  • Maintain regular visibility into Getty Images and iStock visual offering, working directly with Content Creation teams to monitor new content so that curations are kept both fresh and relevant
  • Work with Insights, Sales Research and Custom Solutions teams to identify customer needs and content gaps in our visual offering
  • Develop and lead regular updates and trainings on new visual narratives and strategy in tandem with Insights team
  • Brainstorm and provide ongoing POV on visual trends across things aesthetics, video, subject, industry, regional
  • Set and maintain regional strategies for the ongoing development of the Creative special collections and ensure alignment to global strategy.
Vos principales missions
  • Fournir des sélections promotionnelles de visuels pour les projets de recherche Creative Insights, les initiatives de leadership d’opinion (articles de tendances, guides, etc.) et toute autre activité confiée.
  • Soutenir les demandes spécifiques de sélections de visuels destinées aux clients stratégiques dans le cadre de partenariats ou d’opportunités commerciales.
  • Créer des ensembles thématiques de visuels pour accompagner les supports marketing régionaux ainsi que les activités RP.
  • Sélectionner et renouveler régulièrement les visuels mis en avant sur les sites Getty Images et iStock, ainsi que sur les réseaux sociaux et newsletters.
  • Gérer la mise en avant des principales collections créatives mondiales et régionales.
  • Contribuer aux candidatures et soumissions pour des prix et reconnaissances du secteur.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Insights pour développer des récits visuels autour des projets de recherche et de leadership d’opinion.
  • Assurer une veille régulière de l’offre visuelle Getty Images et iStock et travailler avec les équipes de création de contenu pour maintenir des sélections pertinentes et actualisées.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Insights, Sales Research et Custom Solutions afin d’identifier les besoins clients et les lacunes de l’offre visuelle.
  • Concevoir et animer des formations et mises à jour régulières sur les nouvelles orientations visuelles et stratégiques.
  • Apporter un point de vue sur les tendances visuelles en matière d’esthétique, vidéo, sujets, secteurs et régions.
  • Définir et piloter les stratégies régionales pour le développement des collections créatives spéciales, en cohérence avec la stratégie globale.

You should have:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a related field (photography, filmmaking, visual arts, photo editing, art direction etc.)
  • High visual literacy with a broad understanding of photography as a medium, trends in popular culture (film, TV, music, art), global news, etc. Video/filmmaking knowledge is a plus, but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas visually to different audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple distinct projects at the same time.
  • Positive, collaborative attitude with a passion for creative excellence.
  • Experience thriving in a fast-moving, dynamic creative environment while not losing sight of critical details.
  • Strong organizational, project and time management skills
  • Proficiency in relevant software applications, particularly Microsoft PowerPoint (and/or Keynote) and Excel.

Profil recherché:

  • 3+ ans d’expérience minimum dans un domaine connexe (photographie, cinéma, arts visuels, édition photo, direction artistique, etc.).
  • Excellente culture visuelle et bonne compréhension de la photographie, des tendances culturelles, médiatiques et artistiques.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication et aptitude à présenter des idées complexes de manière visuelle.
  • Capacité démontrée à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets distincts.
  • Esprit positif, collaboratif et passion pour l’excellence créative.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique tout en conservant une grande attention aux détails.
  • Excellentes compétences d’organisation, de gestion de projet et de gestion du temps.
  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques pertinents, notamment Microsoft PowerPoint (ou Keynote) et Excel.
  • Anglais professionnel requis
There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame.
We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world.
Working at Getty Images
Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Foundational to our culture are our Leadership Principles, which are the shared values that guide how we come together to do our work. We raise the bar and collectively bring solutions while exercising trust, transparency, and care. We actively reject biased behavior and are inclusive of different voices, perspectives, and experiences. We focus on our customers and deliver on our commitments and commercial goals.
We foster a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes delivering results efficiently and using time wisely, so that all employees can achieve balance between commitments to the company and health and well-being in our lives. We value the importance of rest and recovery ranging from company-paid holidays to time away from work.
Our employees’ growth, development, belonging, and engagement are important investments. We offer learning experiences ranging from leadership development, diversity and inclusion training, mentoring programs, a high potential program, and professional and skills development. We prioritize staying connected in our hybrid-working world and encourage participation in global morale events and local gatherings, as well as finding community in one or more of our Employee Resource Groups. Learning about our business is paramount, and our open and transparent culture means you’ll have direct access to experts and senior leaders via open forums, all hands, and content hours.
Getty Images believes that diversity is critical to our success in moving the world and is committed to creating an inclusive, mutually respectful environment that celebrates diversity. We seek to hire based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. Getty Images is an equal opportunity employer.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Cloud Services
description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Staff Software Engineer – Cloud Services to own and evolve the architecture of Agiloft’s cloud-native CLM platform and supporting infrastructure. This role has end-to-end accountability for the design, reliability, scalability, security, and long-term health of cloud services that underpin the Agiloft platform.

Operating at both the platform- and organizational level, you will partner closely with Engineering leadership, senior engineers, and product leaders to translate business- and product strategy into durable cloud architectures and executable technical plans. A key focus of this role is designing and enabling scalable, observable, and resilient cloud services on AWS, while accelerating delivery through modern DevOps- and AI-assisted engineering practices.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining deep cloud and backend expertise with broad influence. Your work will directly shape Agiloft’s cloud architecture, operational posture, developer experience, and ability to scale reliably as the platform evolves.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture Ownership & Stewardship

  • Own the architecture of one or more critical cloud service domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and technical debt management over time.
  • Act as the architectural steward for AWS-based services, ensuring systems remain scalable, resilient, cost-efficient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Define service boundaries, APIs, data contracts, and integration patterns that enable independent evolution of cloud services.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles, including stateless services, managed services adoption, and failure-tolerant architectures.

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Lead the planning and execution of cloud architecture improvements that enhance scalability, availability, performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Translate architectural vision into mid- and long-term technical roadmaps, balancing near-term delivery with long-term cloud sustainability and cost optimization.
  • Drive cross-team alignment on design standards and architectural trade-offs.
  • Partner with CloudOps teams to define reliability targets, disaster recovery strategies, and operational readiness standards.

Cloud native & AI-Forward Engineering Enablement

title: Command and Control Network (C2NET) System Administrator SE-3
description:
Position Summary

Odyssey has an exciting opportunity for a Command and Control Network (C2NET) System Administrator (SE‑3) supporting the 96 Cyberspace Test Group (96 CTG), 45 Test Squadron Cyberspace Test Range Flight at Eglin AFB, FL.

The Cyberspace Test Range Flight manages the C2NET enclaves that enable developmental testing across the 96 CTG and provide Information Technology services not supported by the 96th Communications Squadron. C2NET is a government-developed and maintained family of network enclaves used to conduct developmental and certification testing of Command and Control (C2) systems and applications. These efforts include all associated hardware, software, networking equipment, and supporting infrastructure.

As a C2NET System Administrator, you will provide system engineering and cybersecurity support for mission-critical testing environments, support test infrastructure modernization efforts, and help maintain secure and effective C2 test capabilities for Air Force programs.

This is a full-time position located at Eglin AFB, FL.

Responsibilities

Duties include, but not limited to:

  • Provide system administration and cybersecurity support as part of the C2NET infrastructure team
  • Provide technical expertise to stakeholders within the Cyberspace Test Range Flight and across the 96 Cyberspace Test Group
  • Provide remote and on-premises network access required to support 96 CTG test objectives
  • Maintain JAD/C2 Datacenter physical assets and configurations in accordance with security standards and mission requirements
  • Engineer representative test environments utilizing virtualization suites and physical assets to support customer testing requirements
  • Attend required technical and security training related to operating systems, networking, and cybersecurity management
  • Perform minor physical duties, including occasional lifting, to support hardware installation and maintenance activities

Qualifications

Citizenship: Must be a US citizen

Minimum Required Qualifications

Clearance: Must have an Active Secret Clearance

Education:Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field and 3–10 years of applicable technical experience; OR

    • Six years of applicable technical experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree; OR
    • Four years of applicable technical experience with a technical associate’s degree

Certifications: Security+ is an acceptable qualification pathway. Candidates must meet current DoD 8140 requirements before onboarding.

  • At least 3 years of applicable technical experience
  • Experience with Windows and Linux administration
  • Experience supporting enterprise network and virtualization environments
  • Experience with Active Directory administration

Technical Skills

  • Experience implementing and assessing DISA STIG controls

title: Geospatial Analyst
description:
About INflow Federal - founded in 2013, INflow Federal is a mission-driven small business delivering cutting-edge solutions to the Department of War (DoW) and Joint Force operations across 20+ states. Our strength comes from our people - especially the Veterans who make up over 50% of our workforce. Through our Veteran Outreach Program and employee-first culture, we invest deeply in professional growth, well-being, and innovation. We empower both our employees and mission partners to stay ahead - driving smarter, faster, and more secure outcomes.

Job Overview:


INflow Federal is seeking a Geospatial Analyst to support mission-essential geospatial intelligence operations focused on analyzing and visualizing potential adversaries’ strategic weapons capabilities. You will leverage ArcGIS Enterprise technologies to perform spatial analysis, manage geospatial data, and develop web-based GIS applications that support operational planning and intelligence decision-making across the Department of Defense (DoD) and Intelligence Community (IC).
Here, your work is more than a job—it's a journey in innovation. With opportunities to work on high-impact projects, access to the latest technologies, and a culture that thrives on creativity and collaboration, INflow Federal is where your expertise can truly make a difference.

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform spatial analysis using ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise to support intelligence and operational planning.
  • Develop web maps, web applications, and analytic dashboards using ArcGIS Enterprise Portal.
  • Support installation, configuration, and administration of ArcGIS Enterprise, including Portal, Operations Dashboard, and GeoEvent Server.
  • Develop custom cartographic products, maps, charts, and visualizations supporting intelligence analysis.
  • Create Python and ArcPy scripts to automate geospatial data processing and analysis.
  • Manage and maintain GIS databases and spatial data environments.
  • Integrate dynamic streaming data sources using REST APIs and formats such as JSON, GeoJSON, XML, and CSV.
  • Process geospatial feeds using ArcGIS GeoEvent adapters for incorporation into analytic dashboards.
  • Support integration with DoD visualization platforms and intelligence workflows.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity standards including DISA STIGs, FedRAMP, and ATO processes.
  • Collaborate with analysts, technical teams, and leadership to support mission objectives.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geospatial Sciences, Geography, Remote Sensing, Geospatial Intelligence, or related GIS-focused field OR 8 years of military experience in GIS, geospatial intelligence, remote sensing, or geographic information science.
  • Minimum 3 years of GIS experience performing spatial analysis and supporting GIS systems.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Pro.
  • Experience with Python scripting and ArcPy.
  • Experience with relational and spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS or SQL Server.
  • Experience working with dynamic data connections and APIs (REST, JSON, GeoJSON, XML, CSV).
  • Knowledge of Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) standards.
  • Familiarity with ArcGIS Enterprise components including Portal and GeoEvent Server.
  • Familiarity with DoD IT security standards (DISA STIGs, FedRAMP, ATO).
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DIA/DOD privileged user account.
  • Ability to travel within CONUS approximately four times per year.

Desired Skills

  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • Experience supporting enterprise GIS systems in a government or defense environment.
  • Experience working with real-time geospatial data feeds.

Clearance Requirements

  • DoD Top Secret (TS) security clearance with eligibility for Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) is required.
Certification Requirements
Most of our contracts require DoD 8140 (formerly 8570) compliance. We built - our certification training platform - to help. This helps you study for certifications such as the CompTIA Security+.

title: Senior Manager, Portfolio Reporting & Compliance
description:
About Us
Solar Landscape is the nation’s leading distributed energy infrastructure company, transforming commercial real estate into a source of new power by deploying solar and storage at scale. Partnering with more than 170+ commercial real estate owners, the company develops, builds, owns, and operates distributed energy projects that deliver new capacity to the grid in as little as 12 months while generating long-term income for commercial and industrial property owners.

Proven by our performance, backed by institutional capital, and trusted by the biggest names in commercial real estate, we’re building the future of energy, and it shows:

  • Recognized by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. in 2025
  • Named to the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies
  • Ranked the #1 commercial rooftop solar developer by Solar Power World in both 2025 and 2026

That doesn’t happen without a team of smart, driven, and down-to-earth people who are serious about doing excellent work—and fun to work with. At Solar Landscape, you’ll be challenged, trusted with responsibility, and surrounded by people who thrive in our fast-paced environment. Career growth here isn’t limited by title or a rigid path: people who take ownership and deliver are given opportunities to stretch, lead, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll be supported by great benefits, professional development, and a culture that values authenticity, collaboration, and accountability.

Across our headquarters in Asbury Park, New Jersey and our offices in New York City, Chicago, and Baltimore, Solar Landscape employees are building something that matters, deploying critical energy infrastructure that creates long-term value for communities, property owners, and the grid. Come join us.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Portfolio Reporting and Compliance, to lead portfolio reporting and financing compliance at Solar Landscape. This leader will own the reporting and compliance function end to end, build and manage a team of analysts and accountants, and serve as the primary accounting and compliance contact for our lenders, tax equity investors, and auditors.

You will lead three connected areas:

  • Portfolio reporting. Own the reporting framework that leadership, investors, and lenders rely on, and set the standard for its accuracy, timeliness, and insight.
  • Financing and capital contribution transactions. Lead the accounting workstream for new project financings and capital contributions, from term sheet review through funding and onboarding.
  • Compliance through the operating life. Own the compliance program for every financing vehicle across its operating life: covenant and DSCR testing, reserves, distributions and waterfalls, capital accounts, and recurring lender and investor reporting.

The ideal candidate combines partnership accounting expertise with proven people leadership. You will set policy, make judgment calls on complex structures, and partner with finance, legal, investments, subscriber management, and asset management. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and external capital providers as we scale a fast-growing, mission-driven renewable energy business.

Responsibilities

Portfolio accounting and reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting cycle for all portfolios and financing vehicles, including timelines, review standards, and sign-off.
  • Lead budget vs. actual and variance analysis; present drivers and recommendations directly to senior leadership.
  • Design and continuously improve management, investor, and lender reporting packages, including KPIs and dashboards.
  • Oversee portfolio budgets and forecasts and liquidity forecasting.
  • Set accounting policy and positions for complex portfolio matters and document technical memos under US GAAP.

    • Financing and capital contribution transactions

    • Lead the accounting workstream on new debt, tax equity, and other financing transactions, from term sheet and document review through close.
    • Review transaction documents to flag accounting, reporting, and compliance impacts before execution, and negotiate workable reporting terms.
    • Own the onboarding of newly closed projects and financing vehicles, including entity setup, chart of accounts, and opening balances.
    • Serve as the primary accounting contact for lenders, tax equity investors, and their advisors.

      • Compliance through the operating life

      • Own the compliance program and calendar for every financing vehicle, ensuring zero missed deliverables or covenant breaches.
      • Oversee and approve covenant and DSCR testing, reserve requirements, debt service, partner distributions, and cash waterfalls under credit, partnership, and operating agreements.
      • Review partner and member capital accounts, including contributions, distributions, and allocations of income and loss, and resolve complex allocation questions.
      • Identify compliance risks early, escalate to leadership, and lead remediation, waivers, or amendments with legal and counterparties.
      • Lead the external audit and lender or investor reviews for the portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for auditors.
      • Ensure compliance with project agreements and regulatory and government requirements, and keep controls documented and tested.

        • Team leadership and process

        • Hire, manage, and develop a team of analysts and accountants; set goals, review work, and run performance conversations.
        • Build scalable processes, controls, and systems (including ERP and automation tools) so reporting and compliance keep pace with portfolio growth.
        • Write and maintain policies, procedures, and desk guides for the function.
        • Lead special projects and cross-functional initiatives and represent the function in leadership discussions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.
  • CPA, CFA, MBA, master's in finance, strongly preferred.
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience across project finance, portfolio management, fund accounting, public accounting, or investment banking, including at least 2 years managing people.
  • Deep knowledge of debt agreements, LLC and partnership agreements, and tax equity structures (e.g., partnership flips), and how they drive distributions, waterfalls, and capital account allocations.
  • Expert Excel and modeling skills, including sources and uses, liquidity, waterfall, and covenant compliance models; able to review and challenge others' models.
  • Proven FP&A leadership (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis) and the ability to present results to executives, investors, and lenders.
  • Hands-on experience with the operating phase of infrastructure, real estate, or solar assets, including covenant and DSCR testing, distributions, and lender reporting.
  • Ability to own complex processes independently, make sound judgment calls, and manage relationships with auditors, lenders, investors, and other third parties.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint); ERP experience (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics) a plus.
  • Experience in renewable energy, particularly solar project or fund accounting, is strongly preferred.
Benefits and Perks
We offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work:
  • Training / Professional development opportunities
  • 401(k) with 4% company match
  • Summer Fridays
  • Flexible remote/hybrid work options
  • Paid parental leave
  • Team lunches, events, and stocked kitchens
  • Modern, collaborative office spaces in Asbury Park, New York City, Boston, Chicago, and Baltimore
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and long-term disability insurance
ADA Accommodation Statement
Solar Landscape is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us at hr@solarlandscape.com.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
As a Senior Platform Engineer working within our software engineering group, you’ll design the architecture needed for our test, build and deployment pipelines as well as the services that underpin our factory software. You will guide technical decisions covering our full technology stack including on-prem hardware, hypervisors, container orchestration, platform services, application software, robotics and cloud.

You’ll be a subject matter expert who is able to provide practical help and guidance to allow the whole team to make the most of our platform. This includes advising on regulatory and security best-practices for local continuous integration and remote factory production environments.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll regularly diagnose issues with CI/CD pipelines, perform maintenance, deploy into new factory networks and review the contributions of others in the team.

This is an opportunity to join a truly multi-disciplinary team and broaden your skillset. As well as working within an established software group, you’ll regularly collaborate across robotics, systems engineering and test teams.

What you’ll bring

You’ll have a strong background in the design, implementation and deployment of platform infrastructure and services to enable rapid and robust delivery of software to both in-house and remote environments. Your open and collaborative working style combined with a breadth of technical knowledge will allow you to work effectively with the whole team.

Essential:

  • Excellent understanding of automation tools and scripting for infrastructure and platform management (Terraform, Ansible, python, bash).

  • Ability to design, implement and manage CI/CD pipelines backed by high quality technical documentation. Strong understanding of DevOps best practices (BitBucket/GitHub, Jenkins/CircleCI etc).

  • Practical experience in some of the following: setting up servers, networking, storage, virtualization, containerization or cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure).

  • Experience designing and deploying infrastructure for software delivery to on-prem and remote environments.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when supporting developers and other stakeholders to make best use of our platform.

Desirable:

  • Interest or previous experience working with robotic automation systems or in regulated environments.

  • Understanding of security best-practices in DevOps.

  • Demonstrated ability to gather and refine technical and business requirements.

  • Ability to evaluate and integrate new technologies into an existing platform.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or vocational qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field or equivalent industry experience.

  • 5 years’ experience in software, DevOps, platform or infrastructure roles.

title: Aloitteleva rakennustyöntekijä
description:
Etsimme aloittelevaa RAKENNUSTYÖNTEKIJÄÄ vaihteleviin rakennusalan tehtäviin Tampereen seudulle!

Tämä paikka sopii sinulle, jos haluat kartuttaa kokemusta rakennusalalta, oppia uutta ja päästä tekemään käytännön töitä erilaisilla työmailla. Aikaisempaa kokemusta ei tarvitse olla vielä vuosien edestä, tärkeintä on reipas asenne ja halu tehdä töitä.

Työtehtävät vaihtelevat kohteen ja oman osaamisesi mukaan. Töihin kuuluu mm. avustavia rakennustöitä kokeneemman tekijän parina, purku- ja raivaustöitä, työmaan järjestelyä ja siivousta sekä materiaalien siirtoa.

Hakijalta toivomme:

* Jonkin verran aikaisempaa kokemusta rakennusalalta
* Reipasta ja motivoitunutta asennetta
* Valmiutta fyysiseen työhön
* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääsääntöisesti Tampereen alueella, mutta töitä voi olla myös lähikunnissa. Ajokortti ja auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan siis eduksi.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Töitä on tarjolla sekä yksittäisinä keikkoina että pidempinä työrupeamina työmaiden tarpeiden mukaan. Palkkaus määräytyy hakijan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan (pohjana rakennusalan TES).

Voit hakea tehtävään jättämällä yhteystietosi ja vapaamuotoisen hakemuksen alla olevan linkin kautta. Halutessasi voit liittää mukaan CV:n.



ProROSTERI Henkilöstöratkaisut Oy on vuonna 2019 perustettu pirkanmaalainen henkilöstöalan yritys. Toimintamme on keskittynyt pääsääntöisesti rakennusalan henkilöstöratkaisuihin, ja vuonna 2025 työllistimme yli 200 ammattilaista. ProROSTERIn työntekijänä pääset käsiksi monipuolisiin rakennusalan mahdollisuuksiin erilaisissa yrityksissä. Meille on tärkeää, että hommat hoidetaan hyvällä asenteella, rehellisesti ja asioista puhutaan suoraan. Tarjoamme töitä sekä pitkän kokemuksen omaaville ammattilaisille että työuransa alussa oleville tekijöille. Työntekijöillemme tarjoamme työterveyspalvelut, laadukkaat työvaatteet sekä lippuja urheilutapahtumiin.

title: Senior Engagement Manager
description:
About Gilbert + Tobin

Gilbert + Tobin is built on enduring values of excellence, trust, respect, integrity and good corporate citizenship. We are a leading firm with over 500 lawyers, trusted by our clients to navigate today's increasingly complex world.

We are purpose-built for our clients' most complex work – across transactions, disputes and regulation. Our partners are leaders in their fields, delivering the highest quality legal advice and providing an exceptional edge for our clients. They also provide our lawyers with the opportunity to work alongside and learn from them. We are innovators in the use of technology, redefining value and service in the legal industry.

Our open, merit-based culture attracts and inspires the best legal talent. Founded in 1988, G+T's journey has been one of relentless ambition and rapid progress, achieving extraordinary success in just over three decades.

We remain as determined as ever to be the best it's possible to be.

About the Marketing team

Our Marketing team plays an important role in supporting G+T's strategic priorities, strengthening our brand and enhancing how we engage with our clients, people and the broader market.

Bringing together expertise across communications, digital marketing, business development and client relationship management, the team works collaboratively to deliver creative, commercially focused initiatives that support the firm's continued success.

It's a dynamic and collaborative environment where fresh thinking, initiative and new ideas are encouraged, and where you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects across the firm.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Engagement Manager to join our broader Marketing team in Sydney.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this is a highly visible and influential role responsible for shaping and delivering G+T's internal communications and engagement strategy.

Working closely with our CEO, senior leadership, partners and business services teams, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening how we communicate, connect and engage our people across the firm.

This is an opportunity for a strategic and creative communications professional who enjoys building relationships, influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex business priorities into clear, engaging communications.

You will also take ownership of our recently refreshed intranet and Microsoft Viva Engage platforms, helping us create a more connected, informed and engaged workplace.

Key responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the development and delivery of G+T's internal communications and engagement strategy, ensuring alignment with the firm's business priorities and values.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders, including the CEO, executive leadership and practice group leaders, to develop and deliver communications for key business initiatives and projects.
  • Build strong relationships across the firm, acting as a trusted adviser on internal communications and employee engagement.
  • Oversee the ongoing management, governance and continuous improvement of our intranet and Microsoft Viva Engage platforms.
  • Develop compelling, high-quality content that reflects G+T's tone of voice and strengthens connection across our offices.
  • Support the planning and delivery of key firmwide engagement initiatives and events, including Town Halls, Ops Showcases and the annual Partner Offsite.
  • Collaborate with our Communications and Digital Marketing teams to ensure consistency across internal messaging, campaigns and content.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, emerging technologies and innovative communication approaches to improve efficiency and engagement.
  • Monitor communication effectiveness and engagement, using data, feedback and insights to continuously improve our approach.

About you

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded communications professional who combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution and stakeholder engagement skills.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • Significant experience in internal communications, employee engagement or corporate communications, preferably within a professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and delivering internal communications and engagement strategies across a complex organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence and credibility to advise and influence senior executives, partners and business leaders.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling and engaging content.
  • Experience managing internal communication platforms, including intranets, Microsoft Viva Engage or similar digital engagement tools.
  • Experience supporting firmwide events, change communications and strategic business initiatives.
  • An interest in digital innovation, AI and data-driven approaches to improving communications and engagement.
  • Excellent organisational skills, sound judgement and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

You will be a natural relationship builder who enjoys connecting people, understands the importance of effective communication and brings energy, initiative and a collaborative approach to everything you do.

What we offer you

Gilbert + Tobin offers a friendly, flexible and professional working environment. In addition to top-of-market remuneration, we provide our people with benefits such as up to 26 weeks' paid parental leave, additional annual leave, a subsidised café, subsidised gym membership, end-of-trip facilities, exclusive retail discounts, social events and much more. You can view our full list of benefits here: .

title: VP of Strategy
description:
The VP of Strategy defines and leads the strategic vision for assigned verticals, translating market, client, competitive, and economic insights into actionable strategies that accelerate revenue growth, improve profitability, and strengthen Vericast’s market position. This role leads, develops, and aligns a team of Strategists responsible for partnering with Sales and clients to identify business needs, shape differentiated solutions, and advance high-value opportunities. EQUIPMENT/SOFTWARE UTILIZED

COMMUNICATION AND CONTACTS

DECISION MAKING

Exercises broad decision-making authority over vertical and client strategy, including prioritization of growth initiatives, allocation of strategist resources, team structure, client focus areas, and strategic recommendations.

Applicants should possess an earned PhD degree in Civil Engineering or closely related field from a reputable university and have at least one earned degree at any level in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited program or provide evidence of teaching coursework at an ABET accredited program. A sustained and successful track record of attaining research or commercial funding and publications in internationally recognized quality journals and conferences associated with high Scopus h-index are essential. Applicants with commitment to professional activities, professional engineering registration, knowledge of the practice of civil engineering and potential to establish an externally funded research program are highly desirable.

What we offer:

· Competitive salary and 2-course teaching load per semester
· Generous research time
· Research seed grants and other competitive research funding opportunities
· Selected conference and travel funding
· International health insurance
· Expatriate benefits (rent-free housing, home travel (one per annum), child education allowance, assistance for relocation expenses including air fares for the appointee and dependents)
· Paid home leave of 56 days per annum

Initial appointment is on a 3-year renewable contract and subsequent appointments can be 5-year/3-year renewable subject to annual performance reviews.

Application Information: Applicants should send a detailed CV, cover letter and three references letters, teaching and research statements, and list of publications via Smart recruiters system at https://smrtr.io/3VgP6

Review of applications is expected to begin soon and continue until the position is filled. Applicants on the shortlist will be called for interviews.

Successful appointments are expected to begin in August, 2027. Additional information can be found on our website (www.nu.edu.kz).

title: Senior User Researcher
description:
What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a skilled practitioner with significant experience in delivering user research projects. The focus of your role will be to plan, facilitate and lead user research activities on a variety of projects. You’ll often be working with multidisciplinary teams on complex projects where autonomy and project management will be important.

We’re on the hunt for someone who will champion our values: to care passionately, be fluent in people, believe in your craft, push convention, be open to change, and to value each other.

We work with a broad range of clients, some of whom are completely new to user-centred design (UCD). This means you’ll also play a key role in championing our UCD approach.

The role may also involve:

  • Leading and directing projects – You’ll lead the planning and delivery of research activities with multidisciplinary teams and clients in the pursuit of inclusive, accessible and effective research outcomes.
  • Supporting or delivering other practices - We're looking for someone who's keen to get involved with activities beyond user research - mainly other UCD practices, but also working closely with roles such as Business Analyses and Technical Architecture.

Team support and management – You’ll help to support the user research team by inspiring and line managing team members, including overseeing appraisals and professional development.

  • Defining and refining practice – You’ll help to define the way our disciplines work together, and progress the way NEC Digital Studio delivers inclusive, accessible, and effective design.
  • Supporting new business – You’ll help NEC Digital Studio identify and win projects by spotting opportunities with clients and helping with proposals and pitches.

How we work:

We work with central and local government, the NHS, voluntary, not-for-profit, and private sector organisations.

We work hand-in-hand with our clients and sometimes we’re embedded in their teams for projects. Beyond individual projects, NEC Digital Studio’s User Researchers support each other at weekly meet-ups where we share our work, discuss its wider implications, and learn about methods.

You’ll also broaden your skills by working closely with members of our Digital teams, including service and interaction designers, and developers.

All of our user researchers are supported by more senior members of the user research team. They look after your wellbeing, help you set goals and objectives and provide feedback to help you grow.

    We’d like to hear from you if you have skills or experience in these areas:

    • Multidisciplinary teams – Leading and advocating for, the user research activities on a project. Working with the wider team (including Service Design and Digital roles) to deliver insightful project outcomes
    • Inclusive research – Conducting user research in ethical and trauma-informed ways that ensures the safety of everyone involved. This includes actively identifying accessibility needs of users and being confident in making adjustments for these.
    • User Research to GDS standards – planning and conducting research activities across the different agile phases of a project.
    • Facilitation – skilled in a variety of sessions, from user interviews and usability testing to co-design, co-analysis and co-synthesis sessions; guiding other stakeholders through these, clearly explaining the processes to enable them to engage fully and contribute.
    • Qualitative analysis and synthesis – working with findings from user research to produce representative user journeys, user stories and user needs.
    • Recommendation and implementation – Work collaboratively with the wider design team, experts and clients to produce clear insights that will enable project teams to make informed design decisions.
    • Service Design – you have an interest in the discipline or experience in service design thinking and outcomes
    • Product and UX Design – you have worked with a range of digital design disciplines
    • Written communication – write and share findings in an engaging and meaningful way to colleagues and stakeholders.
    • Proactive and autonomous – you can lead the conversation, and look for ways to participate and add value
    • Stakeholder management – you know how to negotiate and guide clients and stakeholders towards positive outcomes that deliver outcomes within budget.
    • Managing complexity and ambiguity – UCD projects are complex and messy! You’re up for leaping into the unknown, supporting our team members and clients to navigate the uncertainty that comes with UCD projects

    Additional experience:

    • Justice experience: You have prior experience working in the justice domain
    • T-shaped practitioner: Whilst we have specific practices for UCD at NEC, we are ideally looking for candidates who can apply themselves (with guidance) to other UCD and technology practices

    We pride ourselves in offering an excellent benefits package, including an above average pension scheme. When you join the team at NEC Software Solutions, you are provided with the following:

    • Private Medical Cover funded by NEC for Employees (with the option to add family members at an additional cost)
    • 25 days paid holiday with the option to buy/sell (FTE)
    • 4 x basic salary life assurance cover funded by NEC (with the option to increase cover at an additional cost)
    • A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions up to a maximum of 8.5%
    • A selection of flexible benefits to suit your individual needs
    • All colleagues get free access to LinkedIn Learning. Over 15,000 courses covering a huge breadth of subjects. Learn about what you like, when you like, how you like.
    • Give back days
    • Annual team and company away-days

    Other information:

    • Candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. Documentary evidence will be required.
    • All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting, references and occupational health checks.
    • Depending on the nature of the role a Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check may also be required.

    NEC Software Solutions is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from all communities. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have specific accessibility needs during the recruitment or interview process, please feel free to share these with us. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accommodating experience for all candidates.

    We receive applicants from multiple different sources - so the application process may vary. Once you have chosen to apply the key things we would like to see in your applications are:

    • A CV
    • A Cover Letter - tell us why you think you’d a good fit for the role and why you want to work for NEC Digital Studio. Please aim to keep your covering letter to 1000 words.

    Come join us and make a difference in the world!

    We’re NECSWS. While you read this ad, our software is helping to dispatch ambulances, support families, keep trains on the move, locate missing people and even test the hearing of newborn babies.

    Working with us, you’ll be helping our 3,000+ employees push the boundaries of what’s possible and support amazing public services.

    We work with governments, hospitals, police forces, housing providers, local authorities, charities and more. We help them pay financial support faster, improve diagnosis and treatments for patients and respond to emergencies in the right way. The more we do, the more our customers can do for others. And together, we make a world of difference.

    At NEC Digital Studio, we believe in design practices that make the world more human.

    NEC Digital Studio was created to put people at the centre of services, positively changing how they experience the world. Everything we design, build and maintain is made for life.

    Our mission is to empower organisations to be more effective, inclusive and sustainable, through tools, systems and experiences that are intelligent, integrated and intuitive for all.

    As a people-first digital studio, we are designing and developing evidence-led solutions at scale to transform the services used by everyone, every day. We specialise in working with seldom heard voices and diverse user groups. We practice participatory co-design and ethical research. Our teams are experts in accessibility and digital inclusion

    We’d love your help. And we’ll support you all the way. Discover more at NEC Digital Studio | Made for Life (necsws.com)

title: Software Engineer II (Hybrid - 2x/week)
description:
About the role:

As a Software Engineer II on the storeLink engineering team, you will design, develop, and support key features for our cloud-native retail management platform. storeLink empowers grocery and drug retailers across three core operational capabilities: in-store price tag printing, Electronic Shelf Label (ESL) device management, and digital video screen display management. Operating within an Azure-hosted microservices architecture, you will work closely with dedicated feature sprint teams, our Principal Architect, and L2 Technical Support Engineers to deliver reliable, high-performance web applications and API integrations.

This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days/week in-office. Currently we are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our offices in Little Rock, AR; Dallas, TX; Mentor, OH; Miamisburg, OH; and New Century, KS.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Full-Stack Feature Development: Design, build, test, and maintain scalable microservices using .NET Core for backend web APIs and modern Angular for front-end web interfaces.

  • Database & Cloud Infrastructure: Maintain and optimize MS SQL data structures, leverage Azure AI Search, and support applications hosted on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure Front Door, and Application Insights.

  • API Integration & Services: Integrate storeLink microservices with external systems via REST APIs, including custom rendering engines (such as UE2) for PDF and PNG media generation.

  • CI/CD & Production Support: Manage GitHub version control, build/release pipelines using GitHub Actions, and partner with L2 support to triage and resolve escalated production issues.

  • Quality, Compliance & Agile Methods: Implement unit/automated integration tests, adhere to internal security and SOX 404 controls, and participate in Agile code reviews and task estimation.

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field with 4+ years of software development experience (or MS with 1+ years).

  • Proven experience building enterprise web applications using .NET Core, C#, Angular, and RESTful Web APIs within a microservices architecture.

  • Strong proficiency in MS SQL / T-SQL development, schema design, query optimization, and working with managed database instances.

title: Senior Director - Payments Strategy
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Senior Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our clinical trial payments solution, Veeva Payments, within the Veeva Clinical Operations suite.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Payments solution. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial budgeting, site contracting, and investigator payments within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how sponsors and CROs budget, contract, and pay clinical research sites.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of Veeva Payments among Life Sciences companies (Sponsors, CROs, and emerging biotechs), aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
  • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a connected payments solution in improving site payment speed, budget visibility, financial accuracy, and site satisfaction
  • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native payments application that generates payable items directly from trial execution data, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure revenue goals are achieved
  • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical trial payments and site financial technology at key industry events, conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Payments roadmap based on market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
  • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on site payment and trial budgeting pain points, identify emerging trends in site financial management and investigator retention, and provide actionable insights to enhance the Payments product and overall business strategy

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
  • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations and finance leaders, and C-level executives)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

  • Payments Domain Expertise: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy or implementation for clinical trial payment or site financial management solutions; understanding the nuances of fee schedules, clinical trial agreements, study budgets, and accounts payable integration is a core competency
  • Clinical Operations Expertise: Specific experience with the operational and financial workflows of clinical research sites, sponsors, and CROs
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and the compliance considerations of investigator payments, including fair market value and transparency reporting
  • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $150,000 - $300,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Perception Verification and Validation team. The team is responsible for verifying and validating the perception stack of our autonomous driving system by building the metrics, datasets, and analyses that tell us how perception performance translates into driving behavior. As a senior member of the team, you will own the evaluation strategy for major perception capabilities from start to finish, partnering with perception and ML engineers, systems and safety engineers, and autonomy leadership to decide what to measure, how to measure it with statistical rigor, and what the results mean for release decisions.

Your work will directly shape how Zoox safely and efficiently ships perception improvements to our fleet, connecting model-level performance to end-to-end system behavior. You will also help raise the bar for the team by mentoring other data scientists and setting technical direction for how we validate perception.

In this role, you will...

  • Lead the design of metrics and evaluation frameworks for new perception capabilities, partnering with perception engineers early in model development to define what "ready to ship" means and how it connects to end-to-end driving behavior.

  • Drive cross-team validation projects, bringing together perception, systems, safety, and autonomy stakeholders to build consensus on metrics, evaluation datasets, and release criteria.

  • Develop rigorous statistical methods for uncertainty quantification, error estimation, and error propagation (frequentist, bootstrap, and Bayesian) so teams know when changes in performance are real.

  • Build evaluation datasets and analyze large-scale, highly geospatial fleet and simulation data to uncover perception failure modes, then turn findings into clear recommendations for engineering and executive leadership.

  • Mentor and guide a small group of data scientists by defining tasks, reviewing their work, and raising the team's technical bar.

Requirements:

  • Master's degree with 7+ years of experience, or PhD with 3+ years of experience, in data science, applied science, or a related quantitative role (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field).

  • Expert proficiency with SQL and/or Spark (PySpark or Scala) and Python, with a track record of building production-quality analyses and pipelines on large-scale (terabyte+) distributed data.

  • Deep expertise in statistical modeling, inference, and decision making, including uncertainty quantification, and a history of connecting point and uncertainty estimates to high-stakes decisions.

  • Experience designing metrics and validating ML models, such as computer vision, sensor-based, or perception models, including discovering and measuring failure modes.

  • Demonstrated track record of leading technical projects across teams, mentoring other data scientists or engineers, and presenting results and recommendations to senior leadership.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with autonomous driving, robotics, or other safety-critical systems, including system-level verification and validation or simulation.

  • Experience analyzing geospatial data and/or working with embeddings (e.g., similarity search, representation learning).

  • Skilled at using AI tools to improve development efficiency and quality.

Compensation:

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.


About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. title: Programme Manager
description:
The Role

The Programme Manager - GTM is responsible for leading and coordinating the end-to-end go-to-market process for new products and commercial initiatives across Fastmarkets.

Working across Product, Commercial, Marketing and Analytics teams, the role ensures products are brought to market efficiently, governance processes are followed, and commercial objectives are achieved. The role focuses on programme delivery, stakeholder alignment, performance monitoring and continuous improvement of the go-to-market operating model.

Principal Accountabilities

Go-to-Market Programme Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end GTM programme lifecycle, from opportunity assessment through to launch and post-launch performance review.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on product positioning, pricing, packaging, target customer segments and launch activities.
  • Facilitate Commercial & Product Squad meetings and product performance reviews.
  • Ensure all functions remain aligned on priorities, timelines, deliverables and commercial objectives.

Programme Delivery & Governance

  • Develop and manage programme plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and issues.
  • Establish and maintain governance processes, decision gates and approval frameworks.
  • Manage Go/No-Go approval processes and ensure launch readiness requirements are completed.
  • Maintain RAID logs and ensure risks and issues are actively managed and escalated where appropriate.
  • Manage programme budgets, forecasts and expenditure across CapEx and OpEx.

Commercial Performance

  • Produce regular programme updates, executive reports and decision papers for senior stakeholders.
  • Support cross-functional decision making through data-driven insights and performance analysis.
  • Ensure clear accountability for commercial outcomes across Product, Marketing and Commercial teams.

Change Management & Business Readiness

  • Support business readiness activities including communication, training and adoption planning.
  • Ensure successful transition of products and initiatives into business-as-usual operations.
  • Track benefits realisation and coordinate corrective action where expected outcomes are at risk.
  • Drive continuous improvement of GTM processes and ways of working.

AI & Process Improvement

  • Use AI-enabled tools to support programme planning, reporting, risk management and stakeholder communications.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness across the GTM lifecycle through technology and automation.
  • Promote adoption of AI-enhanced working practices where appropriate.

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

Essential

  • Significant experience delivering go-to-market programmes within a B2B subscription, SaaS, information services or data-driven business.
  • Proven track record managing cross-functional programmes involving Product, Marketing, Commercial and Analytics teams.
  • Strong programme management experience, including governance, risk management, stakeholder management and benefits realisation.
  • Experience supporting product launches and commercialisation activities from concept through to post-launch review.
  • Strong commercial awareness with the ability to interpret performance metrics and translate insights into action.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior leaders.
  • Experience using programme management tools and CRM systems such as Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, MS Project and Salesforce.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable

  • Experience within information services, market intelligence, financial data, price reporting or related subscription-based industries.
  • Understanding of subscription business models, customer lifecycle management and revenue operations.
  • Professional qualifications such as APM, PRINCE2, MSP, PMI or equivalent.
  • Experience using AI tools to support programme delivery and business processes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience.
  • Programme or project management qualifications desirable.

KEY STAKEHOLDER RELATIONSHIPS

  • Product Leadership
  • Commercial Leadership
  • Marketing Leadership
  • Analytics & Data Teams
  • COO Office
  • Senior Leadership Team

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Successful delivery of GTM programmes to agreed scope, quality, budget and timelines.
  • Improved speed and effectiveness of product launches.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and cross-functional alignment.
  • Achievement of agreed commercial and adoption targets.
  • Effective management of programme risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Successful handover of initiatives into business-as-usual operations.

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets

We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based.

Specific benefits may vary by country and role.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.
