  • Coordinate inbound and outbound semester exchange programs with partner institutions.
  • Ensure exchange agreements are maximized and exchange opportunities are effectively managed.
  • Support exchange logistics including admissions, course mapping, orientations, and student onboarding.
  • Deliver pre-departure and re-entry programming for outbound students.
  • Provide ongoing support to students before, during, and after their exchange experience.
  • Train and support students, staff, and faculty participating in exchange and international mobility programs.

International Delegations & Global Programs

  • Coordinate and host international visitors and partner delegations.
  • Manage logistics including accommodations, transportation, cultural activities, schedules, and gifts.
  • Support the delivery of Global Education Network (GEN) initiatives, including short-term programs, professional development opportunities, and inbound educational experiences.
  • Act as a key liaison between SAIT stakeholders and international partners.

Study Canada Mobility Programs

  • Support faculty and staff in developing and implementing Study Canada initiatives.
  • Guide stakeholders through program approval and risk management processes.
  • Monitor and mitigate risks associated with student travel and mobility activities.
  • Serve as the primary contact during travel-related incidents or emergencies.

Program Administration, Reporting & Evaluation

  • Maintain accurate records of all inbound and outbound mobility participants and activities.
  • Manage and update student mobility software and databases.
  • Track participation, satisfaction, and program performance metrics.
  • Prepare reports and provide data to support program planning and continuous improvement.

Communications & Promotion

  • Promote Study Abroad opportunities through information sessions, events, presentations, and outreach activities.
  • Update web and internal communication channels with current program information.
  • Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to develop promotional materials.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively with the Study Abroad Project Manager and International Centre team to support strategic objectives.

What you bring

Education & Experience

  • Undergraduate degree required; graduate degree considered an asset.
  • Minimum three years of experience coordinating programs, projects, or events with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience working within established budgets and managing competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Knowledge of international education, student mobility, or partnership development.
  • First-hand study abroad, international exchange, or international travel experience is highly desirable.

    • Preferred

    • 3-5 years of experience in a post-secondary environment.
    • Experience supporting student mobility, international education, or global learning initiatives.

    Skills & Competencies

    • Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
    • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication abilities.
    • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with students, faculty, and external partners.
    • Strong intercultural awareness and communication skills.
    • Experience using Microsoft Office and database management systems.
    • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

title: SentinelOne Engineer (R-00249)
description:
About True Zero Technologies

True Zero Technologies is a veteran-owned small business founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology directly drives the quality of an organization’s outcomes. We design and deliver cybersecurity programs and software solutions that empower federal, state and local government, education, and commercial leaders to run a proactive defense with better intelligence and more efficient collaboration. Recent recognitions include Inc. Magazine’s 2026 Best Workplaces list and awarded positions on Fairfax County VA Cybersecurity Program, Montana ITS Contract, Kansas Services MSA, DARPA’s MANNUS IDIQ, NASA SEWP VI, and the $151B SHIELD contract.

Our endpoint and detection engineering practice helps organizations get full value out of the SentinelOne platform — governance first, integrated with Zero Trust architecture, and aligned to the NIST Risk Management Framework and NIST SP 800-53. We build secure, highly tuned detection and response capabilities that keep critical systems protected without overwhelming security teams with noise.

Position Overview

True Zero is seeking a Certified SentinelOne Engineer to lead the ongoing operations, tuning, and optimization of SentinelOne across secure, mission-critical environments — including use of the platform as a SIEM for centralized log management, detection, and correlation. This is a senior technical role for an engineer who pairs deep, hands-on SentinelOne expertise with the judgment to guide teams, engage clients, and deliver production-grade, highly reliable endpoint and SIEM operations.

The ideal candidate holds current SentinelOne Certified Engineer status and brings a track record of running and continuously optimizing SentinelOne in production — tuning detection policies, managing the agent fleet, and operating SentinelOne’s SIEM capabilities for log ingestion, correlation, and alerting. Experience supporting state government customers is a strong plus, given True Zero’s growing work across SLED environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Operations: Own the day-to-day administration of SentinelOne across managed environments, including agent deployment, policy management, and fleet health.
  • SIEM Operations & Optimization: Operate and continuously optimize SentinelOne’s SIEM capabilities — log ingestion, correlation rules, dashboards, and alerting — to maximize detection coverage and minimize false positives.
  • Detection Engineering & Tuning: Design, tune, and validate detection policies and Deep Visibility/Storyline queries to keep pace with evolving threats while reducing analyst noise.
  • Incident Response Support: Support triage, investigation, and remediation of SentinelOne-detected threats, including threat hunting and root-cause analysis.
  • Systems Integration: Integrate SentinelOne with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and other security tooling to ensure seamless data flow and unified workflows.
  • Performance & Health Monitoring: Monitor agent health, policy coverage, and platform performance; identify and remediate gaps across the managed fleet.
  • Upgrades & Lifecycle Management: Manage SentinelOne upgrades, policy version control, and lifecycle changes with minimal operational disruption.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure SentinelOne operations align with regulatory and security requirements, including NIST SP 800-53 and Zero Trust principles, and state-specific requirements where applicable.
  • Reporting: Deliver technical reports on endpoint and SIEM health, detection posture, and tuning outcomes with clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Client Collaboration: Engage with clients and stakeholders throughout the engagement lifecycle, including state government customers where assigned.
  • Team Development: Coach and mentor junior engineers on SentinelOne operations and detection engineering best practices.

Qualification & Requirements

  • Certification: Must be a SentinelOne Certified Engineer (current certification required).
  • Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years in endpoint security, detection engineering, or SOC operations, with substantial hands-on SentinelOne administration.
  • SIEM Operations: Required: experience with the ongoing operations and optimization of SentinelOne as a SIEM platform, including log management, correlation, and alert tuning.
  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR administration, policy tuning, Deep Visibility/Storyline queries, and threat hunting workflows.
  • Systems Integration: Experience integrating EDR/SIEM platforms with SOAR, ticketing, and broader security tooling.
  • Governance: Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, Zero Trust architecture principles, and general security compliance frameworks.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills to convey technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting state government (SLED) customers is a plus.
  • Additional security certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, GCIH, or equivalent) are a plus.
  • Experience with other EDR/SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, CrowdStrike) is a plus.
  • Prior experience at a Veteran-Owned Small Business or similar government-focused contractor is a plus.

What We Offer

Team members at True Zero enjoy:

  • A competitive salary, paid twice per month
  • Best-in-class medical coverage — 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero
  • Companywide new business incentive programs

ABOUT YWCA SEATTLE | KING | SNOHOMISH

YWCA Seattle | King | Snohomish is dedicated to eliminating racism, empowering women, and promoting peace, justice, freedom, and dignity for all. Through services that support housing stability, health and safety, and economic advancement, YWCA works alongside individuals and families to address barriers and create opportunities for lasting stability.

This position requires an understanding of how racism, sexism, poverty, and other forms of oppression affect the communities we serve. Applying antiracism principles in everyday work, working effectively across cultures, and advancing equitable services and outcomes are essential to this role.

POSITION SUMMARY

Basic Food Employment and Training (BFET) is a program that helps eligible people receiving Washington’s Basic Food benefits build skills and prepare for employment. Through career planning, job search assistance, education, training, and connections to supportive services, BFET helps participants pursue employment and greater financial stability.

The BFET Career Navigator works directly with participants to understand their strengths, interests, and goals and develop an individualized employment plan. This includes helping participants explore career options, access training, prepare resumes and applications, and connect with employers. The Career Navigator also helps participants address challenges such as transportation, childcare, or access to technology that may affect their ability to participate in training or maintain employment.

Using a strengths-based, participant-centered, and culturally responsive approach, this position provides ongoing coaching, coordinates resources with YWCA colleagues and community partners, and maintains accurate records to support participant progress and meet program requirements.

WORK ARRANGEMENT: This position works 100% onsite. Hybrid and remote work are not available. Travel to other YWCA sites and community locations may be required.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Participant Support and Career Navigation

  • Recruit and enroll eligible participants, complete assessments, and develop individualized employment plans based on participants’ strengths, interests, and goals.
  • Provide career coaching and practical assistance with resumes, interviews, job searches, online applications, and basic digital skills.
  • Connect participants with education, vocational training, and employment opportunities that align with their goals.
  • Help participants access transportation, childcare, housing resources, and other supports that address barriers to employment.
  • Maintain regular contact with participants to support progress, job retention, and career advancement.

Partnerships and Outreach

  • Build relationships with employers, training providers, WorkSource, and community organizations to expand participant opportunities.
  • Coordinate referrals and services with YWCA colleagues and external partners.
  • Participate in community events, job fairs, and partner meetings to recruit participants and share program resources.

Program Records and Accountability

  • Verify eligibility and maintain timely, accurate, and confidential participant records in eJAS and other required systems.
  • Document services, participant progress, reimbursements, and employment outcomes in accordance with program requirements.
  • Support reporting, file reviews, and program monitoring by keeping documentation complete and addressing needed corrections.
  • Participate in required training and team meetings, stay informed about BFET requirements, and contribute to improvements in participant services.
  • Apply antiracism, trauma-informed practices, and respect for participant choice throughout daily work.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least one year of experience supporting people through employment services, community programs, education, housing, customer service, or a related setting. Relevant volunteer experience, community involvement, and transferable skills will be considered.
  • A combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the role. A college degree is not required.
  • Ability to build respectful, supportive relationships with people from diverse backgrounds and work collaboratively with colleagues and community partners.
  • Understanding of barriers that may affect employment, such as poverty, racism, housing instability, limited access to childcare, or transportation challenges.
  • Commitment to YWCA’s mission and willingness to learn and apply antiracist, culturally responsive, and trauma-informed practices.
  • Clear communication, listening, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to help participants identify goals and navigate resources.
  • Ability to organize work, follow through on commitments, maintain accurate records, and protect confidential information.
  • Basic computer skills, including email, word processing, and online applications, with the ability to learn required databases.
  • Ability to travel between worksites and community locations as needed.

Helpful but not required

  • Familiarity with BFET, eJAS, WorkSource, or King County employment and community resources.
  • Experience helping others with job searches, resumes, applications, or access to community services.
  • Experience working with communities of color or people experiencing economic or housing instability.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. In performing this position, the employee:

  • All positions at YWCA Seattle | King | Snohomish are exposed to clients who have experienced or are experiencing trauma in various forms including but not limited to domestic violence, sexual violence, homelessness, unemployment, financial hardship, etc. As a result, staff are at risk of secondary trauma. Employees are encouraged to seek external support and maintain self-care when working indirectly or directly with clients.
  • Regularly communicate with participants, colleagues, employers, and community partners.
  • Use a computer and other office equipment to maintain records and provide services.
  • Sit, stand, walk, and travel to community meetings, events, and partner locations.
  • Lift and carry program materials, typically up to 5 pounds and occasionally up to 40 pounds.
  • Occasionally bend, reach, or stand for extended periods during outreach activities and job fairs.

title: School Leaver Programme, Audit - Tunbridge Wells (Sept 2027)
description:
Why Start Your Career at S&W?

Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your achievements and supports you to be yourself.

At S&W, you'll be given meaningful responsibility from the start, alongside the support and guidance needed to help you succeed. You'll learn from experienced colleagues, develop valuable professional skills and build confidence as your career progresses.

As one of the UK's fastest-growing accountancy and advisory firms, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career.

No previous experience in accountancy, finance or professional services is required. We're looking for people with the right attitude and potential to succeed. If you're curious, eager to learn and ready to challenge yourself, we'll provide the training, support and opportunities to help you make the most of your potential.

The Audit & Assurance Team at S&W

Our Audit & Assurance team works with a diverse range of clients, from entrepreneurial and family-owned businesses to charities, not-for-profit organisations and larger established businesses across a variety of industries.

What sets Audit & Assurance at S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain early in your career. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial awareness and a well-rounded understanding of how organisations operate, while working closely with experienced colleagues and gaining exposure to senior leaders and Partners. Together, this provides a strong foundation for a successful career in the profession.

Why Join our Tunbridge Wells office?

Our Tunbridge Wells office is easily accessible by car or via train, with the office being a 10–15 minute walk from Tunbridge Wells station. There are lots of surrounding green spaces and the office is also a short walk from the town. Our office is open plan with all departments working together on a fantastic mix of clients across a diverse range of industries. Our audit team is growing, and you'll be around plenty of other recent graduates and school leavers who have joined in recent years.

What Will You Be Doing?

As part of our Audit & Assurance team, you'll work alongside colleagues to deliver services to a variety of clients. You'll be involved in different stages of an engagement, gaining insight into how organisations operate and the role assurance plays in building confidence in financial reporting.

Your work will include:

  • Analysing financial information
  • Testing processes and controls
  • Building relationships with client teams
  • Resolving audit and accountancy queries
  • Supporting a range of audit and accountancy projects

Whether you're based in one of our offices or working directly with clients, you'll contribute to meaningful work from day one while building your knowledge, skills and confidence.

Alongside your role, you'll study towards the Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA) qualification, a prestigious qualification equivalent to a Level 7 Master's degree. Through a combination of professional training and practical experience, you'll build a strong foundation in audit, accountancy and wider business advisory services.

You'll be fully supported throughout your studies with funded training, dedicated study time, guidance from experienced colleagues and a network of people who want to see you succeed.

To Be Successful in This Role

You'll be someone who:

  • Is curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges
  • Enjoys working with others and building positive relationships
  • Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems
  • Is proactive and looks for ways to make a positive contribution
  • Takes ownership of their development and is motivated to achieve their goals

You'll also need to:

  • Be committed to working towards the Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA) Level 7 professional qualification
  • Have a minimum of 112 UCAS points from your top three A Levels (or equivalent), excluding General Studies
  • Have achieved a minimum Grade 5 (or equivalent) in GCSE English Language and Maths

No previous experience in accountancy, finance or professional services is required.

Your Learning & Development

We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning.

You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a strong support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team. From your first day, you'll have people around you to guide you, answer questions and help you make the most of every opportunity.

As a Colleague at S&W, You'll Have Access to Benefits That Include

  • Fully funded training towards professional qualifications
  • Competitive salary
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Pension contribution
  • Generous holiday package
  • Option to purchase additional holiday
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Season ticket loan
  • Eye care support
  • Shared parental leave

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.

We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know.

IMPORTANT NOTES FOR COMPLETING YOUR APPLICATION

When you click on the 'I'm interested' button, you'll be taken to your profile page. We're currently updating it, but in the meantime:

  • We can only accept one application to any of our programmes in a recruitment season. If you're unsuccessful, you'll need to wait until the following recruitment season to reapply.
  • Under the Resume (CV) section, uploading a document is mandatory; however, it will not be formally reviewed.

title: Associate Consultant, September 2027
description:
Our early careers opportunities have a strong record of establishing early career foundations and developing well-rounded industry skills in our Associate Consultants.

You will work on a diverse mix of international projects with the best-known brands in the industry, applying our deep domain expertise and methodology to solve complex business issues.

You will attend our comprehensive training programme where you will learn essential consulting skills and industry knowledge through courses, networking and teamwork.

After completing the training, you will join project teams and provide strategic advice and high-quality analysis on all aspects of strategy planning, transaction support, regulation and policy while continuing your professional development. Our international client base means you will have opportunities to work with colleagues and clients across different countries, with travel depending on the needs of each project.

Because our project teams are small, you will regularly get direct exposure to our world-class experts, not only in your office, but also across our global locations. You will receive hands-on mentoring from experienced members of the team, including our Partners.

Our culture is collaborative and team-oriented. You will work in project teams and contribute directly to client deliverables from an early stage, taking ownership of research, analysis and problem-solving as you develop your consulting skills. This provides a steep learning curve and structured career progression.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • conducting high-quality research
  • offering quantitative and qualitative analysis of that research
  • gathering and interpreting numerical data
  • using the latest AI tools alongside traditional research and analytical methods
  • modelling and forecasting using various pieces of software
  • presenting your main findings in written, graphical and live form
  • contributing to proposal creation and client meetings
  • collaborating with other teams across our global locations
  • developing deep sector knowledge
  • and more.

If you are a problem-solver who is critical and analytical in your approach, then this is the right job for you.

You must have graduated by September 2027, or earlier, and you must have a degree from any academic background (including STEM, Humanities and others) from a top tier university.

You must enjoy working with numbers as we are a quantitative data-driven business. You should also be curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and interested in how they can be used to approach problems in new and effective ways.

As long as you are keen to learn about the sectors, you do not need to have an industry background. As a matter of fact, many of our consultants only became experts after joining us.

You must be fluent in Swedish and English.

On top of an exciting opportunity, we offer many attractive benefits, including:

  • annual bonus
  • 30 days of annual leave
  • employer pension contribution
  • private health and dental care
  • mental wellbeing app
  • flexible working
  • your birthday off
  • stepped career progression
  • continuous training for professional and personal development
  • career coaching programmes
  • volunteering days
  • Cycle-to-work scheme.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunities employer and ensure fair work practices for all our employees, clients, candidates and other associated persons.

title: Senior Projectmanager PMO
description:
Hoe voeg jij waarde toe?
In deze rol:

  • vertaal je complexe opdrachten binnen de PMO-governance naar een heldere scope, concrete resultaten, een uitvoerbaar projectplan en duidelijke besluitmomenten;
  • stuur je actief op uitvoering, planning, budget, kwaliteit en resultaat en zorg je dat acties en besluiten worden opgevolgd;
  • coördineer je projectteams, leveranciers en stakeholders en spreek je hen aan op bijdragen, afspraken en verantwoordelijkheden;
  • signaleer en beheers je risico’s, issues en afhankelijkheden, organiseer je tijdig oplossingen en escaleer je waar nodig;
  • leid je implementaties en begeleid je de verandering, zodat resultaten duurzaam worden geborgd in processen, systemen, werkwijzen en de lijnorganisatie.


PMO als versneller van verandering
Je werkt binnen een professioneel PMO dat de strategische veranderopgave van BDO ondersteunt en versnelt. Eenduidige werkwijzen, heldere governance en professioneel opdrachtgever- en opdrachtnemerschap vormen de basis voor effectieve uitvoering. Samen met management, senior stakeholders en professionals stuur je projecten waarin inhoud, processen, systemen en uiteenlopende belangen samenkomen. Je neemt positie in, organiseert voortgang en bent zichtbaar verantwoordelijk voor realisatie en duurzame implementatie.

Dit zijn jouw kwaliteiten
Je bent een ervaren projectmanager die methodiek combineert met pragmatisme en daadkracht. Je brengt snel structuur aan, doorziet uiteenlopende belangen en houdt onder druk koers. Je stuurt scherp op resultaat, maakt verwachtingen expliciet en weet wanneer overleg volstaat en wanneer besluitvorming moet worden afgedwongen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • wo-werk- en -denkniveau;
  • ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig leiden van complexe, organisatiebrede projecten en implementaties;
  • aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met professioneel projectmanagement;
  • een sterk trackrecord in het daadwerkelijk opleveren en implementeren van projectresultaten;
  • gedegen kennis van projectplanning, scope-, tijd- en budgetbeheersing;
  • ruime ervaring met risico- en issuemanagement;
  • uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, ook op senior managementniveau;
  • ervaring met verander- en implementatiemanagement;
  • analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen;
  • organisatiesensitiviteit en bestuurlijke stevigheid;
  • sterke mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden;
  • het vermogen om mensen aan te spreken, verwachtingen expliciet te maken en waar nodig tijdig te escaleren.

Bovenal heb je executiekracht. Je neemt eigenaarschap, houdt tempo en bent pas tevreden wanneer projecten aantoonbaar bijdragen aan de verandering van BDO en het resultaat duurzaam in de organisatie is verankerd.

Echte waarde is meer dan geld
Bij BDO kan je rekenen op een salaris dat past bij wat je doet én wat je kunt. Tel hierbij op:

  • een mobiliteits- of leasebudget.
  • 22 vakantiedagen + 10 flexdagen per kalenderjaar. Wil je nog meer vrije tijd? In overleg kun je extra flexdagen kopen.
  • een pensioenpremieregeling bij Nationale Nederlanden waar je 2% aan bijdraagt. Ook ben jij verzekerd voor een nabestaandenpensioen.
  • direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.

Er is meer. Ga voor een compleet overzicht van de arbeidsvoorwaarden naar werkenbijbdo.nl/arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Kom werken bij BDO en ga voor echte waarde
Reageren op deze vacature? Natuurlijk.

Heb jij eerst nog vragen? Marleen Maassen geeft je antwoord via 040 - 269 8255 en/of marleen.maassen@bdo.nl.

title: Ambulatory Solution Adoption Project Manager
description:
ABOUT THIS POSITION

The Strategic Project Manager is responsible for the successful implementation of Waystar solutions by leading the team and the client project team. This engagement begins with the sales transition to implementation, the move to production and the transition of the solution and client to the Waystar Enterprise Support Team. Individuals in this position are expected to have or develop a specific knowledge of Waystar’s business, industry, and operations, including an intimate understanding of healthcare specific billing requirements, reimbursement, enrollment, and patient billing and payments. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to interact with some of the largest, most successful and prestigious Healthcare Enterprise organizations in the U.S.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Oversee and manage all aspects of the project implementation; including product solutions and associated revenue

  • Understand and support the client project success criteria and goals

  • Define and communicate project plan updates to the Waystar team and client project manager

  • Manage project status, issue list, and risk management reporting

  • Act as primary contact to the client for project and milestone issues

  • Coordinate Waystar project team resources and deliverables

  • Deliver monthly internal project status report out

  • Coordinate monthly strategic review sessions with client and Waystar leadership

  • Document client set-up information and specifics for the Transition Document

  • Perform other duties and /or projects as assigned by management within the area of responsibility

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor degree is required

  • Exceptional critical thinking and analytical skills

  • Healthcare billing or healthcare operations experience required preferably institutional and provider billing knowledge

  • Project management experience working with large healthcare organizations preferred

  • Excellent Organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple projects concurrently

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills required. Must be able to clearly and effectively communicate the results of implementations with team members, clients, and vendor partners

ABOUT WAYSTAR

Through a smart platform and better experience, Waystar helps providers simplify healthcare payments and yield powerful results throughout the complete revenue cycle.

Waystar’s healthcare payments platform combines innovative, cloud-based technology, robust data, and unparalleled client support to streamline workflows and improve financials so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Waystar is trusted by 1M+ providers, 1K+ hospitals and health systems, and is connected to over 5K commercial and Medicaid/Medicare payers. We are deeply committed to living out our organizational values: honesty; kindness; passion; curiosity; fanatical focus; best work, always; making it happen; and joyful, optimistic & fun.

Waystar products have won multiple Best in KLAS® or Category Leader awards since 2010 and earned multiple #1 rankings from Black Book™ surveys since 2012. The Waystar platform supports more than 500,000 providers, 1,000 health systems and hospitals, and 5,000 payers and health plans. For more information, visit or follow @Waystar on Twitter.

WAYSTAR PERKS

  • Competitive total rewards (base salary + bonus, if applicable)
  • Customizable benefits package (3 medical plans with Health Saving Account company match)
  • We offer generous paid time off for our non-exempt team members, starting with 3 weeks + 13 paid holidays, including 2 personal floating holidays. We also offer flexible time off for our exempt team members + 13 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave (including maternity + paternity leave)
  • Education assistance opportunities and free LinkedIn Learning access
  • Free mental health and family planning programs, including adoption assistance and fertility support
  • 401(K) program with company match
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee resource groups

Waystar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate, value, and support diversity and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, marital status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: IT Service Manager
description:
mPower, Inc. is seeking an experienced and results-driven IT Service Manager to lead and oversee the delivery of comprehensive IT support services for its customer.

The IT Service Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership for a multidisciplinary team responsible for IT service delivery, Help Desk operations, desktop and systems support, asset management, and information security support. This individual will serve as the primary liaison between mPower and Government stakeholders, ensuring contract performance, service quality, customer satisfaction, and compliance with established requirements.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, hands-on leader with a strong background in IT operations, federal contract management, and IT service management. This position requires someone who can effectively manage personnel, drive operational improvements, resolve complex challenges, and maintain strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities:

Program and Contract Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between mPower and Government stakeholders, including the Contracting Officer (CO), Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and other designated personnel.
  • Provide overall leadership, management, and oversight of contract operations, ensuring successful execution of all contractual requirements, deliverables, and performance standards.
  • Manage program resources, personnel assignments, schedules, budgets, and operational priorities to ensure efficient and effective service delivery.
  • Develop and maintain project management plans, operational procedures, performance reports, and other required contract documentation.
  • Conduct regular meetings with Government stakeholders to review program performance, staffing, project progress, and operational challenges.
  • Identify and proactively address performance concerns, operational risks, resource constraints, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support contract transitions, workforce planning, and continuity of operations as required.

IT Service Management and Operations

  • Oversee daily IT service delivery operations, including Help Desk support, incident management, service requests, desktop support, and technical escalation processes.
  • Ensure adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), performance metrics, and customer service standards.
  • Monitor and evaluate ITSM performance using ticketing systems, reporting dashboards, customer feedback, and operational metrics.
  • Oversee the effective use of IT service management platforms, including ServiceNow or comparable systems, to ensure accurate ticket tracking, prioritization, escalation, and resolution.
  • Coordinate IT projects and initiatives, including technology deployments, hardware refreshes, system upgrades, and service improvements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and Government stakeholders to identify recurring issues, implement corrective actions, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support oversight of IT asset management, including hardware and software inventories, lifecycle management, and compliance reporting.

Team Leadership and Personnel Management

  • Supervise and provide leadership to contractor personnel supporting IT operations and technical services.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, assign responsibilities, monitor productivity, and ensure accountability for assigned work.
  • Identify staffing needs, support recruitment and onboarding activities, and ensure appropriate personnel coverage across supported locations.
  • Promote professional development, technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Foster a collaborative, customer-focused environment that emphasizes responsiveness, professionalism, and high-quality service delivery.
  • Address personnel and performance concerns promptly and effectively.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including ticket volume, response and resolution times, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, and service trends.
  • Prepare accurate and timely weekly and monthly status reports, management briefings, and other required program deliverables.
  • Analyze service delivery metrics to identify trends, recurring challenges, and opportunities to improve efficiency and customer experience.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), escalation processes, and knowledge management practices.
  • Implement process improvements and corrective actions to strengthen operational performance and service quality.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal policies, information security requirements, and established IT operational procedures.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or another related discipline, or a substitute combination of verifiable experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years in a specialized IT-related role.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and management of complex IT programs or projects, from inception through deployment.
  • Experience managing personnel, technical resources, budgets, and operational activities across complex organizational environments.
  • Experience supporting or managing multiple contracts and/or subcontracts of varying size and complexity.
  • Progressive experience in information systems design, management, and IT service delivery.
  • Strong understanding of IT service management principles, Help Desk operations, incident management, escalation procedures, and service performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, resolve operational challenges, and deliver results in a customer-focused environment.
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, organizational, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Government stakeholders, technical personnel, and organizational leadership.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or the ability to obtain in 90 days
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ITIL Version 3 Foundation certification or current equivalent.
  • HDI Help Desk Institute certification, such as:
  • HDI Help Desk Manager
  • HDI Desktop Support Manager
  • HDI Support Center Manager
  • One or more of the following technical certifications:
  • Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA)
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA)
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)
  • Apple Certified Support Professional
  • ITIL Intermediate Certification or higher
  • Previous experience managing IT support services within NIH, HHS, or another federal agency.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
  • Familiarity with federal IT security requirements, IT asset management, and enterprise technology environments.
  • Demonstrated success improving SLA performance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency across large IT support programs.
mPower, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Qualified applicants or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, ancestry, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy (including childbirth or related condition), citizenship, familial status, mental or physical disability status, veteran status, genetic information, other non-disqualifying disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Accommodation Coordinator
description:
Location: Auckland CBD
Employment: Full-time, permanent (participation in a rotating emergency phone roster)
Guaranteed hours: 40 hours per week
Salary: $60,000 - $65,000 gross per annum

About the role:

We are seeking an organised and proactive Accommodation Coordinator to coordinate accommodation arrangements and support a safe, positive experience for our international students, with a particular focus on students under 18.

You will coordinate placements, accommodation changes and holiday arrangements, maintain accurate documentation, and work closely with students, parents, agents, accommodation providers and internal teams. The role requires sound judgement, attention to detail and a responsive approach to accommodation and student welfare concerns.

Key responsibilities

  • Coordinate homestay placements and Designated Caregiver arrangements, ensuring the required documentation and confirmations are completed.
  • Coordinate accommodation and welfare processes for students under 18, following college policies and procedures.
  • Manage the Under 18 Holiday Plan process, including distributing forms, following up with students and families, and confirming arrangements with accommodation providers.
  • Coordinate accommodation changes, transfers and student requests, keeping relevant parties informed.
  • Respond to accommodation enquiries and provide clear information to students, parents, agents, providers and internal teams.
  • Work with accommodation providers and the wider college team to resolve accommodation issues, escalating welfare concerns when required.
  • Maintain accurate, confidential student, accommodation and compliance records across relevant systems.
  • Issue accommodation invoices, monitor payments and follow up outstanding amounts or discrepancies.
  • Participate in the rotating 24/7 emergency phone roster, responding to urgent matters and following established escalation procedures.
  • You will bring empathy, cultural awareness and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining accurate records and timely follow-up.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in student accommodation coordination, international student support or a closely related role.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to coordinate multiple arrangements, deadlines and follow-ups.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to build effective relationships with students, families, agents, accommodation providers and colleagues.
  • Sound judgement when handling sensitive information and student welfare concerns.
  • Accuracy when managing documentation, invoices and payment records.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office and CRM or student management systems.
  • The ability to work effectively with people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
  • Availability to participate in the rotating after-hours emergency phone roster.
  • Experience supporting international students, particularly students under 18, would be an advantage.

Questions about your identity help us appreciate the diversity of individuals looking to work with us, ensuring we’re attracting applications from people with identities and perspectives that are as diverse as our students.

We are an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to equity, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Vice President, Investments
description:
ABOUT CIM GROUP:
CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!

Vice President, Investments (CIM Group, LP – Los Angeles, CA).

Duties:

  • Sourcing and executing transactions meeting investment criteria of CIM’s Infrastructure and Impact investment vehicles.
  • Lead transactions from sourcing through disposition: investment sourcing, underwriting, transaction negotiation, coordination of diligence, and execution, asset management and oversight of business plan.
  • 5-10% North American travel.

Required:

title: Crew Leader
description:
Job Description:

At Arterra Wines Canada, we love inspiring the big and small moments that happen when our products are shared and enjoyed. For us it’s not just about what’s in and on the bottle, it’s what happens in people’s lives when we’re a part of them that keeps us thirsting for more and not resting on our laurels as Canada’s largest and most enjoyed wine company. We put the consumer at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for people who do the same.


The Crew Leader is responsible for leading and supervising the seasonal crew in all vineyard job tasks and ensuring task performance meets specified expectations. In this role, you will communicate regularly with the Vineyard Supervisor and train crew members in all aspects of vineyard job tasks also reporting daily hours and work completed. Transportation of crew to the necessary work sites is required.


Key Responsibilities

  • Liaise with the Vineyard Supervisor on work schedule and tasks, job priorities, tracking of workers’ completed hours and estimated completion times. Record and submit the crew timecards to the Vineyard Supervisors daily.
  • Implement the directives of the Vineyard Supervisor in the daily training of the crew and in all aspects of vineyard tasks and procedures. Ensure OH & S practices are implemented and followed, ensuring employee safety at all times
  • Transport crews to vineyard destination(s). Split the crew as necessary and execute workload as planned
  • Motivate the crew in achieving Arterra Wines Canada objectives. Relay the crew’s needs to the Vineyard Supervisor(s).
  • Coordinate with the Vineyard Supervisor in various other duties related to the vineyard work.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of viticulture experience
  • Grade 12, or equivalent
  • Viticulture knowledge
  • Valid class 5 driver license
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) an asset
  • First aid Certification

Working Conditions

  • The position involves working mainly outdoors. Exposure to summer and winter temperatures is to be expected.
  • Exposure to work in areas with/near heavy equipment and machinery, sometimes on a daily basis. Loud noise is common
  • Some heavy lifting required
  • Position can be considered physically demanding due to long hours, continuous standing and repetitive movements
  • Exposure to chemicals can be expected (mainly pesticides)

Special Conditions

  • Must be available to work long hours including weekends, holidays and overtime during high season
  • Must be prepared to take and retain Bus License (C or F)

Compensation: $23.50-26.00/hour

Job Announcement Paraeducator Moderate/Severe Job Description
Under the supervision of an administrator and general direction of a classroom teacher, assists students with severe disabilities to meet their physical and emotional requirements throughout the instructional day; assists the teacher with record keeping and performs a variety of instructional support duties in developing life skills and/or physical care activities. The work need not be performed in the presence of the teacher, but the teacher retains responsibility for instruction and
supervision.

DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:
Paraeducators work in special education settings where students have behavior emotional, physical, language/communication, or learning disabilities. May spend a substantial portion of their time providing intervention to students who exhibit disruptive, aggressive, depressive, and/or self-injurious behaviors.

Minimum Qualifications:
Education: High School Diploma or equivalent; Courses and/or in-service in psychology, behavior modification, and other related fields desirable but not required. Willingness to complete such training courses, in-service, or otherwise, as may be required upon employment. A.A. degree, 48 units beyond the high school diploma, or successful completion of the District Instructional Assistant Proficiency Test in reading, math, and per the Federal No Child Left Behind Act.
Experience: Prefer experience in the care of children with learning disabilities and/or emotional disturbances. Training in crisis intervention is highly desirable.

Upon Conditional Offer of Employment:

  • DOJ and FBI Criminal Background Check

  • TB Test within the last 60 days (Education Code 49406, Assembly Bill 1667)

  • Complete district Mandated Reporter training, Sexual Harassment, etc.

  • Must obtain and maintain a First Aid/CPR Certificate (In-Person Training ONLY)

  • Pre-Employment Physical Evaluation conducted through the District (Minimum 50 pounds)

Significant Physical Abilities:
With or without the use of aids, the ability to lift up to 50 pounds, sufficient strength to lift nonambulatory students, lift and move adaptive equipment, and physically restrain and control a student up to 200 pounds with assistance, sufficient body movement and mobility to demonstrate gross motor activities, climb in and out of cars, vans, and buses, to walk and run with students, climb well enough to go up and down stairs, to maneuver students into and out of vehicles, wheelchairs, and toilets, sufficient vision to read printed material, with or without aids, sufficient hearing to hear normal and telephone conversations with or without aids, ability to speak in an understandable voice with sufficient volume to be heard in normal conversation, manual dexterity to write and use telephone and other business/office machines. The usual and customary methods of performing the job’s functions require the following physical demands: occasional lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling, climbing and balancing; stooping, kneeling, crouching; reaching, understanding, and following oral and written directions.

title: Senior Help Desk Manager
description:
mPower, Inc. is seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Help Desk Manager to lead and oversee the delivery of comprehensive IT support services for its customer.

The Senior Help Desk Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership for a multidisciplinary team responsible for IT service delivery, Help Desk operations, desktop and systems support, asset management, and information security support. This individual will serve as the primary liaison between mPower and Government stakeholders, ensuring contract performance, service quality, customer satisfaction, and compliance with established requirements.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, hands-on leader with a strong background in IT operations, federal contract management, and IT service management. This position requires someone who can effectively manage personnel, drive operational improvements, resolve complex challenges, and maintain strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities:

Program and Contract Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between mPower and Government stakeholders, including the Contracting Officer (CO), Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and other designated personnel.
  • Provide overall leadership, management, and oversight of contract operations, ensuring successful execution of all contractual requirements, deliverables, and performance standards.
  • Manage program resources, personnel assignments, schedules, budgets, and operational priorities to ensure efficient and effective service delivery.
  • Develop and maintain project management plans, operational procedures, performance reports, and other required contract documentation.
  • Conduct regular meetings with Government stakeholders to review program performance, staffing, project progress, and operational challenges.
  • Identify and proactively address performance concerns, operational risks, resource constraints, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support contract transitions, workforce planning, and continuity of operations as required.

IT Service Management and Operations

  • Oversee daily IT service delivery operations, including Help Desk support, incident management, service requests, desktop support, and technical escalation processes.
  • Ensure adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), performance metrics, and customer service standards.
  • Monitor and evaluate ITSM performance using ticketing systems, reporting dashboards, customer feedback, and operational metrics.
  • Oversee the effective use of IT service management platforms, including ServiceNow or comparable systems, to ensure accurate ticket tracking, prioritization, escalation, and resolution.
  • Coordinate IT projects and initiatives, including technology deployments, hardware refreshes, system upgrades, and service improvements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and Government stakeholders to identify recurring issues, implement corrective actions, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support oversight of IT asset management, including hardware and software inventories, lifecycle management, and compliance reporting.

Team Leadership and Personnel Management

  • Supervise and provide leadership to contractor personnel supporting IT operations and technical services.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, assign responsibilities, monitor productivity, and ensure accountability for assigned work.
  • Identify staffing needs, support recruitment and onboarding activities, and ensure appropriate personnel coverage across supported locations.
  • Promote professional development, technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Foster a collaborative, customer-focused environment that emphasizes responsiveness, professionalism, and high-quality service delivery.
  • Address personnel and performance concerns promptly and effectively.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including ticket volume, response and resolution times, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, and service trends.
  • Prepare accurate and timely weekly and monthly status reports, management briefings, and other required program deliverables.
  • Analyze service delivery metrics to identify trends, recurring challenges, and opportunities to improve efficiency and customer experience.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), escalation processes, and knowledge management practices.
  • Implement process improvements and corrective actions to strengthen operational performance and service quality.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal policies, information security requirements, and established IT operational procedures.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or another related discipline, or a substitute combination of verifiable experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years in a specialized IT-related role.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and management of complex IT programs or projects, from inception through deployment.
  • Experience managing personnel, technical resources, budgets, and operational activities across complex organizational environments.
  • Experience supporting or managing multiple contracts and/or subcontracts of varying size and complexity.
  • Progressive experience in information systems design, management, and IT service delivery.
  • Strong understanding of IT service management principles, Help Desk operations, incident management, escalation procedures, and service performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, resolve operational challenges, and deliver results in a customer-focused environment.
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, organizational, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Government stakeholders, technical personnel, and organizational leadership.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or the ability to obtain in 90 days
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ITIL Version 3 Foundation certification or current equivalent.
  • HDI Help Desk Institute certification, such as:
  • HDI Help Desk Manager
  • HDI Desktop Support Manager
  • HDI Support Center Manager
  • One or more of the following technical certifications:
  • Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA)
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA)
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)
  • Apple Certified Support Professional
  • ITIL Intermediate Certification or higher
  • Previous experience managing IT support services within NIH, HHS, or another federal agency.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
  • Familiarity with federal IT security requirements, IT asset management, and enterprise technology environments.
  • Demonstrated success improving SLA performance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency across large IT support programs.
mPower, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Qualified applicants or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, ancestry, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy (including childbirth or related condition), citizenship, familial status, mental or physical disability status, veteran status, genetic information, other non-disqualifying disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. About the Role:
We're seeking an experienced Location Manager to lead transportation operations in Kansas City, MO. This role encompasses the complete operational lifecycle—from bid development and startup to daily management and continuous improvement. You'll build high-performing teams, manage P&L accountability, and establish best-in-class transportation operations that exceed customer expectations.
What Makes You Successful in This Role:
You're a decisive leader who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments where every day brings new challenges. You balance operational urgency with safety discipline, never compromising on what matters most. You're a natural relationship builder who earns trust with customers, employees, and stakeholders through consistent follow-through. title: Director - Clinical Operations Strategy - SMB West
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our full Clinical Operations suite across the small and mid-size market in the Western United States.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Clinical Operations applications – including CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, Study Training, Payments, Site Connect, and OpenData Clinical – across the SMB West territory. The ideal candidate is a versatile generalist who can speak credibly to every product in the suite, and possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial operations within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how small and mid-size sponsors and CROs run their clinical trials.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of the Veeva Clinical Operations suite among small and mid-size Life Sciences companies across the Western United States, aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
  • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a unified clinical operations platform in improving trial oversight, site activation speed, monitoring efficiency, and operational compliance, tailored to the resourcing realities of smaller organizations
  • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s SMB West sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native clinical operations platform, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure territory revenue goals are achieved
  • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical operations technology at key industry events, regional conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility across the SMB West market
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Clinical Operations roadmap based on SMB market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
  • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on the trial management pain points specific to small and mid-size sponsors, identify emerging trends in decentralized trials and outsourcing models, and provide actionable insights to enhance our Clinical Operations products and overall business strategy

Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
  • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management across a broad product portfolio
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations leaders, and C-level executives)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

  • Clinical Operations Breadth: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy or implementation across multiple clinical operations applications, such as CTMS, eTMF, study startup, study training, payments, or site collaboration; the ability to speak credibly to any product in the suite is a core competency
  • SMB Market Experience: Specific experience working with small and mid-size sponsors and CROs, where teams are lean, budgets are tight, and buying cycles move quickly
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory/compliance considerations in clinical trial technology
  • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $125,000 - $300,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. title: Test & Development Engineer
description:
This is a great opportunity to join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of the Cellular Origins’ Constellation system.

As a Test and Development Engineer, you’ll sit at the heart of product delivery, working closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists to bring our vision to life through development, integration, and rigorous testing. You’ll help to ensure our robots and automated systems meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and compliance.

Working together with design teams, you will initially be focused on development and integration of our system elements, creating test strategies, plans and protocols running procedures, and evaluating performance to ensure functionality, performance and reliable operation. Your experience working with mechatronics systems will help you to diagnose faults, provide feedback to the design team and recommend solutions.

In the longer term, you will transition to more formal verification of our system elements, generating protocols, managing changes, maintaining traceability, overseeing verification activities and writing reports. Your attention to detail and strong documentation will make you key to successful system verification and release.

This is somewhere to really make your mark, working in a technically challenging and impact-driven venture, with bright and committed peers, to define the future of cell therapy manufacturing.

Essential

  • A strong engineering background gained either by degree or vocational route.
  • Proven experience of testing and other means of verification, and troubleshooting complex mechatronics systems, preferably within a product development environment.
  • Robust technical analysis and documentation skills including generating Test Protocols and Test Reports.
  • Capable of applying statistical and data analysis, simulation, and engineering modelling techniques to evaluate product performance, predict behaviour, and generate actionable insights that drive design improvement.
  • Ability to identify failure modes, conduct structured root cause investigations, and implement data-driven corrective actions to improve product reliability and robustness.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams and fast-paced environments.

Desirable

  • A solid understanding of robotic automation system and robot integration, control systems, and testing methodologies.
  • Familiar with modern programming languages such as Python and robotic software frameworks (ROS).
  • Experience working within development of robotic automation systems and robots.

Cellular Origins is based at Melbourn Science Park, just 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our newly renovated premises offer modern office, laboratory and engineering spaces, surrounded by green spaces. We foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture, where ideas are encouraged, innovation thrives, and everyone has the freedom to do their best work.

Our employee benefits include:

  • Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary
  • Private medical insurance for employees and dependants
  • Subsidised lunches
  • Enhanced family friendly leave
  • Life insurance worth 6x salary
  • Electric car leasing scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Season ticket loan

title: Sewing Technician
description:
OVERVIEW

Axiom Space is a human space exploration company, building era-defining space infrastructure and delivering technology-driven solutions that will empower civilization to transcend Earth. Beginning with Axiom Station, successor to the International Space Station, the company is pioneering a next-generation orbital settlement that will foster groundbreaking innovation and research in microgravity and drive the global space economy of tomorrow. Today, guided by the vision of leading humanity's expansion off planet, Axiom Space is the principal provider of commercial human spaceflight services and developer of advanced spacesuits for the Moon and beyond. For more information about Axiom Space, visit www.axiomspace.com.


Axiom Space fosters a work environment inclusive of all perspectives. We are the pioneers of commercial space, leading the transformation of low-Earth orbit into a global space marketplace. Our mission-driven team is seeking a bold and dynamic Sewing Technician who is fueled by high accountability, execution horsepower, and driven to understand our world, science/technology, and life itself, for the benefit of all on Earth and beyond.


POSITION SUMMARY

Since Axiom Space is a very complex work environment, we are looking for a resilient, high-energy Sewing Technician who is responsible for fabrication, assembly and repair of soft-good components and assemblies. This role requires proficiency in the use and operation of the following industrial sewing

machines, Straight Stitch (single and double needle), Walking Foot, Bartack, Buttonhole and 3 Thread Rolled Hem Serger. Candidate will be required to complete safety training as well as training on operating procedures and desk instructions. Perform duties in accordance with established flight and training process procedures and work-authorizing documents. Proficient in reading soft-goods fabrication and assembly drawings. Proficient in the fabrication of soft-goods patterns.


KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sew materials by hand and/or sewing machine, to join, gather, reinforce, or decorate materials or fabricated articles to tight tolerances.
  • Cuts materials, according to specifications, or cuts excess material or thread from finished product, using blade, scissors, or electric knife.
  • Examines and measures finished articles to verify conformance to standards.
  • Monitors sewing operation to detect problems, such as defective stitching or breaks in thread. Mounts attachments, such as needles, and adjusts machine guides according to specifications. Places spools of thread, cord, or other materials on spindles, inserts bobbin, and threads ends through machine guides and components.
  • Positions and marks patterns on materials to prepare for sewing. Positions materials through feed rollers and guides, or positions and maneuvers under sewing machine presser foot and needle during operation. Removes finished materials from sewing machine. Replaces needle and cleans/oils sewing machines to maintain equipment.
  • Records materials processed in production logs.
  • Responsible for the quality and accuracy of the product fabrication according to the fabrication instructions and/or drawing. Use specialized automatic or semi-automatic sewing equipment and other equipment as required to fabricate products.
  • Takes direction from leads and more experienced sewers
  • Communicating project progress, status, and potential issues to stakeholders and leadership
  • Implementing and maintaining agile project management methodologies throughout the project lifecycle
  • Perform additional job duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent, 3+ years of sewing/softgood manufacturing preferably in the aerospace field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proficient in the use and operation of the following industrial sewing machines, Straight Stitch (single and double needle), Walking Foot, Bartack, Buttonhole and 3 Thread Rolled Hem Serger.
  • Proficient in reading soft-goods fabrication and assembly drawings.
  • Proficient in the fabrication of soft-goods patterns.
  • Ability to sew materials by hand and/or sewing machine, to join, gather, reinforce, or decorate materials or fabricated articles to very tight tolerances.
  • Ability to cut materials according to specifications, or cuts excess material or thread from finished product, using blade, scissors, or electric knife to very tight tolerances.
  • Capacity to work in a team environment.
  • Track record of making things happen in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Uses good judgement to problem-solve proactively, positively impacting hard challenges
  • Demonstrated organization skills to meet tight deadlines with high quality results

Core Skills

  • Passion for space and the mission
  • Entrepreneurial, growth mindset
  • High EQ and ability to collaborate within teams and cross-functionally
  • Tech-solutioning in using systems and tools to move smarter and faster

Core Competencies:

Embody our core values of leadership, innovation, and teamwork. In addition, to perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Accountability
  • Technical Rigor
  • Execution Discipline
  • Pride of Delivery

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Generally, an office environment, but can involve inside or outside work depending on the task.


Requirements

  • This position may require access to export controlled technical data or technology subject to NASA regulations, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). In accordance with U.S. export control laws, final candidates may be required to undergo additional export control screening to determine eligibility for access. Meeting these requirements is a condition of employment.

Research Specialist B
