title: Cloud Security Engineer - part-time (R-00250)
description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to support the design, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of security capabilities across enterprise cloud environments in a part-time capacity. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience securing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure environments, with additional exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This role requires a technically proficient engineer with experience deploying and managing cloud security solutions, integrating security monitoring and threat detection tools, and securing containerized infrastructure. The successful candidate will collaborate with security operations, cloud engineering, and infrastructure teams to strengthen security posture, identify vulnerabilities, automate security controls, and respond to emerging threats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Security Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain security controls across AWS and Azure environments, with additional support for GCP, ensuring secure configurations, access controls, and alignment with industry security best practices.
  • Security Tool Implementation and Integration: Deploy, configure, optimize, and maintain security technologies including CrowdStrike, Splunk, Rapid7, and Red Canary to support endpoint protection, threat detection, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.
  • Threat Detection and Incident Response: Investigate security alerts, analyze cloud infrastructure threats, support incident response activities, and develop remediation strategies to reduce organizational risk across cloud environments.
  • Container and Infrastructure Security: Implement security controls for containerized environments using Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS Bottlerocket, including container hardening, vulnerability assessments, runtime protection, and secure deployment practices.
  • Vulnerability Management and Security Automation: Identify, prioritize, and remediate cloud security vulnerabilities, automate repetitive security operations, and develop scripts or workflows to improve security efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Cross-Functional Security Collaboration: Partner with cloud architects, DevOps, infrastructure engineers, and security operations teams to integrate security into cloud deployments, support security assessments, and continuously improve enterprise security posture.

Position Requirements

  • Cloud Security Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, cybersecurity engineering, or infrastructure security, with demonstrated experience securing AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Cloud Security Platforms: Strong knowledge of AWS and Azure security services, identity and access management (IAM), network security, logging, encryption, and cloud security configuration best practices.
  • Security Tools: Practical experience deploying, administering, integrating, or troubleshooting one or more enterprise security platforms, preferably CrowdStrike, Splunk, Rapid7, or Red Canary.
  • Container Security: Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container security concepts, including vulnerability scanning, workload protection, and secure container configuration.
  • Threat and Vulnerability Management: Experience identifying and investigating security threats, analyzing vulnerabilities, implementing remediation measures, and supporting incident response within cloud or hybrid environments.
  • Technical Troubleshooting and Automation: Strong troubleshooting skills and experience with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Senior Scientist II, Recombinant Peptide Process Development
description:
AbbVie’s Biologics CMC organization develops processes to support the advancement and manufacture of biologic medicines. AbbVie is seeking a highly motivated scientist to lead development of microbial-based recombinant peptide production processes. This position will serve as a technical lead across expression-system and strain development, fermentation, recovery, purification, and scale-up.

Recombinant production of short peptides can be challenging due to intracellular degradation, low expression, aggregation, and limited solubility. The successful candidate will develop and optimize practical strategies to address these challenges and advance robust, scalable processes for therapeutic peptide production. When aligned with program needs, the candidate will also evaluate and apply genetic code expansion (GCE) strategies to enable the site-specific incorporation of non-canonical amino acids. The role will collaborate with cross-functional partners and contribute to process development, technology evaluation, and technology transfer activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead recombinant peptide process-development activities, including expression strategy, host and clone screening, process optimization, and scale-up.
  • Design and evaluate expression constructs and microbial hosts, including Escherichia coli and yeast, for peptide production.
  • Develop and assess fusion-tag and carrier-protein strategies—including His-tag, GST, SUMO, and inclusion-body expression—to improve peptide stability, expression, host tolerance, and recovery.
  • Design and conduct clone-screening studies using microscale cultivation, parallel bioreactors, and other appropriate scale-down or high-throughput approaches.
  • Develop and optimize peptide recovery processes, including cell harvest and lysis, inclusion-body isolation and processing, and chemical or enzymatic cleavage of fusion partners.
  • Troubleshoot peptide-specific process challenges, such as aggregation, low solubility, degradation, incomplete cleavage, and co-eluting impurities; recommend and pursue appropriate solutions.
  • Interpret analytical results, including HPLC, UPLC, and LC-MS data, to assess peptide identity, mass accuracy, purity, and process-related impurities; partner with analytical teams to address characterization needs.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and process approaches for recombinant peptide production, including genetic code expansion when relevant to program needs.
  • Apply AI/ML approaches, where appropriate, to analyze peptide sequence, structure, and experimental data in support of design, optimization, and candidate prioritization.
  • Communicate scientific plans, progress, challenges, conclusions, and recommendations clearly to project teams and other stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior scientists and provide technical direction in recombinant peptide bioprocessing.
  • Contribute to scientific publications and presentations at conferences, as appropriate.
  • Maintain a high level of productivity while managing priorities and timelines; follow applicable corporate standards for safety, quality, and compliance.
  • PhD with typically 4+ years of relevant experience, master’s degree or equivalent education with 10+ years of relevant experience or Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education with typically 12+ years of relevant experience is required.
  • Thorough theoretical and practical understanding of relevant scientific disciplines, with hands-on experience in microbial physiology and recombinant expression systems, particularly E. coli and/or yeast.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, and interpret critical experiments to address scientific or development questions.
  • Experience developing or optimizing expression processes for peptides, small proteins, or other products susceptible to degradation, or instability.
  • Experience with strain or clone screening, fermentation, and process optimization; familiarity with bioreactors and scale-down or parallel cultivation approaches.
  • Demonstrated experience with preparative chromatography and peptide or protein purification, as well as peptide recovery and fusion-partner cleavage strategies.
  • Strong experimental design, data interpretation, troubleshooting, scientific writing, and oral communication skills.

description:

At Memorial Hermann Texas Medical Center, you’ll be part of a highly specialized occupational therapy team at the forefront of advanced cardiovascular rehabilitation. Our Heart & Vascular Institute offers a unique opportunity to combine complex patient care, clinical innovation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and professional leadership in an environment that values expertise, teamwork, and continuous growth.

Highlights of joining our team-

• Advanced Clinical Practice: Work with highly complex cardiovascular patients, including those requiring ECMO and advanced mechanical circulatory support devices, while participating in innovative early mobilization and rehabilitation practices.
• Exceptional Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and other specialists to develop individualized rehabilitation plans for critically ill patients.
• Clinical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and develop a cohesive team of skilled occupational therapists, fostering clinical excellence through mentorship, competency development, and ongoing education.
• Innovation & Research: Participate in clinical research, evidence-based practice initiatives, and opportunities to advance rehabilitation approaches for patients with complex cardiovascular conditions.
• Professional Growth & Development: Expand your expertise through specialized clinical education, continuing education opportunities, and exposure to cutting-edge cardiovascular interventions.
• A Collaborative, High-Performing Team: Join a supportive, highly skilled team that thrives on collaboration, shared learning, and delivering exceptional care to patients with complex medical needs.
• Meaningful Clinical Impact: Play an essential role in helping critically ill patients regain function, independence, and quality of life throughout their recovery.

Training and orientation provided over a nine month period

Job Description

Schedule

Open to 8, 10 or 12-hr days

Weekdays TBD

Three Saturdays or Sundays per month required


Minimum Qualifications

Education: Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapist Assistant or an Occupational Therapist program.

Licenses/Certifications: Current License to practice Occupational Therapy by the Texas Board of Occupational Therapy Examiners license or eligibility.

Current certification in Basic Life Support.

Fine hand dexterity, eye-hand coordination, the ability to receive oral and written communication, and to communicate verbally and in writing are also necessary. The visual ability to monitor instruments, computers and equipment, recognize alphanumeric characters, distinguish colors and observe physical characteristics are essential to this position.

Principal Accountabilities

title: Project Manager
description:

Required Skills:

At Onit, we’re committed to offering fair and competitive compensation. In addition to base pay, associates are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The final base salary you receive will reflect factors such as your skills, education, experience, and work location.

title: Senior Analyst, Logistics & Materials Management
description:

Solar Landscape is the nation’s leading distributed energy infrastructure company, transforming commercial real estate into a source of new power by deploying solar and storage at scale. That doesn’t happen without a team of smart, driven, and down-to-earth people who are serious about doing excellent work—and fun to work with. Career growth here isn’t limited by title or a rigid path: people who take ownership and deliver are given opportunities to stretch, lead, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll be supported by great benefits, professional development, and a culture that values authenticity, collaboration, and accountability.

Across our headquarters in Asbury Park, New Jersey and our offices in New York City, Chicago, and Baltimore, Solar Landscape employees are building something that matters, deploying critical energy infrastructure that creates long-term value for communities, property owners, and the grid. Come join us.

About The Role

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Logistics & Materials Management Analyst to support our Supply Chain & Logistics team. This role will coordinate inbound logistics, support warehouse and 3PL operations, maintain inventory accuracy and visibility, and contribute to operational reporting and process improvements. The Analyst will work with Procurement, Logistics, Construction, Finance, and warehouse partners to support reliable material flow to projects.

Responsibilties

  • Coordinate inbound logistics, including shipment scheduling, tracking, warehouse receiving readiness, and resolution of delivery issues. Provide backup support for outbound transportation and carrier coordination as needed.

  • Maintain inventory accuracy and visibility through regular reconciliations, cycle counts, discrepancy resolution, and tracking of inventory quantities, locations, and allocation status.
  • Monitor warehouse capacity, inventory availability, and material readiness to identify potential shortages, storage constraints, and other risks to project execution.
  • Support the development and maintenance of operational reporting and KPIs, including inventory accuracy, warehouse utilization, 3PL performance, and inbound/outbound activity.
  • Identify opportunities to improve warehouse, inventory, and logistics processes, including supporting system enhancements, data accuracy, and standardized workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Two or more years of relevant experience in supply chain, warehousing, inventory management, distribution, or logistics preferred.
  • Working knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory controls, transportation coordination, or 3PL management.
  • Strong analytical and Excel skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, interpret operational data, and identify improvements.
  • Experience using ERP, WMS, inventory management, or shipment tracking systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and coordinate across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Zoho, Power BI, or comparable systems.
  • Familiarity with solar, construction materials, or project-based supply chain operations.
  • Experience developing operational KPIs, improving processes, or supporting inventory reconciliation initiatives.

Work Environment

  • Hybrid or in-office work, depending on project requirements.
  • Fast-paced and dynamic work setting, focused on renewable energy and sustainability.
Benefits and Perks
We offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work:

  • 401(k) with 4% company match
  • Summer Fridays
  • Flexible remote/hybrid work options

  • Team lunches, events, and stocked kitchens
  • Modern, collaborative office spaces in Asbury Park, New York City, Boston, Chicago, and Baltimore
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and long-term disability insurance

title: Senior Director - Disclosures Strategy
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Senior Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our clinical trial disclosures and transparency solution, Veeva Disclosures, within the Veeva Clinical Operations suite.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Disclosures solution. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial transparency and disclosure practices within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how sponsors and CROs meet their global trial registration and results reporting obligations.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of Veeva Disclosures among Life Sciences companies (Sponsors, CROs, and emerging biotechs), aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
  • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a connected disclosures solution in improving registration speed, submission accuracy, deadline management, and overall transparency reporting efficiency
  • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native disclosures application that sources data directly from their existing clinical applications, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure revenue goals are achieved
  • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical trial transparency technology at key industry events, conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Disclosures roadmap based on market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
  • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on disclosure and transparency pain points, identify emerging trends in global registry requirements and public data sharing, and provide actionable insights to enhance the Disclosures product and overall business strategy

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
  • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations leaders, and C-level executives)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

  • Disclosures Domain Expertise: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy for clinical trial disclosure and transparency solutions; understanding the nuances of trial registration, results reporting, and redaction and anonymization workflows is a core competency
  • Clinical Operations Expertise: Specific experience with the operational workflows of sponsor clinical development, transparency, and regulatory teams, as well as CROs
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and global clinical trial transparency requirements such as ClinicalTrials.gov and EU CTR
  • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $150,000 - $300,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

title: Senior Administrator
description:
The Senior Administrator will be responsible for the direct line management of Administration Officers and Patient Engagement Officers, ensuring tasks such as appraisals, routine 121 meetings, annual leave and sickness absence reviews are completed / monitored.

The role will also include acting as the first point of contact on behalf of the business for the programme’s patients.

They are directly responsible for the oversight of patient management from front end registration to ensuring adequate call and recall targets are maintained by the creating and editing of clinical locations, database validation and cleansing and to issue all communication in a timely fashion ensuring notification of information to patients and healthcare professionals are received.

Main responsibilities and opportunities:

  • The creation, editing and maintenance of clinical locations and the appointment schedule ensuring all eligible patients are offered annual screening as per NDESP guidelines and guidance. This will involve the booking, rearrangement and cancellation of appointments in accordance with programme requirements.
  • Maintaining an up to date and accurate patient database by undertaking and participating in continual data validation through multiple levels of data analysis.
  • Timely issuing of all accurate clinical data and screening results to patients and healthcare professionals adhering to NDESP guidelines at all times, in a secure and auditable environment.
  • Maintain and make available any and all policy documents, audit trails and office Legislative compliance documentation accessible for inspection at all times.
  • Ensuring all documentation of a sensitive nature and containing Personal Identifiable Data (PID) is disposed of in a secure a proper manner in line with 1998 Data Protection Act and Calidcott Principle Guidelines.
  • Reviewing and maintaining a safe, risk free office environment to help promote an office environment that is tidy, orderly and compliance with relevant legislation.
  • Ensure all office stationery material are kept stocked and raise any requirements for timely replenishment.
  • Responsible for adequate clinical capacity maintenance and attendance via the arrangement and monitoring of appointment slots filled and available
  • Identify areas of underperformance or concerns within the programme on a clinical level and to communicate these to the Administration Team Leader and Programme Manager.
  • Communicate with healthcare professionals, including Ophthalmologists, Optometrists, Diabetic nurses and GP’s to determine best levels of care and clinical decisions are followed for patients in line with guidance from the Administration Team Leader.
  • The administration acts as continued first line communication with a large cohort of patients, with direct impact on organisational performance and reputation. They are also directly influential on the organisations reputation with a wide number of stakeholders including GP’s Ophthalmologists, Optometrists, other organisations (Including other DESP programmes & NHS members) and service users.
  • Excellent communication skills covering telephone, written and electronic formats.
  • Experience in the use of database software.
  • Excellent IT skills and a working understanding of Microsoft Office software.
  • Ability to work under your own initiative and priorities tasks using problem solving skills.
  • Ability to initiate and manage change.
  • Open to the continued advancement and service improvement to working practices on a local and Organisation level and actively engage with any development opportunities.
  • Minimum of 2 pass Leaving Certificate or equivalent qualification.
  • Evidence of continued professional development (CPD)
